scripts.translation: 当时的王位候选人伊森阿姆突然暴起，最后被格博格家族的继承人杀死了。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: After discussion, our family decided not to take part in the ^0000cdRoyal Assembly^000000 this time.
scripts.translation: 商议之后，我们家族决定这次不参加王室集会。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well then. I hope you enjoy the banquet. The banquet is held for you after all.
scripts.translation: 那么，希望你能玩得尽兴。毕竟这场宴会是为你举办的。

scripts.text: Yes. Thank you for sparing me some time.
scripts.translation: 好的。谢谢你抽空接待我。

scripts.text: I hope you enjoy the banquet since it is held for you.
scripts.translation: 这场宴会是为你举办的，希望你能尽兴。

scripts.text: Why are you here? I thought we agreed ^0000cdnot to see each other ever again after the previous Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation: 你怎么来了？我们不是说好，上次王室集会后就再也不见吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I remember that, but the heir of your family has been busy these days.
scripts.translation: 我记得。不过你们家的继承人最近一直在忙着调查。

scripts.text: He has been digging around so much that the story has reached me.
scripts.translation: 他四处打听的事已经传到我耳朵里了。

scripts.text: No one seems to pay much attention, but you never know.
scripts.translation: 虽然好像没人太在意，但谁知道呢。

scripts.text: I told Isenhonor to ^0000cdstop investigating about his brother's death^000000.
scripts.translation: 我已经叫伊森霍纳别再调查他哥哥的死因了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He should. It would get us both in trouble if the fact that ^0000cdwe were going to kill the imperial candidate of the Geoborg family^000000 leaks out.
scripts.translation: 他最好听你的。要是我们打算杀害格博格家族王位候选人的事泄露出去，我们两家都会惹上麻烦。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: No one knows about it, you know.
The ^0000cdplan was ruined ^000000as Isenarm was killed while acting violently.
scripts.translation: 00cd计划已经失败了，伊森阿姆在暴走时被杀了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I am sorry about your heir.
scripts.translation: 你们家失去了继承人，我很遗憾。

scripts.text: I don't care who becomes the heir as long as he leads the family well.
scripts.translation: 只要能带领家族走好，谁当继承人我都不在乎。只是

scripts.text: I don't understand why Isenarm who has behaved so well acted that way though...
scripts.translation: 我不明白，一向表现出色的伊森阿姆为什么会突然那样...

scripts.text: He must have sensed something to act like than when he was about to be elected as the king... There is no way to find out now...
scripts.translation: 他快要当选国王时，肯定察觉到了什么才会那样做...现在也无从查证了...听说格

scripts.text: Geoborg has been silent as well ever since, I hear.
scripts.translation: 博格家族从那以后也一直保持沉默。

scripts.text: Since Isenarm was killed by Geoborg, ^0000cdthe Walther family has been excluded from the Royal Assembly^000000 this time.
scripts.translation: 伊森阿姆死在格博格家族手上后，沃尔特家这次被排除在王室集会之外 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He was a great boy. It is a shame since he was the perfect candidate for the throne.
scripts.translation: 00。他是个好孩子，本来是王位候选人的最佳人选，真可惜。

scripts.text: The important thing is that as long as we both keep silent, the truth will remain unknown forever.
scripts.translation: 只要我们都守口如瓶，真相就会永远埋没。那我

scripts.text: Then, I guess we will never see each other again.
scripts.translation: 们以后大概不会再见了。

scripts.text: Make sure to warn your heir not to dig around the incident, no more.
scripts.translation: 警告你的继承人，别再调查这件事。事情要是败

scripts.text: If it gets out, my family can deny it.
scripts.translation: 露，我的家族可以撇清关系。

scripts.text: However, you Ian will be in trouble as the same member of the family since there is no witness or proof left now.
scripts.translation: 不过，伊恩，你也是同谋。如今没有证人或证据，你也会惹上麻烦。

scripts.text: Shh... You'd better keep your voice down. Your heir may hear you.
scripts.translation: 嘘...小声点，你的继承人可能会听见。我

scripts.text: I mean, we should be careful.
Well, I cannot be absent for so long anyway. Let me head back now.
scripts.translation: 好了，我也不能离开太久，先回去了。

scripts.text: I shouldn't have worked with him in the first place. I lost my poor nephew for nothing.
scripts.translation: ...！我一开始就不该和他合作，结果白白害死了我可怜的侄子。

scripts.text: You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
scripts.translation: 你行李不少啊，拿得动吗？看

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large.

scripts.translation: 要不要先精简一下行李？

scripts.text: You must be an adventurer. Thank you for visiting this gloomy place.
scripts.translation: 你是冒险者吧？谢谢你来这个冷清的地方。

scripts.text: The representative of our family is over there. I hope you have a good time then.
scripts.translation: 我们家族的代表在那边。祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text: What are you doing here? The Banquet Hall is over there.
scripts.translation: 你在这里做什么？宴会厅在那边。

scripts.text: I was sorry that I didn't get the time to talk to you then.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，刚才没机会和你说话。

scripts.text: What story? You mean the story of my brother being killed for his violent behavior? You seemed to hear it so eagerly. I hope you don't believe that bullshit.
scripts.translation: 什么事？你是说我哥哥因暴走而被杀的事？你好像听得很起劲。希望你别信那些鬼话。

scripts.text: I cannot believe that my brother has acted violently. Even if he did, there must have been a ^0000cdreason.^000000
scripts.translation: 我不相信哥哥会突然暴走。即使他真的那样做了，也一定有理由。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: My brother, he must have done it for something. No one knows the truth, but people seem to believe the gossip.
scripts.translation: 哥哥肯定是有原因才那样做的。没人知道真相，可大家似乎都相信流言。

scripts.text: If you want to clear the name of your brother, you can investigate on your own.
scripts.translation: 想替你哥哥洗清罪名的话，可以自己去调查。

scripts.text: I am trying. But ^0000cdthe elders of my family don't want me to dig out the dishonorable incident^000000.
scripts.translation: 我正在查。可是家族长老不希望我继续追查这桩丑闻。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Also, it is impossible to meet ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000.
scripts.translation: 而且，我也见不到恩斯特·格博格。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: No. any access to him is blocked.
scripts.translation: 不，所有接触他的途径都被封锁了。

scripts.text: The ^0000cdGuardian Knight^000000 and ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000 are the only people who know what has happened that day. However it is impossible to meet them. I don't know where to begin...
scripts.translation: 只有守护骑士和恩斯特·格博格知道那天发生了什么，可我根本见不到他们。我都不知道该从哪儿查起... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: A Guardian Knight? Did your brother have a Guardian Knight?
scripts.translation: 守护骑士？你哥哥有守护骑士？

scripts.text: Yes. Each member of the Walther family has a Guardian Knight. Our family is in overseas trade so that we often travel by ship.
scripts.translation: 是的，沃尔特家族的每位成员都有守护骑士。我们家做海外贸易，经常要乘船出行。

scripts.text: As you know, the sailors are not a gentle bunch and we tend to carry money with us so that we are often threatened. We all have to bring Guardian Knights with us.
scripts.translation: 你也知道，水手可不好惹，而且我们常带着钱，容易被人盯上。因此每次出门都得带上守护骑士。

scripts.text: Where is your Guardian Knight then, Isenhonor?
scripts.translation: 那你的守护骑士呢，伊森霍纳？

scripts.text: I am sick of Guardian Knights since my brother's Guardian Knight abandoned my brother and ran away. I don't want to call them Guardian Knights.
scripts.translation: 哥哥的守护骑士抛弃他逃走了。从那以后我就不喜欢守护骑士这个称呼。

scripts.text: What should I call a Guardian Knight who betrays the master and runs away?
scripts.translation: 背叛主人、临阵脱逃的守护骑士，还算什么守护骑士？

scripts.text: I think it would be a good idea to start from your Guardian Knight. Since they worked together as Guardian Knight, he must know something.
scripts.translation: 不如先从你的守护骑士问起。既然他和你哥哥共事过，应该知道些什么。

scripts.text: Well, when I asked, he told me he knew nothing. If he did, he must have told me before I even asked.
scripts.translation: 我问过他，他说什么都不知道。要是知道，他早该主动告诉我了。他

scripts.text: They were pretty close and often exercised together.
scripts.translation: 们以前关系很好，还经常一起训练。

scripts.text: Oh, well, since they were so close, he could have tried to defend his friend.
scripts.translation: 哦...既然他们那么要好，他可能是想替朋友辩护。

scripts.text: Why didn't I think of that...
Let me talk to him now. If I hear anything, it would be a good thing. Even if I don't get to hear anything it would still count as a try.
scripts.translation: 让我去和他谈谈吧。问出线索最好，就算什么都没问出来，也算试过了。

scripts.text: Why would you go through such trouble?
scripts.translation: 你为什么要为这事费这么大劲？

scripts.text: Well, I have a hunch. As an adventurer, my instinct says that there must be something going on.
scripts.translation: 我有种预感。作为冒险者，我的直觉告诉我这件事另有隐情。

scripts.text: Do all the adventurers count on their hunch like that? This could be dangerous. It is no matter to approach with a hunch.
scripts.translation: 冒险者都这么凭直觉行事吗？这很危险。不能只凭预感就贸然行动。

scripts.text: That is why it is called an adventure. Adventurers where the adventures are.
scripts.translation: 这就是冒险的意义。冒险者就是要去冒险。

scripts.text: You may call it a needless meddling out of curiosity. However, I cannot neglect anyone in distress.
scripts.translation: 你可以说我只是好奇，才多管闲事。但我不能对陷入困境的人袖手旁观。

scripts.text: I appreciate your help though. I am desperate enough to accept your favor. However, I don't think you wouldn't hear much from the Guardian Knight though.
scripts.translation: 我很感激你愿意帮忙。我已经走投无路，只能接受你的好意了。不过我觉得守护骑士那里也问不出什么。

scripts.text: If you want to meet him anyway, go to ^0000cdour manor in the south of Alberta^000000. He must be there.
scripts.translation: 如果你还是想见他，就去艾尔贝塔南边的沃尔特家宅邸找他。他应该在那里。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, how did your meeting with the Guardian Knight in Alberta go? Not that I expect too much...
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你在艾尔贝塔见到守护骑士了吗？虽然我不抱太大希望...

scripts.text: However, still, I have hoped to hear good news from you...
scripts.translation: 不过，我还是希望能听到好消息...

scripts.text: Adventurer, you are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你回来了。怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I have something for you...
I must have left it back. Let me go bring it for you.
scripts.translation: 我大概落在那边了。我去取来给你。

scripts.text: You are back. How did it go?
I told him the story of meeting the Guardian Knight of Isenarm and the conversation with him.
scripts.translation: 我把与伊森阿姆的守护骑士会面、以及和他交谈的内容都告诉了伊森霍纳。

scripts.text: Well, this indeed is the seal of our family, and it is my brother's handwriting.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这确实是我们家族的印章，而且笔迹也是我哥哥的。

scripts.text: As you said, my brother's Guardian Knight must have not betrayed my brother.
scripts.translation: 正如你所说，我哥哥的守护骑士应该没有背叛他。

scripts.text: My brother indeed must have done such a thing for a reason.
scripts.translation: 哥哥做那种事，一定有他的理由。

scripts.text: I guess this is all I can do you now.
scripts.translation: 我现在能做的也就这些了。

scripts.text: I understand. I should take on from here. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。接下来就交给我吧。谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text: Please come back anytime when you need the help of the Walther family.
scripts.translation: 以后需要沃尔特家族帮忙，随时来找我。

scripts.text: You are a valuable guest for us, the Walther family, from now on, dear adventurer. I'll help you anytime you want.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，从今以后你就是沃尔特家族的重要客人。只要你开口，我随时愿意帮忙。

scripts.text: Based on the piece of information you have brought me, I am collecting other information too. It is not enough year, but I believe that I can unveil the truth someday.
scripts.translation: 根据你带来的线索，我也在继续搜集情报。现在的线索还不够，但我相信总有一天能查明真相。

scripts.text: I called Simon from Alberta. I need to gather all the help I can get now.
scripts.translation: 我已经联系了艾尔贝塔的西蒙。现在能争取的助力，我都会争取。

scripts.text: I will see you again when the truth is revealed.
scripts.translation: 等真相揭晓时，我们再见。

scripts.text: Well, I am looking for the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor. Where can I find him?
scripts.translation: 我在找伊森霍纳的守护骑士。你知道他在哪里吗？

scripts.text: I am his Guardian Knight. What's the matter? Has anything happened to him?
scripts.translation: 我就是他的守护骑士。怎么了？主人出事了吗？

scripts.text: I shouldn't have stayed behind. Is he all right?
scripts.translation: 我不该留在这里的。主人没事吧？

scripts.text: Kidnapping? Injury? Robbery? Fall? What is it? Oh, I should go there now...!
scripts.translation: 被绑架了？受伤了？被抢了？摔倒了？到底怎么了？我现在就赶过去...！

scripts.text: Calm down. Isenhonor is all right. Nothing happened. I am here to ask you something.
scripts.translation: 冷静点，伊森霍纳没事，什么也没发生。我只是想问你一些事。

scripts.text: Phew, I guess it wasn't my lord who called me. I am still glad that I is OK.
scripts.translation: 呼...看来不是主人叫我回去。知道他没事，我也就放心了。

scripts.text: What are you going to ask me? Well, who are you by the way?
scripts.translation: 你想问什么？对了，你是哪位？

scripts.text: [I told him the conversation with Isenhonor in the palace briefly.]
scripts.translation: [我简要告诉他，我在宫中与伊森霍纳交谈的内容。]

scripts.text: Oh, sorry about that. I am ^0000cdSimon Walther Marshall^000000.
scripts.translation: 噢，失礼了。我叫西蒙·沃尔特·马歇尔。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I don't know the whereabouts of ^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000 who used to be the Guardian Knight of Isenarm, unfortunately.
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，我不知道凯恩·沃尔特·沃克在哪里。他曾是伊森阿姆的守护骑士。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You both have Walther in your names. Is there a special reason for it?
scripts.translation: 你们的名字里都有“沃尔特”，有什么特别的缘由吗？

scripts.text: Every knight belongs to the Walther who is assigned to a member of the Walther family is given the name, Walther.
scripts.translation: 沃尔特家族会给派给家族成员的骑士冠上“沃尔特”之名。

scripts.text: The name gives a sense of belonging. Also it gives us the pride to have been recognized as excellent knights.
scripts.translation: 这个名字让我们有归属感，也让我们为自己获认可、成为优秀骑士而自豪。

scripts.text: Right. By the way, did you say that you know nothing about Kain Walther Walker?
scripts.translation: 明白了。对了，你刚才说不知道凯恩·沃尔特·沃克的下落？

scripts.text: I heard a ^0000cdstrange gossip^000000 from some of the knights there when I escorted Isenhonor to the palace.
scripts.translation: 我护送伊森霍纳去宫殿时，听那里的骑士说起一条奇怪的传闻。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: They heard ^0000cda pickpocket locked in the basement of the palace^000000 babbling about how he had seen a person from the Walther family in a foreign country.
scripts.translation: 他们听说有个被关在宫殿地下室的扒手胡言乱语，说自己在国外见过沃尔特家族的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: However, no family member left the country due to the royal banquet. It was strange to hear that. I think that person could be ^0000cdKain^000000.
scripts.translation: 可是因为王室宴会，家族里没人出国。听起来确实蹊跷。我想那人可能是凯恩。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I wanted to investigate myself considering the importance of the matter. But Isenhonor ordered me to go back to Alberta so I had to come back here.
scripts.translation: 这事很重要，我本想亲自调查。可伊森霍纳命令我回艾尔贝塔，我只好回来了。

scripts.text: The pickpocket in the underground prison?
Yes. I don't know his real name, but he is called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 in the underworld.
scripts.translation: 对。我不知道他的真名，不过黑道上都叫他大脚怪。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Minor offenders like pickpockets are usually locked in this other place. But that guy was caught pickpocketing in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 扒手之类的小罪犯通常关在别处。不过那家伙是在阿鲁纳菲兹偷窃时被抓的。

scripts.text: Due to diplomatic issues, we have taken his custody and locked him in the underground prison.
scripts.translation: 因为外交方面的原因，我们接管了他，并把他关进地下监狱。

scripts.text: That guy seems to have a lot of information from all over the continent. Even when his words about seen the person of the Walther family wasn't true, I felt that I could get useful information from him.
scripts.translation: 那家伙似乎知道大陆各地不少事。即使他说见过沃尔特家族成员是假的，我也觉得能从他那里打听到有用的消息。

scripts.text: Whether the information he has is true or not, I would rather go visit him. Thank you for the information.
scripts.translation: 无论他的情报是真是假，我都想去见见他。谢谢你告诉我这些。

scripts.text: Please say hello to my master when you get back to the palace. Tell him that I will be guarding this place well.
scripts.translation: 回宫后请替我向主人问好。告诉他我会好好守着这里。

scripts.text: And, let him know that he can call me anytime. I would gladly go there to guard him.
scripts.translation: 也告诉他，随时都可以召我回去。我很乐意回去保护他。

scripts.text: Yes, I'll let him know for sure.
How did your visit to the prison go?
scripts.translation: 你去监狱探望得怎么样？

scripts.text: You can go see the convict called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 locked in the ^0000cdUnderground prison of the palace^000000.
scripts.translation: 你可以去见见被关在宫殿地下监狱的犯人大脚怪。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Didn't you hear anything else from Isenhonor? Please extend my greetings to him when you go to Prontera.
scripts.translation: 伊森霍纳没告诉你别的事吗？你去普隆德拉时，麻烦代我向他问好。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer! At last, Master Isenhonor called me! I am happy that I can guard my lord nearby.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者！主人伊森霍纳终于召我回去了！能在主人身边守护他，我太高兴了。

scripts.text: Glad to hear that. Then what are you doing here now?
scripts.translation: 那太好了。你现在在这里做什么？

scripts.text: I am waiting for the ship to Izlude. I will rush to the ship when it comes here.
scripts.translation: 我在等去依斯鲁得岛的船。船一来我就立刻上船。

scripts.text: I have a lot of questions for you, but I guess I'd better hear the story from my master. Then dear adventurer, have a safe trip!
scripts.translation: 我有很多事想问你，不过还是听主人亲口讲比较好。亲爱的冒险者，祝你一路顺风！

scripts.text: What if anything happens to my master while I am gone...
scripts.translation: 我离开期间，万一主人出了什么事...我

scripts.text: Shall I leave for Prontera now?
scripts.translation: 要现在就去普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text: No, he will be mad at me.
He will call me someday. Let's wait here.
scripts.translation: 总有一天会召我回去，就在这里等吧。

scripts.text: What a fine day. However, the house feels to empty and lonely.
scripts.translation: 今天天气真好。不过宅邸里空荡荡的，怪冷清。

scripts.text: Hello? Is this the manor of the Walther family?
scripts.translation: 你好，这里是沃尔特家族的宅邸吗？

scripts.text: Yes, it is. What brought you here. Since everyone has left for Prontera, you cannot meet the master now.
scripts.translation: 是的。请问您找谁？大家都去普隆德拉了，现在见不到主人。

scripts.text: Isenhonor has sent me here to meet the Guardian Knight.
scripts.translation: 伊森霍纳派我来找守护骑士。

scripts.text: Oh, really? He has been waiting for Isenhonor's call so much! I am happy for him.
scripts.translation: 哦，真的吗？他一直盼着伊森霍纳召他回去呢！真替他高兴。

scripts.text: Simon, the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor is near the ^0000cddock^000000 where the ship leaving for ^0000cdIzlude^000000 is anchored.
scripts.translation: 伊森霍纳的守护骑士西蒙就在码头附近，那里停着开往依斯鲁得岛的船。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He is waiting there to go to Prontera as soon as possible when Isenhonor calls him.
scripts.translation: 他正在那里等着，只要伊森霍纳一召唤，就马上动身去普隆德拉。

scripts.text: Go to where the ship to Izlude is anchored.
scripts.translation: 去停靠着依斯鲁得岛航船的码头找他吧。

scripts.text: Mahatra Mornen, the butler of the Alkish family, I cannot take his arrogance anymore.
scripts.translation: 阿尔基什家的管家玛哈特拉·莫伦，我真受不了他的傲慢。

scripts.text: They only own a manor. And they call themselves as the best family in Alberta? What do they think of the Walther family!
scripts.translation: 他们不过有一栋宅邸，竟敢自称是艾尔贝塔最好的家族？他们把沃尔特家族当什么了！

scripts.text: They cannot even make eye contact when they meet us.
scripts.translation: 他们见到我们时，连正眼都不敢瞧。

scripts.text: Our master is just too gentle to leave them alone. How classless.
scripts.translation: 主人就是太宽厚了，才会放过他们。真没教养。

scripts.text: Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
scripts.translation: 炸鸡、烤土豆、啤酒、新鲜奶酪...唉...被关在这种地方，我现在特别想吃这些平常菜。

scripts.text: I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation: 谁要是给我带来，我就娶谁。

scripts.text: Argh! Not again! I am terrified!
But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation: 了！不过被关在这里反而安全。

scripts.text: Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
scripts.translation: 炸鸡、烤土豆、啤酒、新鲜奶酪...唉...被关在这种地方，我现在特别想吃这些平常菜。

scripts.text: I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation: 谁要是给我带来，我就娶谁。

scripts.text: Argh! Not again! I am terrified! But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation: 啊！又来了！吓死我了！不过被关在这里反而安全。

scripts.text: Oh no! I won't eat that! I don't want to have another bite of that pigs feed! I may not be a gourmet, but my tongue hasn't been decomposed or anything!
scripts.translation: 不要！我才不吃那个！我再也不想吃猪食了！我虽然不是什么美食家，但舌头还没坏掉呢！

scripts.text: Bring me something I can eat! I know that I am locked in the prison, but I deserve to eat something edible!
scripts.translation: 给我带点能吃的东西来！我知道自己在坐牢，但也该吃点像样的东西吧！

scripts.text: There must have been a misunderstanding. I am not the warden here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你误会了，我不是狱卒，是专程来找你的。

scripts.text: You are now? I am relieved to hear that. The food here just sucks.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那我就放心了。这里的伙食实在太糟了。

scripts.text: Who are you by the way? You look like an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 对了，你是谁？看起来像个冒险者。

scripts.text: Well, it is not important. You are here to ask me something, right? You know nothing in this world is free.
scripts.translation: 算了，这不重要。你是来问我事情的吧？要知道，这世上可没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text: It would be beyond my ability.
scripts.translation: 这可超出我的能力范围了。

scripts.text: Don't be such a perfectionist. You must be of a high rank to come down here, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 别这么较真。能来这里的人，地位肯定不低吧？

scripts.text: Well, I understand. I knew it was a difficult favor to ask anyway.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我明白。本来就知道这请求很难答应。

scripts.text: I didn't think you would let me out. I just got it out loud.
scripts.translation: 我没指望你真能放我出去，刚才只是随口说说。

scripts.text: However, you turned it down so firmly. You could at least pretend to consider or think about it.
scripts.translation: 不过你拒绝得也太干脆了吧？至少装作考虑一下也好啊。

scripts.text: What do you really want then?
Money of course. The price depends on the information you want.
scripts.translation: 当然是钱。你想要什么情报，价格就不一样。

scripts.text: I don't offer a monthly installment plan. I only take cash. I only accept currencies older than 2 years. I'll spend it meaningfully when I get out here in the future.
scripts.translation: 我不接受分期付款，只收现金。而且只收两年以上的旧钞。等我哪天出去，再好好花掉。

scripts.text: I don't have much money, but I know where to spend it. I guess I should turn down the deal. Goodbye then.
scripts.translation: 我没多少钱，不过知道该把钱花在哪。看来这笔交易谈不成了，再见。

scripts.text: Hey! Don't take the joke too seriously. Don't your friends call you stubborn?
scripts.translation: 喂，别把玩笑当真啊！你朋友是不是都嫌你太固执？

scripts.text: I knew it. You give up too easily. You are still young, you know.
scripts.translation: 我就知道，你这么快就放弃了。你还年轻呢。

scripts.text: Well, you remind me of something...
scripts.translation: 嗯...你倒让我想起一件事...

scripts.text: Yes! Bring me fried spicy dumplings and green salad! That's right! Bring me that.
scripts.translation: 对了！给我带炸辣饺和蔬菜沙拉！没错，就要这个。

scripts.text: I cannot eat the horrible food here much so I keep thinking about the food out there.
scripts.translation: 这里的饭菜太难吃了，我吃不下，所以一直想着外面的美食。

scripts.text: What I crave the most is that. Would you do this for me at least? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation: 我最想吃的就是这个。至少这点小忙你能帮吧？三份炸辣饺和一份蔬菜沙拉！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can do that. Wait for me.
You don't have to tell me to wait. I cannot go anywhere.
scripts.translation: 不用叫我等，我又不能到处乱跑。

scripts.text: Wait, you stop there for a moment.
I don't smell the greasy dumplings and fresh salad at all.
scripts.translation: 完全没闻到炸辣饺和新鲜沙拉的香味。

scripts.text: Did you bring the food? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation: 你把食物带来了吗？三份炸辣饺和一份蔬菜沙拉！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I won't talk before you bring them to me! Check again and bring them!
scripts.translation: 你把食物带来之前，我什么都不会说！再检查一下，带过来！

scripts.text: I smell it! This smell! Take out what you have brought.
scripts.translation: 我闻到了！就是这个味道！把你带来的东西拿出来。

scripts.text: Oh, my love. I'll enjoy every bite of it. Well, ask me the question now.
scripts.translation: 啊，我的最爱！我要好好享用每一口。好了，问吧。

scripts.text: I heard that you saw a person of the Walther family in a foreign country. Where did you see him? How did you know that he was from the Walther family?
scripts.translation: 我听说你在国外见过沃尔特家族的人。你在哪里见到他的？又怎么知道他是沃尔特家的人？

scripts.text: Oh, you wanted to know that. As you know, it is rare to see seafarer Walthers in other places of Rune-Midgarts, except Alberta and Prontera.
scripts.translation: 哦，你想问这个啊。你也知道，除了艾尔贝塔和普隆德拉，在卢恩·米德加兹其他地方很少见到沃尔特

scripts.text: They are good at hiding their identities other than those who are well known.
scripts.translation: 家的航海商人。除了那些名人，他们都很会隐藏身份。

scripts.text: However, I saw the distinctive symbol of the family in ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation: 不过，我在维因斯看到了他们家族特有的徽记。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Veins? Who did you see there? And how?
scripts.translation: 维因斯？你在那里看到了谁？怎么发现的？

scripts.text: I don't know who he is. I was working as always. You know you have to work to make ends meet.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他是谁。我当时照常干活嘛。你也知道，人总得谋生。

scripts.text: You don't have to be so specific about it. Don't you want to hear the story? Well, don't worry. I do have a sense of honor. I'll keep my promise to you who has brought me the dumplings.
scripts.translation: 不用说得那么直白嘛。你还想不想听后面的事？放心，我还是讲信用的，会遵守对带炸辣饺给我的人的承诺。

scripts.text: Anyways, I found a shabby man who seemed so defenseless in the market there. His wallet was fat. So I took it and went off.
scripts.translation: 总之，我在市场上看到一个看起来毫无防备的寒酸男人。他的钱包鼓鼓的，我就顺手拿走了。

scripts.text: I opened the wallet in a secluded corner of the market. He turned out to be quite loaded. And I found an ^0000cdold letter^000000 in there. The one stamped with the ^0000cdseal^000000, you know.
scripts.translation: 我在市场偏僻的角落打开钱包，发现那人相当有钱，里面还放着一封旧信。就是盖着家族徽章的那种信。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The fact that he had the letter doesn't prove that he was a person from the Walther family.
scripts.translation: 光凭他有那封信，还不能证明他是沃尔特家族的人。

scripts.text: Hey, I am getting there. After checking what was in the wallet, I was going to call it a day. I had earned enough.
scripts.translation: 喂，我这就说到重点了。翻完钱包，我本来打算收工，因为已经赚够了。
就在那时，那个寒酸男人出现了。

scripts.text: I don't have to tell you the rest of the story, right? Whoa... I thought I was fighting three men at the same time. His fist was like...! Phew... When he was punching me, I saw it.
scripts.translation: 剩下的不用我多说了吧？天哪...我当时以为自己在同时对付三个人。他的拳头简直像...！呼...他揍我的时候，我看到了。

scripts.text: There was a hidden ^0000cdsword^000000 under his cloak. The ^0000cdhandle was engraved with the symbol^000000. You see, well. Do you believe my story now?
scripts.translation: 他的斗篷底下藏着一把剑，剑柄上刻着那个徽记。怎么样，现在相信我了吧？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: How did you manage to see that when you were beaten up so bad?
scripts.translation: 你都被打成那样了，是怎么看清的？

scripts.text: Oh, have some faith. Don't you know what I do for living?
scripts.translation: 喂，要有点信心啊。你不知道我是靠什么吃饭的吗？

scripts.text: Hey, don't be so specific, please!
Anyways, my profession required a sharp eye to catch whatever is significant at a glance. That's how I thrive in this field.
scripts.translation: 总之，这行得眼尖，一眼就要看出关键。靠这本事，我才能混下去。

scripts.text: When I see a person, I need to identify the position of the wallet, any weapon in possession, the target's wits and how fast the target can run in a moment. This job required such a special quality.
scripts.translation: 见到一个人，我得立刻判断他的钱包在哪、有没有武器、反应快不快、跑得有多快。干这行就得有这种本事。

scripts.text: You don't have to believe me, but you can trust my professional skill.
scripts.translation: 你不必相信我，但我的专业眼光可不会错。

scripts.text: Well, you must have hidden your money inside the belt and your shoes. Nice work. Those are tough spots to steal from.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你把钱藏在腰带和靴子里了吧？藏得不错，这些地方确实不好下手。

scripts.text: OK, I guess I can trust your skill.
Anyways, it sure seems suspicious. Thank you for your information.
scripts.translation: 总之，事情确实很可疑。谢谢你提供情报。

scripts.text: Don't you need anything else? I want to have some dessert now.
scripts.translation: 你不问别的了吗？我现在想吃点甜品。

scripts.text: What is it? Did you change your mind?
Do you want more information? I'd really like to have some Mastela Fruit Wine.
scripts.translation: 还想知道更多吗？我好想喝玛丝黛拉果酒。

scripts.text: Did you forget where to go?
Bring me some dessert when you come back!
scripts.translation: 回来的时候记得带点甜品！

scripts.text: You seem to carry a heavy burden.
Who are you? Why are you staring at me? Are you after my wallet too?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？为什么盯着我看？也想偷我钱

scripts.text: It hasn't been long since I sent a person who stole my wallet to the prison.
scripts.translation: 包吗？我才刚把偷钱包的人送进监狱。

scripts.text: I guess no such information is shared among the pickpockets. Get lost if you don't want to be sent to prison.
scripts.translation: 看来扒手之间也不会互通情报。要是不想进监狱，就赶紧滚。

scripts.text: You are quite quick-tempered, aren't you.
scripts.translation: 你脾气真暴躁。你就是凯

scripts.text: The one who betrayed his master.
Who... Who are you? Reveal yourself!
Why are you telling me such a thing?
People say that. I don't buy it though.
scripts.translation: 大家都这么说，但我不相信。

scripts.text: Why don't you believe it? Why? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不相信？为什么？你知道些什么？

scripts.text: You are the one who knows the truth, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation: 凯恩·沃尔特·沃克，知道真相的人是你。

scripts.text: Tell me. Who are you? Do you know anything about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation: 说吧，你是谁？你知道伊森阿姆之死的真相吗？

scripts.text: Your life depends on your answer. I have enough reason to kill you since you know who I am.
scripts.translation: 你的回答会决定你的生死。既然你知道我的身份，我有充分理由杀你。

scripts.text: Who are you? How did you find me? And what do you know about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation: 。你是谁？怎么找到我的？你知道伊森阿姆之死的什么内情？

scripts.text: I am asked to investigate the death of Isenarm by Isenhonor.
scripts.translation: 我受伊森霍纳所托，调查伊森阿姆的死因。

scripts.text: While carrying out the investigation, I got the information that you would be here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation: 调查时我打听到你在这里，所以特地来见你。

scripts.text: Isenhonor? At last, he is in action!
scripts.translation: 伊森霍纳？他终于开始行动了！

scripts.text: Oh, please excuse my bad manners. I am sorry. Please forgive my earlier behavior.
scripts.translation: 啊，刚才失礼了。对不起，请原谅我刚才的态度。

scripts.text: That's OK. It wouldn't hurt to be careful, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation: 没关系，小心一点也好，凯恩·沃尔特·沃克。

scripts.text: I cannot use the name, Walther, anymore.
scripts.translation: 我已经不能再用“沃尔特”这个姓

scripts.text: When a star disappears, its satellite shall lost its name too. Even worse, I am a sinner who haven't been able to my star.
scripts.translation: 了。星辰消失，追随它的卫星也会失去名字。更何况，我是个连自己的星辰都没能守护好的罪人。

scripts.text: Is Isenhonor investigating the death of Isenarm? I will do my best to help him by his side.
scripts.translation: 伊森霍纳在调查伊森阿姆之死？我愿尽全力协助他。

scripts.text: Not yet. Isenhonor wants to know the truth behind his brother's death, but he is not in the position to carry out the investigation due to the circumstances.
scripts.translation: 还没有。伊森霍纳想查明哥哥死亡的真相，但受到各种限制，无法亲自调查。

scripts.text: That's why I, who is relatively free to move around, am is doing the research for him.
scripts.translation: 所以由行动比较自由的我代他调查。

scripts.text: Is that so... Then what can I do to help you? I'll do whatever I can do to reveal the truth.
scripts.translation: 这样啊...那我能帮什么忙？只要能查明真相，我什么都愿意做。

scripts.text: You can tell me what happened when you were with Isenarm. Why you disappeared before Isenarm's death, why you are here and all.
scripts.translation: 告诉我你和伊森阿姆在一起时发生了什么。你为什么在他死前离开，又为什么会在这里，诸如此类。

scripts.text: In fact I know nothing about his death myself. However, he ^0000cdsent me here with a mission^000000 before incident broke out.
scripts.translation: 事实上，我也不知道他是怎么死的。不过，事发前他派我去执行一项任务。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: When I was going to go back after completing the mission, he sent me a lot of money and a ^0000cdletter^000000. It said ^0000cdnot to return to Rune-Midgarts^000000.
scripts.translation: 我完成任务准备回去时，他寄来一大笔钱和一封信。信上说不要回卢恩·米德加兹。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I heard the news of his death after few days. I wanted to go back, but I couldn't because of his last order. I couldn't even be there by his side...
scripts.translation: 几天后我听说他死了。我想回去，却不能违背他的遗命，甚至没能陪在他身边...

scripts.text: After a long time, I heard the rumor about the violent behavior which caused Isenarm to be killed.
scripts.translation: 过了很久，我才听说伊森阿姆因为突然暴走而被杀的传闻。

scripts.text: And also the story of the Guardian Knight who betrayed his master...
scripts.translation: 还有那个背叛主人的守护骑士的传闻...

scripts.text: When I became a wanted man, I wanted to back and tell the truth. However, the letter said ^0000cdnot to return no matter what^000000. I couldn't let down the last order given by my master.
scripts.translation: 我成了通缉犯后，也想回去说出真相。可是信上写着无论如何都不要回来。师父最后的命令，我不能违背。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I guess Isenarm didn't want you to be involved. If anything happened to him, you would have been the one in the biggest trouble.
scripts.translation: 我想伊森阿姆是不想让你卷入其中。万一他出了什么事，你也会惹上大麻烦。

scripts.text: Ha... Perhaps... I didn't think of that... Here are the ^0000cdletter and sword Isenarm^000000 has give me.
scripts.translation: 哈...也许吧...我之前没想到...这是伊森阿姆给我的信和剑。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please give them to Isenhonor. I hope they help him recover his brother's honor.
scripts.translation: 请把它们交给伊森霍纳。希望这能帮他恢复哥哥的名誉。

scripts.text: Keep the sword. The sword is like the life of the knight. I believe Isenarm would want you to have it.
scripts.translation: 剑就留给你吧。剑对骑士来说就像生命一样重要，我想伊森阿姆也希望你留下它。

scripts.text: Did you deliver the letter and the words to Isenhonor well?
scripts.translation: 你顺利把信和我的话转达给伊森霍纳了吗？

scripts.text: Please let him know that I am ready to devote my life if he needs my help.
scripts.translation: 请告诉他，只要他需要我，我随时愿意为他献出生命。

scripts.text: He is lying in bed, deeply wounded.
It doesn't seem that he is in the state to talk.
scripts.translation: 重。看起来他现在无法交谈。

scripts.text: How disrespectful of you to enter without permission.
scripts.translation: 未经允许就闯进来，太无礼了。

scripts.text: Why don't you enjoy the banquet?
Nyhill went to the Banquet Hall too.
He didn't make a good first impression, but he is not a bad kid...
scripts.translation: 尼希尔给人的第一印象不太好，但他不是坏孩子...他

scripts.text: Well, I guess I shouldn't talk more.
The archduke has been waiting for you.
Nillem said he would visit your room after making all preparations. You may wait in your room.
scripts.translation: 尼勒姆说，一切准备好后会去你房间找你。你可以先回房等候

scripts.text: I have heard the story from my father.
I have received the approval for you to access the Past Memories of the Royal Family freely.
scripts.translation: 了。我已经批准你自由出入王室的过去记忆。

scripts.text: Let's talk about the Past Memories of the Royal Family tomorrow
scripts.translation: 王室过去记忆的事，我们明天再谈吧。

scripts.text: Since you must be tired going through all the trouble today.
scripts.translation: 你今天经历了这么多，想必很累了。

scripts.text: Are you going back to that place?
That it is difficult for him to connect multiple times since he is just a human after all.
scripts.translation: 毕竟他只是个普通人，很难一次又一次地连接多个次元。

scripts.text: I appreciate your efforts for the royal family.
But don't push yourself too hard.
You are here, just in time.
Are you going there again today?
...Oh, do you know what Nyhill is doing?
scripts.translation: 了。...对了，你知道尼希尔在做什么吗？

scripts.text: He must be staying quietly since he has been sentenced to disciplinary confinement.
scripts.translation: 了。他既然被判了禁闭，应该正乖乖待着吧。

scripts.text: I hope it works this time.
Please save the piece of Ymir Heart from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation: 请从瓦尔基里手中夺回伊米尔之心碎片。

scripts.text: ...I know it is almost impossible to change the past.
scripts.translation: ...我知道改变过去几乎不可能。

scripts.text: But there is no other way.
We need to try everything we can do.
scripts.translation: 能尝试的办法，我们都得试一遍。

scripts.text: While you are on a mission down there, we are proceeding with the investigation.
scripts.translation: 你在下面执行任务时，我们也会继续调查。

scripts.text: We are searching for the lead to the intruders.
scripts.translation: 我们正在寻找入侵者的线索。大家都

scripts.text: Nillem must be waiting for you.
Please do your best as always.
Is it the same this time?
But, I really don't think all the efforts will go wasted.
scripts.translation: 想也是。不过，我不认为所有努力都会白费。

scripts.text: Someday, when you need the power of our family,
scripts.translation: 来你需要海尔内家族的力量时，无论发

scripts.text: We will be on your side no matter what.
scripts.translation: 生什么，我们都会站在你这边。

scripts.text: That is all we can give you for now as the reward.
scripts.translation: 目前我们只能给你这些作为

scripts.text: I am sorry that we cannot offer you more.
I'll make sure there is no inconvenience to you while living in the palace.
scripts.translation: 更多。我会确保你在宫里生活得舒适。

scripts.text: You must be the returned hero invited to the banquet.
scripts.translation: 您一定是受邀参加宴会的那位归来英雄。这场

scripts.text: This banquet is for you. Please enjoy.
scripts.translation: 宴会是为您举办的，请尽情享用。

scripts.text: Haha... The archduke must be very angry.
scripts.translation: 哈哈...大公一定很生气吧。

scripts.text: I have participated in the Royal Assembly, but I wonder if it has been the right decision.
scripts.translation: 我参加了王室集会，但不确定这是否是正确的决定。

scripts.text: I tried to do this for everyone, but it seems to cause trouble.
scripts.translation: 我本想为大家做些事，没想到反而惹了麻烦。

scripts.text: People tells me that I am a strong candidate in this, but I cannot be so sure.
scripts.translation: 大家都说我是有力的候选人，可我自己并没有把握。

scripts.text: I keep thinking about what a great responsibility it is, how harder I should try and all...
scripts.translation: 我一直在想，这责任有多重大，我还得多努力才能胜任...

scripts.text: Not that I can step back now. I guess all I can do is to do my best.
scripts.translation: 不过现在也不能退缩了。我想只能尽力而为。

scripts.text: I have never allowed your visit.
...It was a shame to cause such a scene
I apologize on the behalf of the Heine family.
scripts.translation: 。我代表海尔内家族向您道歉。

scripts.text: I am the current head of the Heine family, Friedrich Stoltze Heine.
scripts.translation: 是海尔内家族现任家主，弗里德里希·施托尔策·海尔内。

scripts.text: This is the former head of the family, Archduke Grantz, my father.
scripts.translation: 这位是家族前任家主、我的父亲格兰茨大公。

scripts.text: My name is Kronecker Grantz Heine.
scripts.translation: 我叫克罗内克·格兰茨·海尔内。

scripts.text: This is Peter Heine the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation: 这位是海尔内家的彼得，王位候选人。

scripts.text: It has turned out this way.
The one who has left the room, making a fool of himself, is my son, Nyhill.
scripts.translation: 刚才出丑离席的是我的儿子尼希尔。

scripts.text: He is a lineal family member of the Heine family.
scripts.translation: 他是海尔内家族的直系成员。

scripts.text: But he still acts like a child like that.
scripts.translation: 但还像个孩子似的胡闹。

scripts.text: Let him do whatever he pleases.
We cannot take care of him anymore.
...Archduke, please don't be too harsh on Nyhill.
In fact, Nyhill was supposed to be the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation: 。其实原本该由尼希尔成为王位候选人。

scripts.text: I am just a collateral member of the family after all...
scripts.translation: 毕竟我只是家族的旁支...

scripts.text: Stop it there. There is no need for more words.
Nyhill doesn't have what it takes to be the king.
scripts.translation: 希尔没有当国王的资质。

scripts.text: He doesn't have any elements to meet the legitimacy of the family. He cannot be chosen as the candidate.
scripts.translation: 他不具备海尔内家族继承正统性的条件，不能成为候选人。

scripts.text: He doesn't even know where he stands but still seems so hungry for power.
scripts.translation: 他连自己的身份都认不清，却还渴望权力。

scripts.text: He must have been disheartened since his right has been neglected.
scripts.translation: ...自己的权利被忽视，他一定很受打击。

scripts.text: The right of the Heine family is everything which comes with the name of Heine.
scripts.translation: 海尔内家族的权利，伴随着海尔内之名而来。尼希

scripts.text: Why doesn't that child realize it?
It is not appropriate to talk about the family matter in front of the guest.
scripts.translation: 不明白？在客人面前谈家事不合适。

scripts.text: Phew... I wonder what we have done to deserve a punk like that in the family.
scripts.translation: ...我们到底造了什么孽，家里才会有这种朽魔。

scripts.text: I have heard that you are the one who would attend the ritual.
scripts.translation: 听说你会出席仪式。说不定下一任

scripts.text: Gratefully enough, the next king might be from the Heine family.
scripts.translation: 国王就会出自海尔内家族，真是万幸。

scripts.text: In the Royal Assembly earlier in which the candidates for the throne were tested...
scripts.translation: 在之前的王室集会上，王位候选人接受了考验...

scripts.text: Isenarm of the Walther family who happened to be the strongest candidate of all threatened other candidates all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 瓦尔特家族的伊森阿姆原本是最有力的候选人，却突然威胁其他候选人。格博

scripts.text: Ernst of the Geoborg family had to execute him.
scripts.translation: 格家的恩斯特只好将他处决。

scripts.text: It seemed that Ernst was going to be named the next king, but he abruptly resigned.
scripts.translation: 恩斯特本来要成为下一任国王，却突然退位了。...

scripts.text: ...I guess he obeyed the will of the queen.
scripts.translation: 我想他是遵从了女王的意愿。

scripts.text: Due to the course of events, the Royal Assembly would be held again.
scripts.translation: 因此，王室集会将再次举行。

scripts.text: This time, Peter will participate as the representative of the Heine family.
scripts.translation: 这次由彼得代表海尔内家族参加。

scripts.text: And that Nyhill is so jealous of him now.
Hum... He actually is not a bad kid unlike his earlier words.
scripts.translation: 嗯...他其实不是坏孩子，不像他说话时那样

scripts.text: He has never acted to bring disgrace to the name of Heine.
scripts.translation: 。他从没做过有损海尔内家族名誉的事。

scripts.text: I am not trying to defend him because he is my son.
scripts.translation: 我不是因为他是我儿子才替他说话。尼

scripts.text: Don't try to speak for him. His incompetence is a sin.
scripts.translation: 别替他辩解。他的无能就是罪过。强大

scripts.text: Great magical power runs in the Heine for generations.
scripts.translation: 的魔力世代流淌在海尔内家族的血脉中。

scripts.text: There is a reason that he is called Mijeria.
scripts.translation: 他被称作“米杰莉亚”是有原因的。

scripts.text: Don't be overly curious of our family matter.
scripts.translation: 别太好奇我们家族的事。

scripts.text: Phew... I guess I will see you again later.
The Royal Assembly will be over soon, and the ritual will be carried out when the final decision is made.
scripts.translation: 王室集会很快就会结束，最终决定作出后便会举行仪式。在那之前，

scripts.text: Enjoy the banquet until then and participate in the ritual.
scripts.translation: 请尽情参加宴会，到时也请出席仪式。

scripts.text: It wouldn't long before Royal Assembly is over.
scripts.translation: 王室集会很快就要结束了。

scripts.text: We have to prepare for it. Sorry that we cannot spend more time with you.
scripts.translation: 我们得去做准备。抱歉不能再多陪你。

scripts.text: Go visit other families if you have not visited them all.
scripts.translation: 如果你还没拜访完其他家族，不妨去看看。

scripts.text: The Royal Assembly will be over soon.
As we expected, Peter seems to be a strong candidate.
scripts.translation: 来彼得确实是个很有力的候选人。

scripts.text: How are you enjoying the banquet?
As soon as the Royal Assembly is completed, we will move to proceed with the final ritual...
scripts.translation: 王室集会一结束，我们就要开始最后的仪式...

scripts.text: I'll send you a Court Mage.
scripts.translation: 我会派宫廷魔法师去找

scripts.text: Enjoy the banquet and go back to your room in time.
scripts.translation: 您。请尽情享用宴会，记得按时回房间。

scripts.text: I have been waiting for you.
Although I feel reluctant to reveal somewhat embarrassing part of the royal family to you,
scripts.translation: 虽然不太愿意让您知道王室这些不光彩的往事，

scripts.text: It was the royal family of Rune-Midgarts who let you observe the ritual anyway.
scripts.translation: 但毕竟是卢恩·米德加兹王室邀请您来观礼的。

scripts.text: And you were the one who fought the intruders during the incident...
scripts.translation: 而且事发时，也是您击退了入侵者...

scripts.text: Those intruders must have been after the^4d4dff piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation: 些入侵者一定是冲着伊米尔之心碎片来的。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: We didn't know what was in the Room of Consciousness was ^4d4dffa fake piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation: 我们不知道意识之室里的是假的伊米尔之心。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: We searched through the records of ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 for the record of that part.
scripts.translation: 我们查阅了王室的过去记忆，试图找到相关记录。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: The only lead we got was a riddle.
scripts.translation: 唯一的线索只是个谜题。

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说，只有知晓真相的人才能读懂？

scripts.text: You must have seen it in the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
scripts.translation: 您一定是在王室的过去记忆中看到了那句话

scripts.text: You are more cunning than I have thought of you.
What should we do to find out the truth?
We would have to go back in the time to the past.
I found a Court Mage who specialized in that field.
scripts.translation: 我找到了一位精通这方面的宫廷魔法师。

scripts.text: He said that ^4d4dffhe sensed a huge twist of magical force in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, and we could depend on him^000000.
scripts.translation: 他说自己在王室的过去记忆中感受到了巨大的魔力扭曲，让我们尽管交给他。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: He will bring the result soon.
He said he would connect the crack of the dimension by force.
scripts.translation: 果。他说要强行接上次元裂隙。

scripts.text: He acts rather imprudently, but he is said to be quite skilled...
scripts.translation: 他做事虽然鲁莽，但听说本领很高...而且

scripts.text: You seem to know him too.
I want you to pair up with Nillem for this mission.
scripts.translation: 这次任务我希望您能和尼勒姆搭档。

scripts.text: That Nillem pestered me to let him work with you.
scripts.translation: 勒姆缠着我，非要和您搭档。...

scripts.text: ...I tried my best not to slay him.
scripts.translation: 我已经尽力忍住没杀他了。

scripts.text: The Past Memories of the Royal Family is a special place which can be accessed by the royal families and few other people.
scripts.translation: 王室的过去记忆是个特殊的地方，只有王族和少数人能进入。为

scripts.text: We cannot risk getting more people involved in this to keep the secret.
scripts.translation: 了保守秘密，我们不能让更多人卷入。

scripts.text: Sine you have already experienced the crack of dimension...
scripts.translation: 既然您之前经历过次元裂隙...

scripts.text: We didn't have any other choices.
We will reward you handsomely. Please help us out.
scripts.translation: 们会给您丰厚的报酬，拜托了。

scripts.text: We will send Nillem to your room as soon as he is ready.
scripts.translation: 了。尼勒姆准备好后会去您的房间找您。

scripts.text: You may pair up with him for the mission.
scripts.translation: 这次任务就由你们搭档完成。

scripts.text: And this is what has been given to the ones contributed to the royal family.
scripts.translation: 这是给为王室出过力之人的奖励。您

scripts.text: You have received it once when you went down there right after you came to the palace. Do you remember?
scripts.translation: 刚来宫殿时下去过一次，那时也领过，还记得吗？

scripts.text: It must be useful to people like you.
scripts.translation: 这东西对您应该有用。希望

scripts.text: The magician called Nillem will find you.
You may wait in your room.
It is too early to lose our hope.
I believe you will do just fine.
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
scripts.translation: 你行李很多啊，没问题吗？看

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large.
The Roegenburg welcomes adventurers with various experiences, but it is somewhat early for us to work with you.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡欢迎经验丰富的冒险者，不过现在还不是与您合作的时候。

scripts.text: I hope I will see you later.
How could you come in here?
Nobody can come into this place if you are not a staff. Please go outside.
scripts.translation: ？非工作人员不得进入，请出去。

scripts.text: Hello, adventurers. I am honored you have visited the ^0000cdRoegenburg^000000. I am ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation: 你好，冒险者。欢迎造访罗根堡。我是马克西米利安·罗根堡。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We are one of seven royal families that found the kingdom and have work hard for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 我们是建立王国的七大王族之一，一直为卢恩·米德加兹王国效力。

scripts.text: ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, the heir of our family, is supposed to participate in the royal assembly. How about seeing him?
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特·罗根堡是我们家的继承人，也会参加王室集会。要见见他吗？ ^0000cd^000000
你好，我是赫尔穆特·罗根堡。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hello, I'm invited to this banquet. {0} It is nice to see you.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是受邀来参加宴会的。{0}，很高兴见到你。

scripts.text: I am honored to see the hero who defeated Morocc. Please enjoy your time while you are in the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 见到击败梦罗克的英雄，我深感荣幸。您在罗根堡期间，请尽情享受。

scripts.text: If you have time, how about seeing the rest people of the Roegenburg?
scripts.translation: 有时间的话，要不要见见罗根堡家族的其他人？

scripts.text: Brother, it will be helpful to listen to the story of the family from ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，听沃尔夫·罗根堡讲讲家族的事，应该会对你有帮助。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes, it is a good opportunity, of course.
scripts.translation: 好啊，这确实是个好机会。

scripts.text: Did you see the children of the Roegenburg? They look like babies, but now when I see them in the palace, I am pleased that they are almost grown up.
scripts.translation: 您见过罗根堡家的孩子们了吗？他们看起来还小。不过现在在宫里见到他们，发现都长大了，我很欣慰。

scripts.text: You met Helmut already. It will be helpful to you if you meet the second son, Wolf.
scripts.translation: 您已经见过赫尔穆特了。再见见二儿子沃尔夫，对您也会有帮助。

scripts.text: He is in charge of all matters of the Roegenburg instead of the first son who is busy for participation in the royal assembly and protection of the border. You will hear lots of interesting stories.
scripts.translation: 大儿子忙着参加王室集会、保卫边境，所以家族事务都由他处理。你们会聊到不少有趣的事。

scripts.text: The Roegenburg is proud that we are descents of Wilhelm, the national hero, and contributed to the foundation and development of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡家族是民族英雄威廉的后裔，为卢恩·米德加兹王国的建立与发展出过力，我们深以为荣。

scripts.text: Therefore, we hoped that the children could grow into decent adults, but they were raised without their parents' care and now they tend to behave rudely and act as they want.
scripts.translation: 我们本希望孩子们能成长为体面的人，可惜他们从小缺少父母照顾，现在行事粗鲁、任性妄为。

scripts.text: If you feel uncomfortable when you talk with them, please understand kindly.
scripts.translation: 如果和他们交谈时觉得不自在，还请多包涵。

scripts.text: They are the children who will lead the family, but they are going different from what the Roegenburg aims for.
scripts.translation: 他们将来要领导家族，却走上了与罗根堡理想相反的道路。

scripts.text: The first son stays on the front, risking his life everyday and the second is doing business, which is against the family tradition.
scripts.translation: 大儿子每天冒着生命危险留在前线，二儿子却去经商，这与家族传统背道而驰。

scripts.text: The third son would leave the house and hang out on the back street, but we cannot continue to employ some to monitor him all the times.
scripts.translation: 三儿子离家出走，在后街游荡。我们也不能一直派人盯着他。

scripts.text: But the youngest, Agnes, has grown as good girl and I am happy when I think of her.
scripts.translation: 不过，小女儿阿格妮丝已经长成了懂事的好孩子。想到她我就很欣慰。

scripts.text: Ah, I am sorry to talk too much on our family. I have become talkative as I get old.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉说了这么多家族的事。年纪大了，话也变多了。

scripts.text: Please forgive me grumbling and forget this old man's complaints.
scripts.translation: 请原谅我发牢骚，别把这个老头的话放在心上。

scripts.text: I cannot believe that Myer did that.
scripts.translation: ..我不敢相信迈尔会做出这种事。

scripts.text: He spread the bad rumor about the family but I think he did it because he is desperate.
scripts.translation: 他散布了家族的坏话，不过我想他也是走投无路才这么做的。

scripts.text: I have let the children do as they want but I wanted to avoid a war.
scripts.translation: 我曾放任孩子们随心所欲，只希望能避免战争。

scripts.text: But I know it is unlikely that Helmut becomes a king and so leave them to do as they like.
scripts.translation: 但我知道赫尔穆特当上国王的希望不大，所以就由着他们去了。

scripts.text: However, I would like to leverage this opportunity to collect the capabilities of the family members to protect the family.
scripts.translation: 不过，我想借此机会集结家族成员的力量，保护家族。

scripts.text: Opportunities are found in times of crisis.
Please bring Helmut. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
scripts.translation: 请把赫尔穆特带来。他应该在靠近修瓦尔兹巴尔德边境的检查哨，负责巡逻队。拜 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Welcome adventurer. Did you have a safe travel?
scripts.translation: 欢迎，冒险者。旅途还顺利吗？

scripts.text: I cannot see Helmut. Did he refuse to come?
scripts.translation: 我没看到赫尔穆特。他不肯来吗？

scripts.text: Yes, he left a message for two of you.
scripts.translation: 是的，他给你们两位留了话。

scripts.text: [Told Maximilian and Wolf about Helmut's will and the successorship]
scripts.translation: [我把赫尔穆特的心愿和继承权一事告诉了马克西米利安和沃尔夫。]

scripts.text: I knew something when Helmut left, but I didn't expect that he would give up the successorship.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特离开时，我就隐约察觉到了，但没想到他会放弃继承权。

scripts.text: But if that is what Helmut wants, I don't object to it.
scripts.translation: 不过既然这是他的意愿，我不会反对。

scripts.text: This fact will be announced as soon as the royal assembly and banquet are finished. Wolf, now you should lead our family. I hope this will not be a burden to you.
scripts.translation: 等王室集会和宴会结束，我们就会公布此事。沃尔夫，以后家族就由你来带领了。希望这不会成为你的负担。

scripts.text: You have taken a firm attitude that you never showed before.
scripts.translation: 你刚才表现得很坚定，和平时不太一样。

scripts.text: Once I tried to move the children as I want and failed. Since then I left them to do as they like. But now I know.
scripts.translation: 我曾试图让孩子们按我的想法行事，却失败了。从那以后，我便放手让他们自己做主。但现在我明白了。

scripts.text: I realized that a new age needs children. I will work for the family and country in the way the children wants to do.
scripts.translation: 我明白新时代需要年轻人。我会用他们自己的方式，为家族和国家效力。

scripts.text: I seem to have forced my way to Helmut and people in the family.
scripts.translation: 我好像一直在勉强赫尔穆特，也给家里人添了不少压力。

scripts.text: There is something rather than a war to have influence up to every corner in the continent.
scripts.translation: 除了战争，还有别的方式能让影响力遍及整片大陆。

scripts.text: As Myer said, I am looking for other approaches and I will.
scripts.translation: 正如迈尔所说，我会继续寻找别的出路。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, if you don't mind, won't you deliver my will to ^0000cdMyer^000000?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，如果方便的话，能替我把心意转达给迈尔吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That I have given up wars and am looking for better solution and that if he can, visit the family and see the people.
scripts.translation: 告诉他我已经放弃战争，正在寻找更好的解决办法。如果他愿意，欢迎来家里看看大家。

scripts.text: I am willing to do so.
Please deliver the story of Helmut to Myer.
scripts.translation: 请把赫尔穆特的消息转达给迈尔。

scripts.text: He must be somewhere in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 他应该在普隆德拉某处。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you deliver the message to Myer? what did he say?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你把话转达给迈尔了吗？他怎么说？

scripts.text: He said it is good to give up wars. Myer has a lot of trust in you. He said he would help you as much as he can, if you need his help.
scripts.translation: 转达了...中间虽然发生了些事，不过结果还不错。

scripts.text: I want him to visit us more than to help me.
scripts.translation: 比起帮我，我更希望他能常来家里看看。

scripts.text: Ah, he also said he would come after the banquet is finished.
scripts.translation: 啊，他还说宴会结束后就会过来。

scripts.text: Well I am happy that our relationship will improve.
scripts.translation: 太好了，我很高兴我们的关系能有所改善。

scripts.text: Once, we were the closest friends, but the relationship became awkward after he left the family.
scripts.translation: 曾经，我们是最好的朋友，但在他离开家族后，关系就变得尴尬了。

scripts.text: Anyway, I think we have to make preparation to welcome him seriously.
scripts.translation: 总之，我们得认真准备，正式迎接他回来。

scripts.text: I am glad that now everything has found its place. I have been worried a lot.
scripts.translation: 看到事情都已各归其位，我很高兴。我之前一直很担心。

scripts.text: All theses things are thanks to you. I feel safe now that everyone has their right places and will work hard for the family and country.
scripts.translation: 这一切都多亏了您。如今大家各司其职，都愿意为家族和国家尽力，我总算安心了。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. Thank you very much for helping my family. I have been thinking how I can reward you for your contribution, but cannot find anything that is comparable to the magnitude of thank.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，非常感谢你帮助我的家族。我一直想报答你的付出，却想不出什么礼物能回报这份恩情。

scripts.text: However at least to express my mind, I have prepare a small present. Please take it.
scripts.translation: 不过，为了表达我的心意，我准备了一份小礼物。请收下。

scripts.text: If you need a help from the Roegenburg, come to use anytime. The gate of the Roegenburg is always opened to you.
scripts.translation: 如果你需要罗根伯格家族的帮助，随时来找我们。罗根伯格家族的大门永远为你敞开。

scripts.text: I wanted to thank you always. Thanks to your contribution, my family is returning to safety.
scripts.translation: 迎。我一直想向你道谢。多亏了你的帮助，我的家族正在恢复安宁。

scripts.text: It seems that my family had no problem, but inside the wall, we didn't have trust in one another and were not mixed.
scripts.translation: 表面上看，我的家族似乎没什么问题，但家族内部彼此缺乏信任，也未能融洽相处。

scripts.text: But now we are getting along. Thank you very much again.
scripts.translation: 但现在我们相处得很好。再次非常感谢你。

scripts.text: Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你好像带了很多行李。要不要清理一些？

scripts.text: Did you visit to see my grandfather?
If so, he is over there. You can find him there.

scripts.text: If you don't, make sure to see Wolf and have talk with him.
scripts.translation: 吗？如果还没见到，一定要去找狼聊聊。

scripts.text: Nowadays, he shares many works with my grandfather and he has a lot to talk with you.
scripts.translation: 最近，他和祖父一起处理了许多事务，也有很多话想跟你说。

scripts.text: So the time for me to talk with him is quite reduced though.
scripts.translation: 这样一来，我能和他说话的时间就少多了。

scripts.text: The banquet has started but I haven't yet found any body who I go with.
scripts.translation: 宴会已经开始了，可我还没找到舞伴。原

scripts.text: Originally Wolf is supposed to go with me, but it is canceled as he became busy.
scripts.translation: 本狼说要陪我去，但他临时忙起来，只好作罢。

scripts.text: If he had told me earlier he cannot go, I wouldn't have refused all those proposals.
scripts.translation: 如果他早点告诉我不能陪我去，我就不会拒绝其他人的邀请了。

scripts.text: Myer said he would go with me, but I am afraid he may leave as wind anytime.
scripts.translation: 迈尔说愿意陪我去，可我担心他随时会像风一样溜走。
我不求什么盛大的场面..

scripts.text: When we were young, we played together. They read me books.
scripts.translation: .小时候，我们总在一起玩，哥哥们还会给我读书。

scripts.text: I still like the best the books that my brothers read me.
scripts.translation: 我最喜欢哥哥们读给我的那些书。

scripts.text: Those princes and princesses in those books were all my friend.
scripts.translation: 书里的王子和公主，都是我的朋友。

scripts.text: Recently I read a story on a knight who sacrifices himself for a lady.
scripts.translation: 最近读到一个故事，讲一位骑士为一位女士牺牲自己

scripts.text: In the story, the lady handed a pretty handkerchief to the knight.
scripts.translation: 。故事里，女士把一条漂亮的手帕交给骑士。

scripts.text: Then, I realized that what I had lacked.
scripts.translation: 然后我才意识到自己缺少什么

scripts.text: So I carry lots of pretty handkerchiefs so that I can hand them to my knight anytime.
scripts.translation: 所以我随身带着许多漂亮的手帕，随时准备递给我的骑士。

scripts.text: But there is no one for me to hand my handkerchiefs to...
scripts.translation: 可我却没有可以送手帕的骑士...

scripts.text: He is so handsome. I wonder what family he is from.
scripts.translation: 他长得真帅。不知道他来自哪个家族

scripts.text: I am sorry that I left so early that I couldn't talk with him at all. I asked Myer who he is, but he didn't tell me.
scripts.translation: 。真遗憾，我走得太早，完全没能和他说上话。我问迈尔他是谁，可他没告诉我。

scripts.text: Wolf is looking for you. Do you have an appointment with him?
scripts.translation: 险者？狼在找你。你和他有约吗？

scripts.text: He is my brother, but he and other brothers are so childish.
scripts.translation: 他是我哥哥，但他和其他哥哥们都很孩子气。

scripts.text: Go out to the street in Prontera and ask 5-year old children, even they know the answer.
scripts.translation: 去普隆德拉的街上问问吧，就连五岁的小孩都知道答案。

scripts.text: They are overlooking something bigger due to their personal desires. Of course, I also hate them and want to take revenge, but it does not solve the problem.
scripts.translation: 他们只顾个人欲望，忽略了更重要的事。当然，我也讨厌他们，想要报复，但那解决不了问题。

scripts.text: If they had thought about how the citizens of the kingdom can live more happily, they would not have acted like that.
scripts.translation: 如果他们能想想如何让王国的市民生活得更幸福，就不会那样做了。

scripts.text: Anyway, let's wait and see, as they are trying to think like adults.
scripts.translation: 总之，先等等看吧，毕竟他们也在试着像大人一样思考。

scripts.text: But I feel safe that my grandfather stays with me.
scripts.translation: 但祖父陪在我身边，让我感到安心。

scripts.text: You seem to have come to see my brothers? but there is no one in the house.
scripts.translation: 你好像是来看我哥哥们的？但家里没人。

scripts.text: In a long time, we were together, but they left and I am lonely again. It is nice that they don't fight one another any more.
scripts.translation: 过了很久，我们才又团聚，可他们一离开，我又孤单起来。至少他们现在不再彼此争斗了。
