scripts.translation: 我的意思是，我原本以为会和迈尔一起去，所以特意挑选并准备了一条裙子。但现在舞伴换了，我必须根据新舞伴的情况重新准备。

scripts.text: I expected you would agree as a woman like me.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你也会像我一样赞同呢。

scripts.text: There are so many things I have to consider, such as his hair color, eye color, clothes color and shape. I asked Myer about him, but he didn't tell me.
scripts.translation: 我需要考虑的事情太多了，比如他的发色、瞳色、衣服的颜色和款式。我问过迈尔，但他没告诉我。

scripts.text: Once he visits, it will be late. So I have to finish preparation in advance, regardless of how he wears.
scripts.translation: 等他来的时候就太晚了。所以无论他穿什么，我都必须提前做好准备。

scripts.text: To prepare for different situations, such as hair colors and clothes color, I need ^0000cdlots of dresses^000000. Do you understand what I mean?
scripts.translation: 为了应对不同的情况，比如不同的发色和衣服颜色，我需要大量的裙子。你明白我的意思吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Therefore, I told my grandfather that I want to have some more dresses to prepare for all situations, but he said that what I have now is enough. Does it make sense?
scripts.translation: 所以，我告诉祖父我想多准备几套裙子以应对各种情况，但他说我现在的衣服已经够多了。这说得通吗？

scripts.text: You are beautiful enough with the clothes you are wearing now.
scripts.translation: 你穿着现在的衣服就已经足够美丽了。

scripts.text: I talked with Wolf too but He said the same thing as grandfather. I should ask somebody to do me a favor unless he doesn't listen to me.
scripts.translation: 我也问过狼，可他说的和祖父一样。既然他们都不肯听我说，我只好找别人帮忙了。

scripts.text: So I talked with Myer. He told me to talk with you. He also said that if you cannot get a dress, buy the materials and make one. He said that is how they on the street.
scripts.translation: 于是我去找迈尔商量。他让我来找你，还说要是买不到裙子，就买材料自己做。他说街上的人都这么做。

scripts.text: So I hired very skillful person who can make a dress and accessories, but the key is materials. I guess that you are very experienced and can get what I need.
scripts.translation: 所以我雇了一位手艺很好的裁缝来做裙子和配饰，可关键是材料。我想你经验丰富，一定能帮我弄到需要的东西。

scripts.text: If I go out to get a dress, I may be the first princess in Rune-Midgarts who dies for a dress. So would you please save me from this situation?
scripts.translation: 要是我亲自出去买裙子，恐怕会成为卢恩·米德加兹王国第一位为买裙子而丧命的公主。所以，你能救我脱离这个困境吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I'll do my best to help you.
You need cloth, accessories and dyes don't you?
scripts.translation: 需要布料、配饰和染料，对吧？

scripts.text: You understand me very well! I like you very much.
scripts.translation: ！你非常懂我！我很喜欢和你相处。

scripts.text: Can you be my friend. I have wanted a woman who understands me very much.
scripts.translation: 你能做我的朋友吗？我一直渴望有一位非常懂我的女性朋友。

scripts.text: Of course. What do you want?
Hmm.. how can I help you?
Of course, you will get cloth, accessories and dyes!
scripts.translation: 当然，你会弄到布料、配饰和染料的！

scripts.text: Then which kind do you want?
There is an accessory I really want to have, but it is so rare that I couldn't get it.
scripts.translation: 有一件配饰我真的很想要，但它太罕见了，我根本买不到。

scripts.text: Can you get it for me?...
it is a ^0000cdpearl^000000! elegant and gentle gloss! Valuable jewel coming from pains!
scripts.translation: 那就是珍珠！光泽优雅而柔和！这是凝聚贝类辛劳的珍贵宝石！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I would like to use pearls to make a necklace and bracelet. You can get pearls from monsters. Can you get them for me?
scripts.translation: 我想用珍珠做项链和手链。击败魔物就能得到珍珠。你能帮我找一些吗？

scripts.text: I think it will be difficult to get pearls. It is really difficult. It is beyond my ability. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我觉得弄到珍珠会很困难。真的很难。这超出了我的能力范围。很抱歉。

scripts.text: Yes... I know it will be very difficult. If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation: 是的...我知道这非常困难。如果你改变主意了，请回来找我。

scripts.text: Thank god. I was afraid that you would refuse it.
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地。我还以为你会拒绝我呢。

scripts.text: I carry this to the banquet whatever I wear. And can ask you do me a favor one more?
scripts.translation: 不管穿什么，我都会戴着它去参加宴会。还有件事，能再请你帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: To produce good cloth, good threads are necessary. To extract good threads, ^0000cdsoft hair^000000 is the best. Would you get soft fur for me too?
scripts.translation: 要织出好布料，就得先有优质的线。要纺出好线，最适合的就是柔软的毛发。你也能帮我找些来吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I think ^0000cd3 {0} ^000000are enough and 50 strands of {1}^0000cdare required^000000.
The success of my banquet is in your hands. I will do my best to make it one of the best ever.
scripts.translation: 我宴会的成败就掌握在你手中了。我会尽我所能，让它成为有史以来最棒的宴会之一。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你在这里做什么？你

scripts.text: Did you come for my dress?
But I'm still making the dress using what you got for me.
scripts.translation: 但我还在用你帮我弄到的材料做衣服。做

scripts.text: I'll decide what to make next after completing this.
scripts.translation: 完这件之后，我再决定接下来做什么。

scripts.text: Thank you for visiting but I am sorry that I cannot help you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的光临，但很抱歉我现在帮不了你。

scripts.text: Would you come back later in the afternoon?
scripts.translation: 你下午晚些时候再来好吗？

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. Thanks for coming. I thought all day of what dress to make. I cannot decide still.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你来。我整天都在琢磨该做什么裙子，可到现在还是拿不定主意。

scripts.text: A golden dress shining brighter than the sun? Or a sliver dress shining more gentile than the moon? Or a dress greener than tree leaves?
scripts.translation: 是比太阳更闪耀的金色礼服？还是比月亮更温柔的银色礼服？亦或是比树叶更翠绿的礼服？

scripts.text: Ah, how can I fit the pearl necklace and look nice with my partner?
scripts.translation: 啊，我该怎么搭配那条珍珠项链，才能和舞伴相得益彰呢？

scripts.text: I prefer the soft pink dress other than young flower petal blooming on a large field. To be like that, I think I need a very soft silk cloth.
scripts.translation: 我更喜欢柔和的粉色礼服，就像广阔田野上绽放的花朵一样。要做出那种效果，我想需要非常柔软的丝绸。

scripts.text: In the banquet, if my soft dress widens like young flower petal, the place will be full with fragrance.
scripts.translation: 宴会上，我那柔软的裙摆若能像花瓣般绽开，整个大厅都会充满芬芳。

scripts.text: The width of the skirt should be as wider as possible. The dress will look like a flower petal shaking every time I move.
scripts.translation: 裙摆应该尽可能宽大。这样每次我移动时，礼服都会像花瓣一样摇曳。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, Would get me ^0000cd{0}^000000? ^0000cd15 pieces^000000 will do.
I also need herbs used to dye the cloth. ^0000cd30 {0} and 10 {1}^000000.
scripts.translation: 我还需要用来染布的草药。^0000cd30个{0}和10个{1}^000000。

scripts.text: I see a dress in you hands that look like a flower petal.
scripts.translation: 我看到你手里那件礼服了，样子像花瓣一样。

scripts.text: Flower! It a flower! Large and shining jewels are too common here in the palace.
scripts.translation: 花！我要做成花朵！宫殿里大而闪亮的宝石已经太常见了。

scripts.text: I want to be a flower in the banquet hall. I want to make people to admire me like a flower that fascinates with delicate fragrance.
scripts.translation: 我想成为宴会大厅里最亮眼的那朵花，让大家像欣赏一朵散发着淡淡香气的花一样，为我着迷。

scripts.text: I'm going to use flowers to make a corsage. Please get me some flowers. No common flowers. I heard that rare flowers can be obtained in a far foreign country.
scripts.translation: 我要用鲜花做一朵胸花。请帮我找些花来，不要普通的花。我听说遥远的异国有稀有花卉。

scripts.text: I saw those flowers once. They were so beautiful.
scripts.translation: 我曾经见过那些花。它们非常美丽。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please get me ^0000cd5 {0}, 5 {1} and 5 {2}^000000.
My beautiful corsage is up to you!
scripts.translation: 我那美丽的胸花就拜托你了！

scripts.text: I was thinking of how I can emphasize my pearl necklace.
scripts.translation: 我一直在想怎么突出我的珍珠项链。

scripts.text: Yesterday, when I was thinking watching the night sky, I found that stars were twinkling.
scripts.translation: 昨天，当我仰望夜空时，我发现星星在闪烁。

scripts.text: It was so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off them.
scripts.translation: 它们太美了，让我移不开目光。

scripts.text: What I ask you today is....
scripts.translation: 我今天想请你帮忙的是...

scripts.text: Imagine that star dusts are gently scattered on a beautiful dress. You won't be able to take your eyes from them.
scripts.translation: 想象一下，把星尘轻轻洒在漂亮的礼服上。那一定让人移不开目光。

scripts.text: I will be the brightest star in the banquet.
scripts.translation: 我将成为宴会上最亮的星。

scripts.text: So please get me ^0000cd5 {0}^000000. I think that amount of star dusts can decorate the entire dress.
scripts.translation: 请帮我找来^0000cd5个{0}^000000。我想这些星尘足以装饰整件礼服。

scripts.text: Don't forget. My shining dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation: 别忘了。我那闪耀的礼服就托付给你了。

scripts.text: I would like to make a fairy dress! A dress so shining in golden light that anyone should admire it.
scripts.translation: 我想做一件仙子般的礼服！让它在金色光芒中闪耀，人人见了都会赞叹。

scripts.text: Cloth is sufficient, but the problem is decoration. I heard that there is something called fairy's wing.
scripts.translation: 布料已经够了，可装饰还没着落。我听说有种东西叫“仙子之翼”。

scripts.text: It will make a dress as elegant as fairy and on which I can work lightly. The thought alone makes you fascinated?
scripts.translation: 用它装饰的礼服会像仙子一样优雅，穿起来也很轻盈。光是想想就让人着迷呢。

scripts.text: Every time I step, the luxury lace will flutter, making people to imagine a fairy waling in the wood. The dress will make me better.
scripts.translation: 每走一步，华丽的蕾丝都会随之飘动，让人仿佛看见仙子漫步在林间。这件礼服一定会让我更加出众。

scripts.text: Of course, I will not attach them as they are. I know a person who will modify them properly.
scripts.translation: 当然，我不会直接把它们缝上去。我认识一位能妥善改造它们的人。
亲爱的冒险者，请帮我找来^0000cd5个{0}^000000。

scripts.text: My fairly-like dress is up to you hands.
scripts.translation: 我那仙子般的礼服就拜托你了。

scripts.text: Have you ever watch the burning sun directly. I am sure you haven't. The sun stabs the eyes of the people who watch it so that they cannot watch it.
scripts.translation: 你曾经直视过燃烧的太阳吗？我相信你没有。太阳的光芒会刺痛直视它的人的眼睛，让人无法再看。

scripts.text: But I wonder how many people lost their eyes after watching the sun directly. Why do people watch that burning fire? What is it?
scripts.translation: 不过我很好奇，有多少人直视太阳后失去了视力。人们为什么要看那团燃烧的火呢？那是什么？

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. I want to have that burning fire.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者。我想要那团燃烧的火。

scripts.text: I heard that there is the ^0000cdhot hair^000000 that looks burning but not hot at all, though the name sounds contradictory.
scripts.translation: 我听说有一种热发，虽然名字听起来自相矛盾，但它看起来像在燃烧，实际上却一点也不烫。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I will use it to make a beautiful shawl. As soon as I enter the banquet hall, I will be able to give a strong impression.
scripts.translation: 我要用它做一条美丽的披肩。当我走进宴会厅时，一定能给人留下强烈的印象。

scripts.text: My beautiful shawl burning like the sun is up to your hands.
scripts.translation: 我那如太阳般燃烧的华丽披肩就托付给你了。

scripts.text: I like a black dress that reminds of dark night. A dress so elegant and beautiful that makes people to admire in silence.
scripts.translation: 我喜欢让人联想到深夜的黑色礼服。一件如此优雅美丽的礼服，让人只能静静地欣赏。

scripts.text: I should make a dress that is as far and mysterious as a dark night.
scripts.translation: 我该做一件像深夜般深邃神秘的礼服。

scripts.text: I will go around the banquet hall like a sleek cat, concealing everything underneath the black dress.
scripts.translation: 我要像一只矫健的猫，在宴会厅里穿梭，把一切都藏在黑色礼服之下。

scripts.text: To do so, I think I need ^0000cd20 {0}^000000.
This will be beautiful dress without a decoration.
scripts.translation: 这将是一件无需装饰的美丽礼服。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, my black night-like dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，我那如黑夜般的礼服就托付给你了。

scripts.text: If you want to listen to the story of my family, see my ^0000cdgrandfather^000000 who is over there.
scripts.translation: 如果你想听听我们家族的故事，可以去找那边的祖父 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He will explain better than me.
Did you see my brother, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000?
scripts.translation: 你见到我的兄弟，沃尔夫·罗 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He is in charge of all household matters helping our grandfather while I am away here on the front.
scripts.translation: 根堡了吗？在我前线驻守期间，他负责协助祖父处理家中所有事务。

scripts.text: If you want to know about the Roegenburg, it will be a quality time.
scripts.translation: 想了解罗根堡家族的话，和他聊聊一定很愉快。

scripts.text: I am glad that I come back home and can see the family members.
scripts.translation: 我很高兴能回到家，见到家人们。

scripts.text: But when I think of the front threatened by the monster, I feel heavy-hearted. Of course, I believe that my men are doing well to protect the territory.
scripts.translation: 但一想到前线正受到魔物的威胁，我就感到心情沉重。当然，我相信我的部下们正努力保护着这片领土。

scripts.text: I want to run back to them as soon as the banquet is finished.
scripts.translation: 宴会一结束，我就想立刻回去找他们。

scripts.text: This place is somewhat stuffy to me.
scripts.translation: 这里对我来说有点沉闷。

scripts.text: I am ^0000cdKalbern^000000 and a chamberlain of Helmut.
scripts.translation: 是卡尔贝恩，赫尔穆特的侍从长。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I served Helmut in a harsh front in the border area. Now I am in Prontera, the capital city of Rune-Midgarts and I cannot adapt to this situation
scripts.translation: 我曾陪赫尔穆特驻守边境艰苦的前线。如今到了卢恩·米德加兹的首都普隆德拉，我反而有些不适应。

scripts.text: I also lose my nerve when I see noble people and royal family in the palace.
scripts.translation: 看到宫殿里的贵族和皇室成员时，我也会感到紧张。

scripts.text: I didn't recognize when I served Helmut on the front but here, he seems a little away as I feel that he is the heir of a royal family.
scripts.translation: 在前线跟随赫尔穆特时，我还没意识到这一点。到了这里，才真切感受到他身为王位继承人的身份，觉得他离我远了些。

scripts.text: He treated solders and working children equally. So everybody liked him and followed him.
scripts.translation: 他平等对待士兵和随军的孩子，因此大家都喜欢他、愿意追随他。

scripts.text: I also thank him for accepting me after my parents were killed by the monster.
scripts.translation: 父母被魔物杀害后，是他收留了我，我一直很感激。

scripts.text: To repay his kindness, I begged him to serve him and I am staying with him...
scripts.translation: 为了报答他的恩情，我苦苦请求他让我留下侍奉他...之后便一直跟在他身边。

scripts.text: Here, I have nothing to do for Helmut except bring him some beer.
scripts.translation: 在这里，除了给赫尔穆特送点啤酒，我没什么事可做。

scripts.text: I wish that the banquet is finished and go back early.
scripts.translation: 我希望宴会快点结束，好早点回去。

scripts.text: But, I don't mean that I don't want him to become a king.
scripts.translation: 但这并不意味着我不希望他成为国王。我

scripts.text: I am just uncomfortable to be here.
scripts.translation: 只是在这里感到不自在。

scripts.text: Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你看起来行李很多。要不要卸下一些？

scripts.text: Thank you for visiting the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 感谢你来访。要不要去见见我的

scripts.text: Won't you see my grandfather and patriarch of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000?
scripts.translation: 祖父，也是罗根堡家族的族长，马克西米利安·罗根堡？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, it is a honor to have you in the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，您能造访罗根堡家族，是我们的荣幸。我是

scripts.text: I am the second son of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡家的二儿子，沃尔夫·罗根堡。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: To carry on the will of Wilhelm Roegenburg, a national hero, we, at the Roegenburg, are making lots of efforts to protect honor, justice and traditions.
scripts.translation: 为了继承国民英雄威廉·罗根堡的遗志，我们罗根堡家族正努力维护荣誉、正义与传统。

scripts.text: Since the foundation of Rune-Midgarts, lots of people from the Roegenburg have made contribution to the country and this is our pride.
scripts.translation: 自卢恩·米德加兹建国以来，罗根堡家族为国家的贡献不计其数，这也是我们的骄傲。

scripts.text: Currently ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, who is an excellent candidate for the throne, is participating in the royal assembly. Did you see him?
scripts.translation: 目前，作为王位继承人的有力竞争者，赫尔穆特·罗根堡正在参加皇家议会。你见到他了吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes. I saw him just before. Who is this?
scripts.translation: 是的。我刚才见过他。他是谁？

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, it is nice to see you. I am ^0000cdAgnes Roegenburg^000000 and the youngest of the four of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，见到你很高兴。我是阿格妮丝·罗根堡，罗根堡家四兄妹中最小的一个。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you have a partner to go with to the banquet? I have no one to go with. No one takes my fancy.
scripts.translation: 你有伴一起去宴会吗？我没有。没有谁让我看得上眼。

scripts.text: Agnes, don't say that. it is not appropriate. We are telling the adventurer of the story of the Roegenburg...
scripts.translation: 阿格妮丝，别这么说。这样很不合适。我们正在向冒险者讲述罗根堡家族的故事...

scripts.text: Now, will my prince come with me?
scripts.translation: 好了，我的王子殿下，你要跟我走吗？

scripts.text: Thanks for coming at the right time. Dear adventurer,
scripts.translation: 谢谢你及时赶到。亲爱的冒险者，这位是

scripts.text: This is ^0000cdMyer Roegenburg^000000 and he is the third son of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 0000cd迈尔·罗根堡，他是罗根堡家的三儿子。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I was away for a long time and have just came back. It is right, isn't?
scripts.translation: 我离家很久了，刚回来。是这样吧？

scripts.text: Well, about half. I heard that ^0000cda war manic and a peddler would join hands and participate in the royal assembly^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯，差不多吧。我听说一个战争狂人和一个商贩要联手参加皇家议会。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So I came back for a short stay. I heard that the relationship between brothers was not close but has suddenly deeper. I cannot be out.
scripts.translation: 所以我才回来小住一阵。听说兄弟们原本关系不太亲近，最近却突然亲密起来。我可不能错过。

scripts.text: What your language. ^0000cdEven though you go outside and hang out with low fellows,^000000 you don't have make the place where you live a dirty back street.
scripts.translation: 你说话真难听。你出去跟那些下等人鬼混也就算了，可别把家里弄得像 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You didn't think that I am ignorant of the fellows that you hang out with, did you?
scripts.translation: 脏乱的后街。你以为我不知道你平时都跟谁来往吗？

scripts.text: Of course I know that grandfather and you sent people to monitor me. They were so awkward and all other fellow knew it.
scripts.translation: 我当然知道祖父和你派人监视我。他们做得太拙劣了，其他人都看得出来。

scripts.text: My noble brother doesn't like my way of speaking?
scripts.translation: 我高贵的哥哥不喜欢我的说话方式？如果

scripts.text: If we join hands and ^0000cdHelmut becomes a king^000000,^0000cdthe whole country will ^000000turn into a back street except the palace. Isn't it better to hear it now to reduce the shock you will have later?
scripts.translation: 我们联手，赫尔穆特成为国王，整个国家除了皇宫都会变成后街。现在告诉你，总比以后让你受到冲击要好，不是吗？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well, you may not hear as you will stay at home and calculate the money you will make from wars.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你可能听不进去，因为你只会待在家里计算战争能赚多少钱。

scripts.text: You are unbelievably rude. I told you should call me politely.
scripts.translation: 你简直粗鲁得令人难以置信。我告诉过你要礼貌

scripts.text: Until when are you going to act like that?
scripts.translation: 地称呼我。你还要这样多久？

scripts.text: Stop all of you! We have gathered here for fight. This is a banquet for the adventurer. We shouldn't do this in front of the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你们都住口！我们聚在这里不是为了吵架的！这是为冒险者准备的宴会，不该当着他的面闹成这样。

scripts.text: Especially you lack dignity. What would the adventurer think of us?
scripts.translation: 尤其是你，太失礼了。冒险者会怎么看我们？

scripts.text: Yes, you are right. I think I am the unwelcome guest. I'd better leave. Agnes, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 是的，你说得对。我觉得自己是个不受欢迎的客人。我最好离开。阿格妮丝，我稍后回来。

scripts.text: Oh my god, I forgot. I have to make preparations!
scripts.translation: 天哪，我忘了！我得去准备了！

scripts.text: Sorry for this unpleasant situation. I never meant to do so. Apologies if you feel uncomfortable. Myer made rude remarks as he came back in a long time.
scripts.translation: 抱歉让您遇到这种不愉快的情况。我本无意如此，如果您感到不适，请见谅。迈尔是因为很久没回来，才说了些失礼的话。

scripts.text: I will tell him to make a polite apology to you later. Actually he is different from what you saw. Please understand kindly.
scripts.translation: 稍后我会让他向您正式道歉。其实他和您看到的并不一样，请多多包涵。

scripts.text: No, it is ok with me.
By the way, dear adventurer, can you do me a favor if you have time?
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，亲爱的冒险者，如果您有空的话，能帮我一个忙吗？

scripts.text: I hope you will visit the Wigner and bring a thing from ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation: 希望您能去一趟维格纳家族，从艾萨克·维格纳那里取一样东西。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Originally, I should do that, but I think I need to talk with Myer seriously. So I would like to do that for me...
scripts.translation: 本来该由我去，可我得和迈尔好好谈谈。所以想请您代劳...

scripts.text: So, please do it for me. Of course, you may refuse it. But I wonder I can find a reliable person like you.
scripts.translation: 所以，拜托您帮我办这件事。当然，您也可以拒绝。不过，像您这样可靠的人可不常见。

scripts.text: It is a test to find that I am reliable.
scripts.translation: 这是在测试我是否可靠吗？

scripts.text: Ah, no it is not. If you feel unpleasant, I am sorry. I just don't have reliable person.
scripts.translation: 啊，不，不是的。如果您觉得不舒服，我很抱歉。我只是没有可以信赖的人。

scripts.text: Ok. Go to the Wigner and ask Isaac Wigner for the thing that you requested. Is that right?
scripts.translation: 好的。去维格纳找艾萨克·维格纳，拿你要的东西。是这样吗？

scripts.text: Walk along the ^0000cdcorridor. The Wigner is in the last room^000000.
scripts.translation: 沿着走廊走，维格纳就在最后的房间 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Find Isaac and bring the thing I requested.
scripts.translation: 。找到艾萨克，把我需要的东西带回来。

scripts.text: I am very sorry to cause inconvenience to you.
scripts.translation: 非常抱歉给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, how is it going? I see you have nothing. It seem that you haven't brought it yet.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，进展如何？我看您手里没东西，看来还没取回来。您只需要去

scripts.text: You just go to the ^0000cdWigner and bring a thing from Isaac^000000.
scripts.translation: 00cd维格纳，从艾萨克那里取东西即可。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring the thing? Oh, you have brought it. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，您拿到东西了吗？哦，您带回来了。非常感谢。

scripts.text: Oh, the box's lock is protected by ^0000cdpassword^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，这个盒子的锁设有密码。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The first cell has a number ^0000cd1^000000 and the next four cells are empty and you should enter numbers into them.
scripts.translation: 第一个格子里有数字1，后面四个格子是空的，您需要填入数字。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hmm.. This is simple. This perfectly ^0000cdbeautiful box is a hint^000000... The answer is always included in the question.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这很简单。这个精美的盒子本身就是提示...答案一直藏在问题里。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Looking at the answer, it really seems that the Wigner people love ^0000cdnumers and gold^000000. Will you try to solve it too?
scripts.translation: 从答案来看，维格纳家族似乎很喜欢数字和黄金。您也来试着解开密码吧？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: How come you ask me to decipher the password. And isn't it a secret thing?
scripts.translation: 为什么让我来破解密码？这难道不是机密吗？

scripts.text: Because you are reliable person. Just do it for fun.
scripts.translation: 因为您是值得信赖的人。就当是玩玩吧。

scripts.text: Then, I think the answer is this:
scripts.translation: 那么，我认为答案是这个：

scripts.text: Hm... It is not the answer.
I think I need some time for contemplation.
scripts.translation: 案。我需要时间思考一下。

scripts.text: 1618. It stands for 1.618 which is the golden ratio.
But what is inside is not easy.
scripts.translation: 但里面的东西可不容易。

scripts.text: The thing put in the small bottle in the box will change the dynamics of combats and wars, though it is in a testing stage.
scripts.translation: 盒子里那只小瓶所装的东西，尽管还在测试阶段，却可能彻底改变战斗乃至战争的局势。

scripts.text: You are a reliable person as I expected.
scripts.translation: 您果然值得信赖。之前请

scripts.text: I was sorry when I asked you to do me a favor. We will reward you generously.
scripts.translation: 您帮忙，实在过意不去。我们会给您丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text: It is OK. there is message from Isaac.
scripts.translation: 没关系。艾萨克有消息要我转告。

scripts.text: Recently, there is a ^0000cdrumor^000000 circulating in Prontera about the Roegenburg and Helmut Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 最近，普隆德拉流传着关于罗根堡和赫尔穆特·罗根堡的谣言。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It was not a good rumor. He asked me to inspect it and check if it is true.
scripts.translation: 那不是好谣言。他让我去调查一下，看看是否属实。

scripts.text: A rumor about you? I didn't know about it... Rumor.....
scripts.translation: 关于我的谣言？我一点也不知道...谣言..

scripts.text: I need to check it, but there is no person we count on...
scripts.translation: .我得去查清楚，可眼下没有能托付的人...

scripts.text: Can you do me a favor again? I cannot do it myself, as there could be a problem when I do it myself.
scripts.translation: 能再请您帮我一次吗？我不方便亲自去，可能会惹出麻烦。

scripts.text: All staff I can have trust in are doing other jobs and I have no person except you.
scripts.translation: 我信任的职员都在忙别的事。现在除了您，我找不到可以托付的人。

scripts.text: You can get information easily traveling around and what is more important is that I can trust you.
scripts.translation: 您四处走动，打听消息很方便。更重要的是，我信任您。

scripts.text: Well, it is not easy but....
If you are busy, you may refuse it. I am sorry that I ask you to do me a favor. My brother came back suddenly and it drives me out of my mind and busy.
scripts.translation: 如果您忙，可以拒绝。抱歉又来麻烦您。我哥哥突然回来，弄得我心烦意乱，忙得不可开交。

scripts.text: No, that is a thing I can do. Then see you soon.
scripts.translation: 不，这是我力所能及的事。那我们很快再见。

scripts.text: I don't know how to thank you. It is the most accurate to hear the rumor from children. I heard that children gather in a ^0000cdlarge open space^000000 in Prontera..
scripts.translation: 真不知道该怎么感谢您。孩子们的消息通常最准确。我听说普隆德拉的大广场上聚集着不少孩子... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What is the rumor about Roegenburg that is circulating in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉最近在传什么关于罗根堡家族的谣

scripts.text: I didn't know there is a rumor about our family circulating
scripts.translation: 言？我竟然不知道家族里出了传闻。

scripts.text: I had to start gather information earlier. I couldn't because I was busy due to others.
scripts.translation: 我本该早点打听消息，可之前忙着处理其他事。

scripts.text: I didn't expect at all that a rumor will be circulating.
scripts.translation: 完全没想到会有谣言传开。

scripts.text: I cannot wait to know what rumor is circulating about our family.
scripts.translation: 我迫不及待想知道大家在传我们家什么。那

scripts.text: Hi, you look a little tired.
Ah, do I? I had to do some errands to find the rumor.
scripts.translation: 啊，是吗？为了寻找传闻，我跑了不少地方。

scripts.text: Oh, I am sorry about that. I should have done that.
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉。我应该早点去做的。

scripts.text: Rumor? what rumor? I like such thing very much.
scripts.translation: 传闻？什么传闻？我很喜欢这类事情。

scripts.text: I really want know about it too.
I am sorry to make you tired. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation: 抱歉让你这么辛苦。你找到什么线索了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I found the rumor and it was pretty specific. Can I tell about it here?
scripts.translation: 是的，我打听到了，传闻说得很具体。我可以在这里说吗？

scripts.text: Yes, it is ok. If the rumor is about our family, everyone has to listen, so that we can gather and develop a solution.
scripts.translation: 可以。如果传闻是关于我们家族的，大家都该听听，这样才能一起商量对策。

scripts.text: [I changed the rumor I got from children to a relatively softer version and told them.]
scripts.translation: [我把从孩子们那里听来的传闻稍稍修饰了一下，换成比较委婉的说法，然后告诉了他们。]

scripts.text: These days everybody talks about the rumor. I think it will spread throughout Rune-Midgarts as well as Prontera.
scripts.translation: 最近大家都在谈论这个传闻。我想它不仅会在普隆德拉，还会传遍卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text: The rumor is....very.... specific and malicious. It must be circulated on purpose by someone who knows the circumstances of my family.
scripts.translation: 这传闻...说得非常...具体，而且充满恶意。一定是了解我们家情况的人故意散布的。

scripts.text: Do yo mean the bad guy is one of us? OMG! this is very serious!
scripts.translation: 你是说，散布谣言的人就在我们当中？天哪！这下可严重了！

scripts.text: Yes. ^0000cdMyer^000000? How much are you going to disgrace our family?
scripts.translation: 是的。迈尔？你还要让我们家族蒙羞到什么程度？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Myer, did you really do that?
scripts.translation: 迈尔，你真的做了那种事？

scripts.text: Myer, is this true? Did you spread the rumor?
scripts.translation: 迈尔，这是真的吗？是你散布的谣言？

scripts.text: You collected small kids and played a leader. Did you have lots of fun?
scripts.translation: 你召集了一群小孩子，还扮演首领。你玩得很开心吧？

scripts.text: Did you see what those little kids did for this time? You believe that only the upper class can exert influence on the common people, don't you? You must be so stupid.
scripts.translation: 你们没看见那些孩子这次做了什么吗？你还以为只有上层阶级才能影响平民？真够愚蠢的。

scripts.text: How far are you going to go?
scripts.translation: 你到底要闹到什么地步？

scripts.text: Well, I asked for help church friends, merchant friends and back street friends. Everyone said they would be willing to help me, when I told them I need help.
scripts.translation: 我找了教会里的朋友、商人朋友，还有后巷的朋友帮忙。我一开口说需要帮忙，大家都答应了。

scripts.text: I wonder how you can deal with invisible enemy.
scripts.translation: 我倒想看看，你打算如何应对看不见的敌人。

scripts.text: I don't understand why you spread such a rumor and do all these things.
scripts.translation: 我不明白你为什么要散布这种谣言，还要做这些事。

scripts.text: No, in fact, I think I know very well. It is because of your immature sympathy and you want to spoil my plan!
scripts.translation: 不，其实我很清楚。你只是出于幼稚的同情心，想破坏我的计划！

scripts.text: Plan? what plan? war plan? the plan to drive innocent people to the battle field? A means that will realize your ambicous plan?
scripts.translation: 计划？什么计划？发动战争的计划？把无辜的人赶上战场的计划？这就是实现你野心的手段？

scripts.text: You are too young to understand why your brothers want to realize our plans.
scripts.translation: 你还太年轻，无法理解为什么你的兄弟们想要实现我们的计划。

scripts.text: ^0000cd14 years ago^000000, we could do nothing though we were the top family. We felt a feeling of helplessness. Have you ever felt that?
scripts.translation: 14年前，尽管我们是顶级家族，却无能为力。那种无助感，你体会过吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: ^0000cdA noble family is not so good as it looks^000000. You are just playing a leader on the back street and spoiling our plan entirely!
scripts.translation: 贵族家族并没有表面看起来那么好。你不过是在后巷扮演首领，完全破坏了我们的计划！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Your plan is to develop the power of the family and unify the continent. Then what? what will you have. Achievement? Revenge?
scripts.translation: 你们想扩张家族势力、统一大陆。然后呢？你们究竟想得到什么？成就感，还是复仇？

scripts.text: As you know, such as thing causes another pain. We were raised without a parent. But we didn't fall because we had a family and we were rich.
scripts.translation: 你也知道，这种事只会给别人带来更多痛苦。我们从小没有父母，却没有被击垮，因为我们还有家人，也有财富。

scripts.text: And we had brothers ^0000cdto depend on^000000. Think how we did to comfort one another? There are not many people that are so lucky as we were.
scripts.translation: 我们还有可以互相依靠的兄弟。想想我们是怎样彼此扶持的？世上没有多少人像我们这样幸运。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There are so many people who has no one to depend on, no place to lie their bodies, or no money to buy a piece of bread. People are dying everywhere.
scripts.translation: 有太多人没有可以依靠的人，没有安身之所，甚至买不起一片面包。到处都有人在死去。

scripts.text: The world you and Helmut are dreaming is only for ^0000cdthe satisfaction of a few persons^000000.
scripts.translation: 你和赫尔穆特梦想的世界，只会满足少数人的私欲。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yo are too ideal. Small sacrifice is a must to achieve a bing goal.
scripts.translation: 你太理想化了。想成就大事，总得有人付出牺牲。

scripts.text: Sacrifice for the goal? Do you think I don't know the reason you are helping Helmut.
scripts.translation: 为了目标而牺牲？你以为我不知道你帮助赫尔穆特的真正原因吗？

scripts.text: When Helmut participated in the Royal Assembly, I didn't care about it. Anyway he is naive and doesn't know how to acquire likeability and credibility from others.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特参加皇家议会时，我根本没放在心上。他天真得很，不懂如何赢得别人的好感与信任。

scripts.text: The wish that Helmut could end up as just a wish, but since you started to support Helmut ambiguously, everything has changed.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特想当国王，原本不过是一厢情愿。可自从你开始含糊地支持他，一切都变了。

scripts.text: Helmut and you look like a good brothers, but Wolf, I know that you want to make money from wars and
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特和你看起来兄弟情深，可沃尔夫，我知道你想从战争中牟利，

scripts.text: even though Helmut becomes a king, he is just a figurehead and you will exert power ^0000cdover our family and kingdom^000000. won't you?
scripts.translation: 就算赫尔穆特当上国王，也不过是个傀儡，而你会掌控我们的家族和王国。不是吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What is our family proud of? Name? Fame? they are useless outside the country. And now they are not so high as before.
scripts.translation: 我们家族有什么值得骄傲？姓氏？名声？出了国门就一文不值。如今它们也不如从前显赫了。

scripts.text: But look at the Wigner. Wherever they go whatever they do, people bow their heads in front of their gold.
scripts.translation: 可看看维格纳家族。无论他们走到哪里、做什么，人们都会向黄金低头。

scripts.text: To whoever has gold. I want that power. I want ^0000cdreal power^000000 rather powerless fame.
scripts.translation: 谁掌握黄金，谁就拥有力量。我想要的就是这种力量。我想要真正的权力，而非徒有虚名。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You want to build a kingdom that you want rule as you want. What if Helmut fails to be a king? What would you do then?
scripts.translation: 你想建立一个由你随心所欲统治的王国。如果赫尔穆特没能当上国王，你该怎么办？

scripts.text: You will run into a limit as the second son of the Roegenburg, can you give up your ambition?
scripts.translation: 作为罗根堡家的次子，你迟早会遇到阻碍。到那时，你还能放下野心吗？

scripts.text: Anyway life is short. What moves people is heart, not money or power.
scripts.translation: 总之，人生苦短。打动人心的是真心，而不是金钱或权力。

scripts.text: Heart? Does it work on ^0000cdthose guys^000000?
scripts.translation: 真心？那对那些人有用吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You didn't know you can approach them in a different way
scripts.translation: 你只是不知道，还可以换一种方式接近他们。

scripts.text: You are better than I expected. You are grown up and I know you will not cry any more in front of me. So stop talking nonsense and play outside.
scripts.translation: 你比我预期的要好。你长大了，我知道你不会再在我面前哭了。所以别再说废话了，出去玩吧。

scripts.text: Watch your mouth. I cannot be nice to you forever.
scripts.translation: 管好你的嘴。我不可能永远对你好。

scripts.text: If you do nothing, I do nothing. I hope I will live on the back street as happy ^0000cdJonathan^000000.
scripts.translation: 只要你不动手，我也不会动手。我希望能像乔纳森一样，快乐地生活在后街。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But you are developing a murder weapon as new business item with the Wigner.
scripts.translation: 可你正在和维格纳家族合作，把杀伤性武器开发成新的生意。

scripts.text: How can people trust you when your family does not trust you? I cannot trust you! And I told you to stop treating me as a child!
scripts.translation: 当你的家族都不信任你时，人们怎么能信任你？我无法信任你！而且我告诉过你，别把我当小孩！

scripts.text: Stop! What the hell are you fighting? Didn't all of us want to live happier than anybody?
scripts.translation: 住手！你们到底在争什么？难道大家不都想过得比谁都幸福吗？

scripts.text: So, everybody pursues happiness in their own ways. Helmut had found it on the front. Wolf on the money. And Myer on the street.
scripts.translation: 所以，每个人都在以自己的方式追求幸福。赫尔穆特在战场上找到了它，狼在金钱中找到了它，而迈尔在街头找到了它。

scripts.text: Isn't it enough? Do you need something bigger? Cause? Revenge? War?
scripts.translation: 这样还不够吗？还要追求什么更大的目标？理由？复仇？战争

scripts.text: Everyone is fighting in this family and losing important thins. Still you want a war?
scripts.translation: ？这个家里人人都在争斗，结果失去了重要的东西。你们还想发动战争吗？

scripts.text: What do we really want? Well, if we can be happy by fighting, it is good!. But it is not. We have fought too long.
scripts.translation: 我们真正想要的是什么？如果争斗能带来幸福，那倒也罢了。可事实并非如此，我们已经斗得太久了。

scripts.text: All of you, Helmut, Wolf and Myer.
scripts.translation: 你们所有人，赫尔穆特、狼和迈尔。

scripts.text: Everybody calm down. It is not nice to raise our voices.
scripts.translation: 大家都冷静一下。大声争吵是不好的。

scripts.text: Agnes is right. Both of you, please stop fighting.
scripts.translation: 阿格妮丝说得对。你们两个，请停止争吵。

scripts.text: Myer! where are you going? Are going to leave the family again?
scripts.translation: 迈尔！你要去哪里？又要离开家族了吗？

scripts.text: What do you think. I totally agree with Agnes. I think we have fought one another too long.
scripts.translation: 你们怎么看？我完全赞同阿格妮丝。我觉得我们已经彼此争斗太久了。

scripts.text: But we have to keep in mind that revenge brings revenge in return and violence brings violence in return.
scripts.translation: 但我们必须记住，复仇只会招来复仇，暴力也只会引来暴力。

scripts.text: Do you know why I have been quiet though I lost my son and daughter-in-law.
scripts.translation: 你们知道吗？我失去了儿子和儿媳，却一直没有采取行动。

scripts.text: Because revenges does not make a difference. Revenge is another type of violence that only gives a temporary satisfaction.
scripts.translation: 因为复仇改变不了什么。复仇只是另一种暴力，只能带来短暂的满足。

scripts.text: The dead never comes back. Your parents would not want you to take revenge.
scripts.translation: 逝者无法复生。你们的父母也不会希望你们去复仇。

scripts.text: I have let you do as you want to do, but this time I hope that you will follow what Agnes said. I want to avoid wars if possible.
scripts.translation: 过去我一直让你们按自己的想法行事，但这次我希望你们听阿格妮丝的。如果可以，我想避免战争。

scripts.text: Lord Helmut! where are you going?
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特大人！您要去哪里？

scripts.text: I don't want to break in, but many people are afraid of wars,
scripts.translation: 我不想打断你们，不过很多人都害怕战争，

scripts.text: including children. It would be better if a war didn't break out, but nothing is good if unrest and feat last long.
scripts.translation: 孩子们也一样。最好别让战争爆发，但动荡和恐惧持续太久，对谁都没有好处。

scripts.text: Ah, I am sorry that you saw
scripts.translation: 啊，让您看到这一幕，真抱歉。

scripts.text: Apologies for making you uncomfortable. I am sorry again but can you do me a favor?
scripts.translation: 抱歉让您感到不自在了。再次向您致歉，但能请您帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: I think we need to inform ^0000cdWigner^000000 of the rumor. Please wait a while.
scripts.translation: 我觉得我们需要向维格纳通报这个传闻。请稍等片刻。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: [Wolf prepares documents for a while and seal it in an envelope.]
scripts.translation: [沃尔夫准备了一会儿文件，然后把它封进信封。]

scripts.text: Please deliver this document. Sorry again. I cannot find time as I have much to do suddenly.
scripts.translation: 请帮我送交这份文件。再次抱歉，我手头突然有很多事要处理，实在抽不出时间。

scripts.text: Did you deliver the document to Isaac? I should have done it myself, but I got busy suddenly.
scripts.translation: 你把文件交给艾萨克了吗？本该我自己去送的，但突然忙了起来。

scripts.text: I thought about many thins after I heard from Agnes. To do those things, I cannot waste a minute.
scripts.translation: 听了阿格妮丝的话后，我想了很多。为了把这些事办妥，我一刻也不能耽搁。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, thank you very much. Was Wigner offended?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，非常感谢。维格纳生气了吗？

scripts.text: He understood everything. He believes that Wigner will find a new item as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 他完全理解。他相信维格纳会尽快找到新的物品。

scripts.text: It is very good that he understands what I want. I think I have to start a new business at least not to disappoint Wigner.
scripts.translation: 他能理解我的想法真是太好了。我想我必须开始一项新业务，至少不能辜负维格纳的期望。

scripts.text: You will not give up the desire to do business huh?
scripts.translation: 看来你并没有放弃经商的想法啊？

scripts.text: It fits me surprisingly. Working is rewarding and enjoyable. Besides, I can show my only ability, not as Roegenburg's ability.
scripts.translation: 这份工作意外地适合我。工作既有回报又让人愉快，而且我能展现自己的本事，而非家族的力量。

scripts.text: By the way, your brothers must be busy. Myer and even Helmut....
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，你的兄弟们一定很忙吧。迈尔，甚至赫尔穆特...

scripts.text: Helmut has left for the front without saying anything. Myer also has left home. I think they felt something from what Agnes said.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特什么也没说就去了前线。迈尔也离开了家。我想他们是从阿格妮丝的话中察觉到了什么。

scripts.text: If you allow, I would like ^0000cdclear up misunderstanding of my family^000000 in the rumor. Do you have time?
scripts.translation: 如果您愿意，我想澄清谣言中对我们家族的误解。您有空吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The rumor is true, except the part that a war will break out.
scripts.translation: 除了战争会爆发这一点外，传闻都是真的。

scripts.text: Let me tell you an old story. The parents of the four children gave a birth to Agnes and left for a neighboring country for resting.
scripts.translation: 我给您讲一段往事吧。四个孩子的父母生下阿格妮丝后，便前往邻国休养。

scripts.text: They were attacked by the monster there.
scripts.translation: 他们在那里遭到了魔物袭击。

scripts.text: In the holiday resort? Now the monster appears even in the holiday resort?
scripts.translation: 在度假胜地？难道连度假胜地也会出现魔物吗？

scripts.text: It was a remote but safe place. But for an unknown reason, the monsters attacked in group.
scripts.translation: 那里虽然偏僻，但很安全。不知为何，魔物成群结队地袭击了那里。

scripts.text: The reason remains unknown, but they guess that the monsters came down to the town, chased by subjugation.
scripts.translation: 原因至今不明，不过人们猜测，魔物是被讨伐队一路追赶，才逃到镇子附近的。

scripts.text: When we arrived at the site, the area was closed and no access was allowed, though my son and daughter-in-law was inside.
scripts.translation: 当我们赶到现场时，该区域已被封锁，禁止任何人进入，而我的儿子和儿媳就在里面。

scripts.text: We met with managers, but they blocked completely heavily armed foreigners like us.
scripts.translation: 我们去找了当地负责人，但他们严加戒备，完全不肯放我们这些全副武装的外国人进去。

scripts.text: I understand that. An armed force of a foreign country was crossing the border and I was not sure what the armed force would do. They have no choice but stop them.
scripts.translation: 我理解他们的做法。当时有外国武装力量正在越境，我不确定他们会做什么。他们别无选择，只能阻止我们。

scripts.text: So, we tried to get into the closed zone and contact many people while time passed.
scripts.translation: 于是我们一边设法进入封锁区，一边四处求人帮忙，可时间一分一秒地过去了。

scripts.text: At the end, we had to provide lots of money as bribe before we can dispatch mercenaries into the resort, but my son and daughter-in-law had been already killed.
scripts.translation: 最后，我们花了大笔钱打点，才让雇佣兵进入度假区。可那时，我的儿子和儿媳已经遇害了。

scripts.text: Actually, they were alive just before they were found. But, the access was delayed and they had to die in pains.
scripts.translation: 其实他们被发现时还活着。只是救援迟迟未到，他们最终才在痛苦中死去。

scripts.text: I am sorry to hear that.
I didn't tell the children about the attack, but I had to confess the death of their parents.
scripts.translation: 我没有告诉孩子们关于袭击的事，但我不得不向他们坦白父母的死讯。

scripts.text: So losing beloved ones, my children and I came to live together.
scripts.translation: 失去挚爱后，我便带着孩子们一起生活。

scripts.text: I grew the children to live up to the name of Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 我想把孩子们培养成足以继承罗根堡家名的人。可实

scripts.text: But actually what they need was education, but warm heart.
scripts.translation: 际上，他们需要的不是严苛的教育，而是温暖的关怀。

scripts.text: I didn't know that and I was only strict on them.
scripts.translation: 我当时并不知道这一点，只是对他们很严厉。

scripts.text: The children couldn't stand any more and one day they left as a token of resistance.
scripts.translation: 孩子们再也忍受不下去，有一天便离家出走，以此表示反抗。

scripts.text: The children are unwilling to talk about those days. But I am sure that what they heard and saw in those days affected them.
scripts.translation: 孩子们不愿谈论那段日子。但我确信，他们在那期间听到和看到的事情影响了他们。

scripts.text: Helmut trained himself. When he was grown up, he left to the border. Wolf suddenly declared that he would make money.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特开始刻苦训练，成年后就去了边境。狼则突然宣布要经商赚钱。

scripts.text: I tried to stop him saying that there should no merchant in my family, but he was so stubborn.
scripts.translation: 我试图阻止他，说我们家不应该有商人，但他非常固执。

scripts.text: After coming home, Myer was doing well for a while. But he left us with a note. Only Agnes has been growing well without a problem.
scripts.translation: 迈尔回家后有一阵子表现得不错，但后来留了张字条就离开了。只有阿格妮丝一直健健康康地长大。

scripts.text: Well. I see each of them has their own stories! The rumor is spread with something concealed.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，每个人都有自己的故事！传闻里果然另有隐情。

scripts.text: Yes, Myer said he would handle the rumor and so the rumor will disappear. Can I ask you to do me a favor?
scripts.translation: 是的，迈尔说他会处理这件事，谣言很快就会平息。能请您帮我一个忙吗？

scripts.text: I am worried that ^0000cdHelmut left without a word^000000, as there are many eyes watching him. He is the heir of our family.
scripts.translation: 我很担心赫尔穆特不告而别，因为有很多人在盯着他。他是我们家的继承人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I hoped that he would stay for the time being, but I am sad that he left all of sudden.
scripts.translation: 我原本希望他能暂时留下来，但很遗憾他突然离开了。

scripts.text: Then, my job is to bring him.
scripts.translation: 那么，我的任务就是把他带回来。

scripts.text: Yes. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
scripts.translation: 是的，他应该在靠近修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国边境的检查站。他负责带领那里的巡逻队。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And when you come back, use this. You can return to Prontera instantly.
scripts.translation: 回来时用这个吧，可以立刻传送回普隆德拉。

scripts.text: I think I was closer to brothers than now, to Helmut and Myer.
scripts.translation: 比起以前，我觉得自己和赫尔穆特、迈尔两位兄弟亲近多了。

scripts.text: Agnes was our favored child in the family. She was the only little sister.
scripts.translation: 阿格妮丝是我们家最受宠的孩子。她是家里唯一的小妹妹。

scripts.text: But sometimes I wonder why we have become this estranged.
scripts.translation: 可有时我也会纳闷，我们怎么会变得这么疏远。

scripts.text: Well, I think it is because we have came to become different and we also have different ideas on what is right. I understand to some extent.
scripts.translation: 我想是因为我们各自变了，对是非也有不同的看法。不过，我多少能理解。

scripts.text: It was quite a shock when Myer left home. He just left without a word, though he was very close to me.
scripts.translation: 迈尔离家出走时，让我很震惊。他什么话都没说就走了，尽管他和我很亲近。

scripts.text: Since then, I think, I started to find what I can. I cannot stand the thought that I am the only one who are not developing.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，我就开始寻找自己的方向。我无法忍受自己成了唯一没有进步的人。

scripts.text: When a human feels an empty space, he/she tends to fill it.
scripts.translation: 人一旦觉得心里空了一块，就总想找东西把它填满。

scripts.text: I think I am going to continue to go around to find it.
scripts.translation: 我想我会继续四处寻找它。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, thanks to you, I feel that my brothers and I have become closer.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，多亏了你，我觉得兄弟们和我又亲近起

scripts.text: My brothers and I didn't know how to be bent and were about to be broken.
scripts.translation: 来了。我们都不懂得变通，差点就彼此决裂。

scripts.text: I think these experiences make us more friendly and developing.
scripts.translation: 我想这些经历让我们更加亲近，也各自有所成长

scripts.text: We were apart a long time and all have forgotten it.
scripts.translation: 。我们分开太久，都忘了曾经的情谊。

scripts.text: From now, I am going to lead my family, helping my grandfather.
scripts.translation: 今后我会协助祖父，带领家族向前。你

scripts.text: If you visit us from time to time, I will be happy.
scripts.translation: 要是常来看我们，我会很高兴。

scripts.text: Please come back to us, if you need a help.
scripts.translation: 如果你需要帮助，记得回来找我们。

scripts.text: It feels good that I come home for a long time.
scripts.translation: 离家这么久，终于回到家，感觉真好。

scripts.text: It is a little suffocating though.
scripts.translation: 不过还是有点喘不过气。

scripts.text: Anyway, this house goes well without me. I don't worry about the family, but I am only worried about my grandfather, as he is quite old.
scripts.translation: 总之，这个家没了我也照样运转。我不担心家里，只是放心不下年迈的祖父。

scripts.text: Now I am home and it seems that Helmut, Wolf, and Agnes have been all good.
scripts.translation: 现在回到家，看来赫尔穆特、狼和阿格妮丝都过得不错。

scripts.text: I think it is great, though a little disappointing.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这样挺好，虽然心里有点不是滋味

scripts.text: It is stupid to think like this, as I left home.
scripts.translation: 。毕竟当初是我自己离家出走的。

scripts.text: Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation: 停！你们两个都别说了。听你们讲这些，我头都晕了。

scripts.text: Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation: 嗨，我有个问题。你们有什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text: I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation: 我接受这个请求。你的问题是什么？

scripts.text: I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
scripts.translation: 我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。

scripts.text: I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation: 我想皇家议会和宴会一定有不少故事。我现在人在首都，想了解这里的气氛，觉得该听听这些。

scripts.text: Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation: 啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text: I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation: 我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text: Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation: 为什么？如果你想要报酬，我可以给你。糖果？

scripts.text: You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation: 你给糖果作为报酬？太傻了。我们不是小孩子。

scripts.text: You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation: 你最好别提报酬。我母亲告诉我不要接受陌生人的东西。

scripts.text: Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation: 陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你们不想要糖果的话，想要什么？

scripts.text: Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation: 报酬对我来说不重要。重要的是，你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text: Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation: 资格？你在说什么？他有时候说话很奇怪。

scripts.text: I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation: 我只信他三成。要是他总能猜中，世界早就毁灭二十多次了。

scripts.text: I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
scripts.translation: 这谣言真有那么危险吗？我刚才听的时候

scripts.text: OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation: 一点也没察觉。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text: It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation: 这取决于你想听什么样的八卦。价值越高，风险就越大。

scripts.text: Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation: 这八卦有这么危险吗？我刚才听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你难道知道吗？

scripts.text: It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation: 艾伦的话只能信三成。要是他总是说对，世界早就毁灭二十多次了。

scripts.text: Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation: 那我该怎么办？告诉我。你们到底想要什么？

scripts.text: At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation: 终于到了谈生意的时候！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text: I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation: 我不知道你们在说什么。请慢慢说，详细一点？

scripts.text: Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
scripts.translation: 很简单，证明你的实力。我想你知道狂暴米诺斯 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation: 00吧？那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。抓一只回来，就能证明你够强。它的力量值是33！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation: 明白了。这样就够了吗？我很快回来。

scripts.text: Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation: 等一下。你不听我们说话吗？你说过要给报酬的。

scripts.text: You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation: 你不能只听艾伦说完就走啊。我们可是一个团队！看到我们三个总在一起玩，还不明白吗？

scripts.text: Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation: 难道我也得照你们说的做...？

scripts.text: I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation: 我不会丢下我的朋友。照他们说的做。如果不做，你就会失去资格。

scripts.text: Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text: I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation: 我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都会穿漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text: I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation: 我也想要漂亮的衣服！我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！我会让我母亲给我做的！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation: 好吧，好吧，你们想要多少？

scripts.text: Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation: 按我的身高，大概需要十二块吧？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation: 这很简单。那么，小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text: I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation: 我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加兹王国全部历史的书。它在皇家图书馆里，我从来没见过。

scripts.text: I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation: 我身边没有人能进入宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我弄来。

scripts.text: Do you want me to steal it?
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation: 你疯了吗？你以为我是什么人？帮我借来就好。

scripts.text: OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation: 好吧。狩猎33只狂暴米诺斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从皇家图书馆借一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史。我很快回来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I will be waiting for you!
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation: 嗨，我回来了。这些是你们想要的吗？

scripts.text: Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation: 让我看看。对！就是这些！真漂亮，也好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation: 当然，我是特地按你们的要求带来的。你之前说要给的报酬，不会只是说说吧？

scripts.text: No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation: 不！不！我是真的想要！谢谢你！

scripts.text: And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation: 还有，这是你要的书。又大又重，我只借到其中一卷，其他几卷都被借走了。

scripts.text: Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你。我终于可以读了。

scripts.text: You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation: 你身上有浓浓的血腥味。没错，你猎杀了那些狂暴米诺斯。你果然是个强大的战士。

scripts.text: Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation: 没错，我把它们全都猎杀了。现在该告诉我那个珍贵的故事了吧。

scripts.text: War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation: 战争，王室。赫尔穆特·罗根堡。如果他成为国王，整个大陆将被卷入战争的漩涡。

scripts.text: Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation: 黑暗将席卷整片大陆，痛苦的哀号将响彻四方！！！

scripts.text: Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation: 这就是正在流传的传闻吗？我还是不明白其中意思。谁能给我解释一下？

scripts.text: Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation: 很简单。如果赫尔穆特·罗根堡成为国王，战争就会爆发。

scripts.text: Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这也太简单了。能再详细说说吗？

scripts.text: Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation: 哎呀！你们两个在说什么呢？还是让我来解释吧。事情是这样的：

scripts.text: if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation: 如果赫尔穆特·罗根堡当上国王...对了，你们听过罗根堡家族的传闻吗？特别是四兄妹遇害的传闻。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation: 不，我不知道。以前从未听说过。

scripts.text: This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation: 这也只是传闻啦。不过我敢肯定是真的。总之，我听说他们访问外国时遭人杀害，

scripts.text: when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特·罗根堡因此深受打击，从那以后就一直在战场上奔波。

scripts.text: Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation: 是的，他确实在战场上游荡。

scripts.text: I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation: 我想这和皇家议会有关。这就是最近流传的版本。

scripts.text: ^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation: 据说，赫尔穆特一旦当上国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动战争统一大陆。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡家的二儿子则在四处经商，为战争筹集资金。
你怎么知道得这么详细？

scripts.text: Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation: 大家都知道。这里到处都是关于这件事的议论。

scripts.text: My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
scripts.translation: 我爸妈很担心，怕赫尔穆特当上国王后发动战争。其实

scripts.text: In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation: 大家都很不安，谁也不想打仗。

scripts.text: The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation: 战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text: Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你们告诉我这些。这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text: If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation: 如果你还有问题，随时来找我！

scripts.text: Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation: 男子汉可不会送人出门。

scripts.text: Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation: 咦？你又来了。还需要什么吗？不过你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text: I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation: 我想问问关于罗根堡家族传闻的事。

scripts.text: There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation: 关于他们家族没什么新消息。没新鲜事，就等于死气沉沉。

scripts.text: I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation: 我不是来打听新传闻的。我想找出最初告诉你们这件事的人。

scripts.text: I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation: 我想知道是谁开始散布这个谣言的。

scripts.text: Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation: 为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text: No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation: 不是。他的祖父托我给他带个口信。

scripts.text: Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation: 他们明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text: Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation: 嗯，情况没那么简单...不过，也差不多吧。

scripts.text: Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation: 是啊，确实奇怪。有时候，家人之间也不方便见面，只能请人代为传话。

scripts.text: This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation: 这次你得拿出更有说服力的凭据...

scripts.text: Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation: 啊，他来了！乔纳森！我们有客人。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，是什么风把你吹到这里来了？

scripts.text: A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation: 要找到最初散布谣言的人，就得先找到传闻的源头。不过我没想到你也在这里。

scripts.text: Did you come here to see me?
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation: 是啊。你的家人托我给你带个口信。

scripts.text: Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation: 迈尔？你的名字叫迈尔吗？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你明明说只要叫你乔纳森就行。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation: 是啊，他们很可爱，不过可不太好应付。

scripts.text: Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation: 你是乔纳森·迈尔？还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我一声！

scripts.text: Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation: 孩子们，我有很重要的话要跟他谈。你们是要捂住耳朵，还是暂时回避一下？

scripts.text: I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation: 如果是重要的事，我想听。

scripts.text: Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation: 快点！他们有重要的事要谈。大家，把耳朵捂起来！

scripts.text: Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation: 真乖。谈完我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text: They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation: 他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text: Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation: 是啊，所以我才留在这里，观察、教导并引导他们。

scripts.text: You are doing a great job.
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation: 嗯，这也是我力所能及的事。对了，口信是什么？

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经放弃继承权，另外两位兄弟也放下了战争。]

scripts.text: That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation: 那太好了。他们是让我引以为傲的兄弟。最值得庆幸的是，狼改变了主意。跟他争来争去实在太烦人了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation: 狼总要看到事情尘埃落定才肯罢休。不过从某种角度来说，这也挺好。

scripts.text: You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation: 你可能不信，可他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text: Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation: 总之，很抱歉让你看到了我们家里这么不愉快的一面。

scripts.text: It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation: 兄弟之间吵吵闹闹很正常。我也...

scripts.text: Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation: 总之，我得回家一趟。以前家里总让我心烦，不过这次应该会很有意思。请告诉家人，我工作期间会留在这里帮忙。

scripts.text: And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation: 还有，告诉他们宴会结束后我会回家看看。

scripts.text: And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation: 也请告诉阿格妮丝，很抱歉我不能陪她参加宴会。

scripts.text: If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation: 要是需要我帮忙，尽管来找我。我会尽全力帮你。保重！

scripts.text: Do you want business with us? But we don't meet with anybody.
scripts.translation: 来找我们谈生意？不过我们可不见外人。

scripts.text: We are not easy people anybody can speak to.
scripts.translation: 我们可不是谁都能随便搭话的人。回

scripts.text: Today, the wind is cold and smells rotten. I feel that something has happened.
scripts.translation: 今天的风又冷又带着腐臭味。我感觉好像发生了什么事。

scripts.text: Ah, sorry, I couldn't clean myself for a few days.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，我好几天没洗澡了。

scripts.text: Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
scripts.translation: 是吗？我倒觉得他们在考验我。

scripts.text: He has come with empty hands.
Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.
scripts.translation: 没有凭据，就别想听到有价值的消息。回去吧。

scripts.text: How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.
scripts.translation: 你怎么能这么说！你一定忘了该带什么。

scripts.text: First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation: 首先要12块柔软的丝绸布料，一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史， ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation: 还有...替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation: 里面混了件奇怪的事，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text: Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation: 想听更多？那就得拿出更有力的凭据。

scripts.text: This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!
scripts.translation: 这是召唤鲜血的仪式！是毁灭与黑暗的仪式！！！！
请离开。我们会处理他的。

scripts.text: The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!
scripts.translation: 战争威胁已经消失了。乱世英雄也就无从诞生。黑暗在呼唤我！
请离开。我们会处理他的。

scripts.text: It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation: 宫殿里的宴会正热闹着呢。

scripts.text: My parents are happy as their business prospers when palace purchases lots of goods in large volumes. I will tell them to buy me a book tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 宫殿大量采购物资，父母的生意兴隆，他们可高兴了。明天我就请他们给我买本书。

scripts.text: It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation: 殿里的宴会正进行得如火如荼。

scripts.text: They will be all destroyed when a bloody day comes.
scripts.translation: 血腥之日一到，一切都会被毁灭。我们

scripts.text: Why are we recording those vain things?
scripts.translation: 为什么要记录这些无聊的琐事？

scripts.text: If you record today, someone in the future will read them and remember us.
scripts.translation: 把今天记下来，将来就会有人读到，也会记得我们。

scripts.text: Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
scripts.translation: 人从虚无中来，也终将归于虚无。

scripts.text: Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation: 咦？怎么空着手？我没看到我们托你带来的东西。

scripts.text: Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation: 你是因为我们是小孩才看不起我们吗？我最讨厌这种人了。

scripts.text: Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 喂，你不是那种人吧？看起来不像啊。你只是忘了该带什么，对不对？

scripts.translation: 首先要12块柔软的丝绸布料，一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史， ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation: 还有...替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation: 里面还夹了件奇怪的要求，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text: I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation: 我正在读你给我的书，虽然它又大又重。

scripts.text: My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.
scripts.translation: 我的梦想是成为历史学家。我想走遍米德加尔特，发掘那些被遗忘的古老故事。

scripts.text: Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation: 乔纳森已经把你借的书还回去了，还另外借给我两卷。

scripts.text: Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.
scripts.translation: 乔纳森真棒！将来我要成为像乔纳森那样的人。

scripts.text: How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.
scripts.translation: 公主们的礼服一定又漂亮又闪亮！我真希望能穿上好多漂亮裙子。

scripts.text: Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
scripts.translation: 你好啊，唱歌的小鸟和漂亮的花

scripts.text: Are you having a beautiful day today too?
scripts.translation: 朵。你们今天也过得愉快吗？

scripts.text: Why don't I have normal person around me?
scripts.translation: 我身边怎么就没有一个正常人呢？

scripts.text: If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.
scripts.translation: ？要是的话，你成功了，我听得一清二楚。

scripts.text: I'm too big to be locked in it.
scripts.translation: 可不是能被平庸束缚的人。

scripts.text: Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation: 咦？怎么空着手？我没看到我们托你带来的东西。

scripts.text: Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation: 你是因为我们是小孩才看不起我们吗？我最讨厌这种人了。

scripts.text: Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 喂，你不是那种人吧？看起来不像啊。你只是忘了该带什么，对不对？
