scripts.translation: 首先要12块柔软的丝绸布料，一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史， ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation: 还有...替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation: 里面还夹了件奇怪的要求，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text: Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
scripts.translation: 请把这块布交给我妈妈，让她帮我做件衣服。
我妈妈做的衣服可漂亮了！

scripts.text: Now I guess that she is in the palace to repair the dresses of princesses.
scripts.translation: 她现在应该在宫里帮公主们修改礼服吧。唉，

scripts.text: Ah, I wish that she was here!
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation: 乔纳森说战争的威胁已经解除了。真是让人松了一口气。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者？你怎么来这里了？这里很危险，刚才有魔物下来。快离开这里。

scripts.text: I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.
scripts.translation: 我没事。我已经习惯了每天被魔物攻击的生活。

scripts.text: I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
scripts.translation: 我忘了您是位了不起的战士，刚才失礼了，请见谅

scripts.text: By the way what has brought you here?
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.
scripts.translation: 我来接赫尔穆特大人回去。您的祖父很担心您，说您在这个关键时刻却离家在外。

scripts.text: I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
scripts.translation: 我不回去。我属于这里，前线。请这样告诉我的祖父。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But everybody is worried about you.
I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.
scripts.translation: 我不会回去。长大后，我一直怨恨那些眼睁睁看着我父母死去的人。

scripts.text: And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.
scripts.translation: 我曾以为，只有建立起强大到让别人不得不追随的力量，才是正确的道路。

scripts.text: So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.
scripts.translation: 所以我的目标是统一大陆，让自己的势力遍及每个角落。为此，我不断训练自己。

scripts.text: However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.
scripts.translation: 但听了迈尔和阿格妮丝的话，我意识到自己追求的道路会给别人带来悲伤和不幸。

scripts.text: So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation: 所以我决定放弃这场会把人们卷入战争漩涡的统一战争。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.
scripts.translation: 我应该留在这里。在这里，我可以更安全地保护更多人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation: 考虑到我们家族的地位，我会配合王室议会所需的一切。

scripts.text: But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.
scripts.translation: 不过我希望由狼来领导一切。王室议会结束后，请告诉狼，我会把继承人的位置让给他。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.
scripts.translation: 狼需要大量的力量。我会留在这里保护我们的人民。

scripts.text: If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation: 这样一来，狼就不会再执意发动战争，迈尔也不必再那样牺牲自己。

scripts.text: ...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.
scripts.translation: ...我明白了。我会把您的话转告给您的祖父。

scripts.text: Yes. thank you. Please take care.
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.
scripts.translation: 诉祖父：我放弃战争，并把继承人的位置让给狼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation: 如果你这样做，狼就不会坚持战争，迈尔也不会再那样牺牲自己了。

scripts.text: I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.
scripts.translation: 攻击很快就要来了，我得做好准备。

scripts.text: I am very happy that I came back here.
scripts.translation: 很高兴能回到这里。现在

scripts.text: Now I've got something to do.
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特大人放弃统一战争，真是太好了。

scripts.text: I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.
scripts.translation: 我不懂什么统一大业，只希望不要再有战争。

scripts.text: Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.
scripts.translation: 我想留在这里，帮助赫尔穆特大人守护大家平静安稳的生活。

scripts.text: Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
scripts.translation: 赫尔穆特大人应该快渴了。

scripts.text: I think I should prepare something to drink.
Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你特地来传话。要不是你，我也不会听到今天这些话。

scripts.text: Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.
scripts.translation: 打打杀杀...我也不想看到那样。

scripts.text: They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.
scripts.translation: 他们是我的家人，比任何人都更亲近我。

scripts.text: Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.
scripts.translation: 激战之后好好休息，是快速恢复实力的好方法。

scripts.text: The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.
scripts.translation: 理查德家族采用各种训练方式，休息也是其中最重要的一环。

scripts.text: The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.
scripts.translation: 理查德家族历代家主训练后也会充分休息。这么平常的事，就不多说了。

scripts.text: Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.
scripts.translation: 训练结束后，谁都会想继续大展身手。不过，那时候正该好好休息。

scripts.text: The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.
scripts.translation: 接下来的训练同样会很艰苦。您最好现在先休息一下。

scripts.text: I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.
scripts.translation: 我看您已经跃跃欲试了。看来该开始下一阶段的训练了。

scripts.text: How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.
scripts.translation: 您好。侍从长告知我您会来，我一直在等您。

scripts.text: This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.
scripts.translation: 这里是理查德家族的宅邸。这个家族一直掌握着王国的军事力量。

scripts.text: I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc
scripts.translation: 久仰{0}大名，您是平定梦罗克的英雄。

scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉占用您这么多时间。房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text: This it the room of the Richard family.
scripts.translation: 这里是理查德家族的房间。

scripts.text: Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.
scripts.translation: 家族继承人波正在休息。请稍后再来。

scripts.text: Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text: Have you met the next head of the family?
If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...
scripts.translation: 如果家族继承人要见您，{0}，请……

scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...
scripts.translation: 啊！刚才失礼了。没什么，请别放在心上...

scripts.text: I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation: 我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text: For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.
scripts.translation: 目前的训练对您来说可能太难了。建议先打好基础，再开始训练。

scripts.text: I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation: 我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text: The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.
scripts.translation: 理查德家族的训练方式和其他训练计划不同。

scripts.text: You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.
scripts.translation: 您之前应该一直是靠单独猎杀魔物来训练吧。

scripts.text: From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.
scripts.translation: 从现在开始，您可以针对特定种类的魔物训练，例如人形、动物、昆虫、鱼类、植物、恶魔、天使、不死、无形和龙族。

scripts.text: It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.
scripts.translation: 与其说一百句话，不如挥一剑来得有效。

scripts.text: Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.
scripts.translation: 嗯，似乎出现了无法解决的问题。请再试一次。如果问题仍然存在，请截图并发送给管理团队。

scripts.text: Please select a training program to try.
scripts.translation: 请选择一个训练计划进行尝试。

scripts.text: This training involves hunting 50 {0} monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation: 这项训练要求猎杀50只140级或以上的{0}魔物。

scripts.text: Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?
scripts.translation: 嗯...您不喜欢这项训练的内容吗？没关系，可以换一个训练项目。

scripts.text: You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...
scripts.translation: 即使觉得训练对您的等级来说很轻松，也不要掉以轻心。祝您顺利...

scripts.text: If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.
scripts.translation: 坚持训练下去，终会达成您的目标。

scripts.text: This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.
scripts.translation: 这是为完成训练准备的奖励，请收下。

scripts.text: We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.
scripts.translation: 感谢您参加我们的训练，这也让理查德家族受益。请别有压力。

scripts.text: You are participating in the training. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation: 您正在参与训练。有什么需要吗？

scripts.text: You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation: 对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text: The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.
scripts.translation: 理查德家族一直关注如何培养出更优秀的战士。

scripts.text: One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.
scripts.translation: 家族的前任家主之一认为，针对特定魔物的训练方式存在局限性。

scripts.text: The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.
scripts.translation: 前任的前任家主...哦，先说明一下，他只是退休了，并没有去世。

scripts.text: Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.
scripts.translation: 嗯...言归正传...他想出了一种训练方法，可以根据学员等级或魔物种类来调整训练内容。

scripts.text: Well... The training began like that...
scripts.translation: 嗯...训练就是这样开始的...

scripts.text: The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.
scripts.translation: 训练的目标...说简单也简单，说难也难。

scripts.text: The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.
scripts.translation: 最显而易见的目标无疑是变强。如果我还年轻，我也会这样回答。

scripts.text: However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.
scripts.translation: 不过，我认为训练的目标是保护身边的人。

scripts.text: The goal may be different for each warrior.
scripts.translation: 对于每位战士来说，目标可能都不尽相同。

scripts.text: I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
scripts.translation: 我不会阻止您放弃。不过您要知道，到目前为止的训练进度不会保留到下一轮。

scripts.text: Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation: 明智的决定。对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text: Too bad. If you finished the training, you must have been able to reap the benefit of hard work.
scripts.translation: 真遗憾。如果您完成了训练，本可以收获辛勤努力的成果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: 真遗憾。如果您坚持完成训练，就能收获努力的成果了。

scripts.text: An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.
scripts.translation: 冒险者？看来你现在需要更加刻苦才行。

scripts.text: I'd like to take a rest now.
scripts.translation: 冒险者？看来你还得再努力些。

scripts.text: You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.
scripts.translation: 你一定是被邀请到宫殿的冒险者。我现在正在休息。请去门口找管家预约时间。

scripts.text: That is the way to do it in the palace.
scripts.translation: 在宫殿里就是这样办事的。

scripts.text: You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.
scripts.translation: 你一定是在讨伐黑暗之王时立下大功的冒险者。宫里也流传着你的事迹。

scripts.text: Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.
scripts.translation: 尤其是我们，理查德家族，对你的事迹非常感兴趣。

scripts.text: Do you want to know why?
Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.
scripts.translation: 好吧，就算你不想听，我也要把我想说的说清楚。

scripts.text: In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.
scripts.translation: 其实你并不是自愿来这里的。我敢肯定，是那位大人召见了你。我能理解。

scripts.text: Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 冒险者也许不太关心宫廷事务，但理查德家族负责掌管卢恩·米德加兹王国的军队。

scripts.text: We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
scripts.translation: 我们也培养了许多优秀的战士。哼！我突然有点好奇。你听说过理查德家族的战士吗？

scripts.text: Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，我想“理查德”这个名字在冒险者中也是很有名的。

scripts.text: Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我是不是有点自吹自擂了？理查德家族还得更加努力才行。

scripts.text: Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.
scripts.translation: 算了，这不重要，就此打住吧。我好久没说这么多话了，口渴了。

scripts.text: Shall we take a rest before proceeding?
scripts.translation: 在继续之前，我们要不要休息一下？

scripts.text: Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.
scripts.translation: 好吧，那我就说说理查德家族为什么对你感兴趣。

scripts.text: As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.
scripts.translation: 众所周知，理查德家族培养出了杰出的战士。我们有一套系统化的训练体系来支持这一点。

scripts.text: I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.
scripts.translation: 我虽然不太喜欢这种训练，但我相信这是基于家族经验的有效训练方案。

scripts.text: Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.
scripts.translation: 请仔细听，因为我马上要说到重点了。

scripts.text: I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.
scripts.translation: 我想冒险者对此不太关心。不过这次讨伐黑暗之王时，有不少王室成员参与其中，我从他们那里听说了你的事迹。

scripts.text: When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.
scripts.translation: 听到你的功绩后，我心里冒出一个问题：如果让一位自由自在的冒险者参加严格的训练体系，会发生什么？我很好奇。

scripts.text: I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.
scripts.translation: 如果你这样一位著名的冒险者愿意帮助我们，我很乐意支付一笔可观的报酬。

scripts.text: I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
scripts.translation: 我觉得这是一个很有吸引力的提议。你愿意挑战理查德家族的战士训练体系吗？

scripts.text: I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 看来这个提议对你没有吸引力。很抱歉，等你改变主意时再回来吧。

scripts.text: Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.
scripts.translation: 太好了！我喜欢你果断的决定，也欣赏这种挑战精神。

scripts.text: Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.
scripts.translation: 让我告诉管家这件事。你可以通过他来进行训练。

scripts.text: Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.
scripts.translation: 不要小看那位将指导你训练的管家。

scripts.text: He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.
scripts.translation: 他本身就是理查德家族的一员。他是一位杰出的战士。

scripts.text: I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.
scripts.translation: 我想知道你对训练的奖励是否满意。

scripts.text: It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.
scripts.translation: 目前我很难给出更高的报酬。就把它当作一份兼职来做吧。

scripts.text: You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.
scripts.translation: 你可能觉得这是理所当然的。不过你训练得越多，理查德家族得到的好处也越多，我们愿意为此付报酬。

scripts.text: Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?
scripts.translation: 哦！你一定正在参加训练。那么，你觉得训练怎么样？

scripts.text: I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.
scripts.translation: 我年轻时也参加过这种训练。这让我想起了美好的旧时光。

scripts.text: There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.
scripts.translation: 这里有各种训练项目，请选一个参加。冒险者通常都会选择自己熟悉的项目。

scripts.text: Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.
scripts.translation: 当你放松警惕时，意外就会发生。请务必时刻保持警惕。

scripts.text: I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation: 我认为对战士来说，最重要的是挑战精神。挑战自我，迈向更高境界...这才是关键。

scripts.text: A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.
scripts.translation: 以前普隆德拉的酒馆里很流行一首《战士之歌》。最近听不到了，真遗憾。

scripts.text: Do you like gambling by any chance? Doesn't the tension make you feel like a warrior in battle?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢赌博吗？那种紧张感，难道不像身处战场的战士吗？

scripts.text: Set to proceed with the Richard family quest.
scripts.translation: 已设置继续理查德家族的任务。

scripts.text: Reset the cooldown time of the Richard family battle training.
scripts.translation: 重置理查德家族战斗训练的冷却时间。
重置所有与理查德相关的任务。

scripts.text: Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation: 动！请配合接受安全检查。

scripts.text: Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...
scripts.translation: 请把证件和随身物品放在桌上，然后面朝墙站好...

scripts.text: Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.
scripts.translation: ？我说过别对我们的客人无礼！

scripts.text: It is for the safety of the queen.
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation: 你在女王身边是为了保护她，而不是无礼地赶走客人。

scripts.text: The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation: 宫里都乱成这样了，还抱着这种悠哉的想法，怎么保护女王！

scripts.text: We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation: 帝国法令期间，我们也只能照办！

scripts.text: Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...
scripts.translation: 如今的帝国法令简直就是...

scripts.text: I have something to you. Please talk to Jerad here.
scripts.translation: 我还有事要处理。请和杰拉德谈谈。

scripts.text: I don't know why but Scarlet and Lidion have been on bad terms for a long time.
scripts.translation: 不知道为什么，斯嘉丽和利迪昂已经很久不和了。

scripts.text: They are similar in age so that it would have been nice if they are friends...
scripts.translation: 他们年纪相仿，本来应该能成为朋友...

scripts.text: However, they both have such strong personalities.
scripts.translation: 可两个人的个性都太强了。

scripts.text: Of course, Scarlet looks several times younger.
scripts.translation: 当然，斯嘉丽看起来年轻许多

scripts.text: It is supposed to be the characteristic of the Jahas.
scripts.translation: 。这大概是雅哈一族的特征吧。

scripts.text: Ernst told me that he would go to the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 恩斯特说他要去宴会厅。不知道

scripts.text: I wonder if he is still there.
Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation: 您在这里还有别的事吗？

scripts.text: Please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation: 刚才给您添麻烦了，请见谅。

scripts.text: There was nothing suspicious found of your belongings.
scripts.translation: 歉。您的随身物品没有可疑之处。

scripts.text: Have you been going through it?
It doesn't hurt to be careful when there are a lot of passengers around here.
scripts.translation: 这里来往的人很多，小心些总没错。我

scripts.text: I don't want to experience such thing again.
If you don't mind, how about talking to the members of the Geoborg family in the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation: 如果您方便的话，能去宴会厅和吉奥伯格家族的人谈谈吗？

scripts.text: She has been taking care of the state affairs alone. Not to mention the Royal Assembly...
scripts.translation: 她一直独自处理国事，更别提还要主持皇家议会...

scripts.text: She hasn't been able to sleep for days.
scripts.translation: 她已经好几天没睡好了。

scripts.text: The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation: ！女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您或许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text: She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation: 她虽不是家族成员，却了解女王的一切。[保镖 杰拉德]

scripts.text: The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation: 哦！女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您或许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text: She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation: 她虽不是家族成员，却了解女王的一切。

scripts.text: The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation: ！女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您或许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text: She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation: 她虽不是家族成员，却了解女王的一切。

scripts.text: Scarlet is much older than the queen, but she doesn't look that old at all.
scripts.translation: 斯嘉丽比女王年长许多，但看起来一点也不显老。

scripts.text: Of course, the queen is well along in years now as well...
scripts.translation: 当然，女王如今也已经上了年纪...

scripts.text: I hope the queen and Ernst can take some rest now.
scripts.translation: 希望女王和恩斯特现在都能好好休息。

scripts.text: After the Royal Assembly is over, the queen may turn over the throne to the new king, and go to the castle of Scarlet.
scripts.translation: 皇家议会结束后，女王或许会把王位传给新国王，然后去斯嘉丽的城堡生活。

scripts.text: I am a little worried for that I have been serving under the queen my entire life.
scripts.translation: 我有些担心。毕竟我这一辈子都在女王身边服侍。

scripts.text: Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation: 您在这里还有别的事吗？

scripts.text: I am Queen Catherine D. Geoborg.
scripts.translation: 我是凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王。

scripts.text: I am sorry if my knights have caused you trouble.
scripts.translation: 骑士们若给您添了麻烦，我很抱歉。

scripts.text: They are a little sensitive these days. Please understand.
scripts.translation: 他们最近有些神经紧张，还请多包涵。
询问关于乔博格家族的事

scripts.text: Come back anytime if you have any other questions.
scripts.translation: 了。如果您还有其他问题，随时可以来找我。

scripts.text: Since the banquet for you heroes is being held in the Banquet Hall, please enjoy your time here.
scripts.translation: 宴会厅正在为各位英雄举办宴会，请尽情享受。

scripts.text: We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.
scripts.translation: 我们乔博格家族是建立这个王国的特里斯坦一世的后裔，世世代代都诞生过许多国王和骑士。

scripts.text: Don't you remember the trouble that all the family members have been through because of your attitude issue during the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation: 方式吗？你不记得皇家议会时，因为你的态度问题，全家人都惹上了多少麻烦吗？

scripts.text: If it is not my attitude, then for what?
scripts.translation: 如果不是因为我的态度，那是因为什么？

scripts.text: Do you mean that it is for my looks?
Can you deny it? Since you were young, when you are doing nothing, no, even when you are rude, people have been nice to you.
scripts.translation: 你能否认吗？从小到大，你什么都不用做——不，就算你态度恶劣，大家也会对你很好。

scripts.text: They all smiled at you to please the pretty-looking heir of the Wigner family, the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation: 他们都对你笑脸相迎，只为了讨好维格纳家族那位英俊的继承人、王位候选人。

scripts.text: You say that is for my looks?
scripts.translation: 你是说大家喜欢我只是因为长相？

scripts.text: Looks have played an important role. You cannot deny it. Looks are part of your talent, right?
scripts.translation: 长相确实起了很大作用，你无法否认。外表也是你的天赋之一，对吧？

scripts.text: Especially, in our family. You should know it by now.
scripts.translation: 尤其是在我们家，你应该早就明白了。

scripts.text: Even if it's all for my looks, have I ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation: 就算大家都是因为我的长相才喜欢我，我又什么时候希望事情变成这样的？

scripts.text: Even when I am not doing anything wrong, I am always compared to my handsome brother, and bad rumors follow me. Do you think I have ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation: 就算我没做错什么，大家也总拿我和英俊的哥哥比较，关于我的坏话也总是传个不停。你觉得我想这样吗？

scripts.text: That's why you need to open up to others and act nice...
scripts.translation: 所以你才应该敞开心扉，对别人友善一点...

scripts.text: The best way not to cause misunderstanding is to be silent. When I don't talk, I don't make a mistake.
scripts.translation: 避免被误解的最好办法就是沉默。不说话，就不会说错话。

scripts.text: That doesn't always work. About what happened today, you know. Even when you were silent...
scripts.translation: 沉默也不总是有用。就像今天的事，你明明什么都没说...

scripts.text: I am already doing my best! You know what? The darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light! It is just like me next to you! I have been trying!
scripts.translation: 我已经尽力了！你知道吗？最深的阴影总在最耀眼的光芒旁边，就像我站在你身边一样！我一直都在努力！

scripts.text: However, people don't see who I really am! What else should I do now?
scripts.translation: 可大家根本看不到真正的我！我还能怎么办？

scripts.text: Both of you should calm down.
scripts.translation: 你们两个都先冷静一下。

scripts.text: Yes. Whatever it is, you'd better calm down. I could hear you yelling at each other from the other end of the hallway.
scripts.translation: 没错，不管发生什么，你们都该冷静点。我在走廊那头都听见你们吵架了。

scripts.text: Our family is supposed to have a reputation to keep, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 我们家不是很重视名声吗？

scripts.text: What you have ruined last time is about to be recovered now, brother.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，你上次搞砸的事，现在总算要挽回了。

scripts.text: By the way, ^0000cdisn't it your box^000000, sister? It was on the table while there are a bunch of people hanging out. I kept it not to get it lost.
scripts.translation: 对了，姐姐，这不是你的盒子吗？刚才它放在桌上，周围又有很多人。我怕它丢了，就先替你收起来了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: This... ^0000cdWas it you who had taken it^000000?
You should have let me know when you were taking it. Do you know how much trouble I have been through for this?
scripts.translation: 你拿走时应该告诉我一声。你知道我为找它吃了多少苦头吗？

scripts.text: Wait, this is unfair! No? I have taken it with me for your sake, sister.
scripts.translation: 等等，这不公平吧？姐姐，我把它带在身上也是为了你好啊。

scripts.text: You know how our father gets furious if anything goes missing in our house!
scripts.translation: 你知道父亲发现家里有东西不见时会多生气！

scripts.text: He would go on and on about how we don't need a person who cannot manage even a small thing in the Wigner family and how management skill is the greatest virtue of our family... Just think about it scares me.
scripts.translation: 他会一直念叨，说维格纳家族不需要连小事都管不好的人，还说管理能力是家族最大的美德...光是想想就让我害怕。

scripts.text: What is in there? Why did you fuss about it so much?
scripts.translation: 里面到底是什么？你为什么这么在意？

scripts.text: There is nothing which is considered valuable by others in it. However, it is the most precious thing to me. Look.
scripts.translation: 里面没有别人眼中的贵重物品，但对我来说却是最珍贵的东西。你们看。

scripts.text: It is better to avoid a futile conversation. If you don't talk, you don't make mistakes. However, there are moments that you want to be honest with yourself.
scripts.translation: 与其进行徒劳的交谈，不如保持沉默。不说话就不会犯错。可是，有时人还是想对自己坦诚。

scripts.text: This diary has been capturing the moments that I want be true to myself.
scripts.translation: 这本日记记录了那些我想对自己坦诚的时刻。

scripts.text: Nevertheless, I still am mistaken by others even I stay quiet. I guess silence has not been the best policy after all. Since I have my diary back, I should get going.
scripts.translation: 即使我保持沉默，别人还是会误解我。看来沉默终究不是最好的办法。既然日记已经找回来了，我该走了。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text: That's all right now. I'll forget it all. You don't have to care about it either.
scripts.translation: 没关系，就当什么都没发生吧。你也不用放在心上。

scripts.text: She walks so fast. What was it all about?
scripts.translation: 她走得真快。刚才到底怎么回事？

scripts.text: It's all because you have taken the box without a word... Phew... Well, long story short, our sister is upset.
scripts.translation: 都怪你一声不吭就拿走了盒子...唉...简单来说，姐姐生气了。

scripts.text: It is complicated. I guess there are some bad rumors about her out there.
scripts.translation: 说来话长。我想外面流传着一些关于她的坏话。

scripts.text: Oh, I have heard about it before. However, I thought you would take care of it since it is mainly your fault.
scripts.translation: 哦，我以前听说过。不过我以为你会处理，毕竟主要是你的错。

scripts.text: You knew about that? Why didn't you tell me about it?
scripts.translation: 你知道这件事？为什么不告诉我？

scripts.text: Even if I did, you wouldn't have taken it seriously. It is true that you were born with that blessed looks.
scripts.translation: 就算告诉你，你也不会当回事。你确实天生就有一副令人羡慕的好相貌。

scripts.text: That's why the people around you have looked up to you. Not that our parents have been hard on us. No wonder you have grown up to be so carefree.
scripts.translation: 所以周围的人都仰慕你。倒不是父母对我们不好...难怪你长大后这么无忧无虑。

scripts.text: Are you picking up a fight with me?
No, listen to me. I am telling the truth here. No hard feelings.
scripts.translation: 不是，听我说。我只是在讲实话，别介意。

scripts.text: Due to your superlative looks, we have been quite disadvantaged, growing up.
scripts.translation: 因为你长得太出众，我们成长过程中一直很吃亏。

scripts.text: Do you remember what our sister has said? How the darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light? It is true.
scripts.translation: 你还记得姐姐说的吗？最深的阴影总在最耀眼的光芒旁边。她说得没错。

scripts.text: I don't get it. Beauty is a good thing. Everyone likes it.
scripts.translation: 我不明白。长得好看是好事，大家都喜欢。

scripts.text: The people who see it may appreciate it. However, the people right next to it are being compared to it.
scripts.translation: 旁人会欣赏那份美，可站在美人身边的人就会被拿来比较

scripts.text: Among the three of us, it must have been the hardest for our sister.
scripts.translation: 。我们三兄妹里，姐姐一定最难受。

scripts.text: Imagine a plain person standing next to an angelic beauty. Despite looking completely normal, she or he would look unattractive and somber. We have been compared to you like that, all our lives.
scripts.translation: 想象一个普通人站在天使般美丽的人旁边。明明一切正常，却会显得平庸阴沉。我们一辈子都被拿来和你这样比较。

scripts.text: Our sister must have suffered from the stress even more. She has managed to endure it with her extraordinary patience and generosity. In fact, I think she could be an angel.
scripts.translation: 姐姐承受的压力一定更大。她靠着非凡的耐心和宽容熬了过来。说真的，我觉得她简直像天使。

scripts.text: I didn't know that... At all..
scripts.translation: 我以前完全不知道...真的一点都不知道...

scripts.text: I don't think it is entirely your fault. It was our parents who have created you like that.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这也不能全怪你。毕竟是父母把你养成这样的。

scripts.text: Oh, well, you are to blame for your carefreeness though.
scripts.translation: 不过你确实该为自己的粗心负责。

scripts.text: Anyway, who we need to worry about is our sister. Has she ever been mad at us? What should we do when she is upset?
scripts.translation: 总之，现在该担心的是姐姐。她以前生过我们的气吗？她难过的时候，我们该怎么办？

scripts.text: Well, she has been mad at me once when I was young.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我小时候她有一次生过我的气

scripts.text: I guess it was somewhat similar to what has just happened. She said something about comparison then...
scripts.translation: 。好像和刚才的情况有些像，当时她也提到了被拿来比较...

scripts.text: I was too young to remember it. However, I do remember how our sister became very quiet after arguing with you.
scripts.translation: 我那时太小，不记得具体情况。不过我记得她和你吵完后就变得很沉默。

scripts.text: You have been the main culprit of it after all.
scripts.translation: 说到底，你才是主要原因。

scripts.text: It is not the time to waste time to distinguish between right and wrong. What should we do, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation: 现在不是浪费时间争论谁对谁错的时候。亲爱的冒险者，我们该怎么办？

scripts.text: I don't know. Have you ever tried to countervail someone's anger?
scripts.translation: 我也不知道。你试过想办法平息别人的怒气吗？

scripts.text: No. No one's ever been mad at me, except our sister.
scripts.translation: 没有。除了姐姐，从来没人对我发过火。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please help us out here.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，请帮帮我们吧。

scripts.text: Leave me out of it. I wasn't the one who got her mad.
scripts.translation: 别把我扯进来，又不是我惹她生气的。

scripts.text: You were the cause of the problem.
I was trying to keep it safe... Please, dear adventurer, help us!
scripts.translation: 我只是想替她保管好...亲爱的冒险者，求你帮帮我们！

scripts.text: What can you do? You'd better wait until your sister lets off steam... Or, you could try giving her something she likes...
scripts.translation: 你们能做什么？最好先等她消消气...或者，送她一件喜欢的东西也行...

scripts.text: What doesn't she like? Do you know?
I know as much as you do.
Which means you know nothing, great!
scripts.translation: 也就是说你什么都不知道，真有你的！

scripts.text: She seems to value experiences and memories. Don't you have any good memories with her? Trace back your memory back a little.
scripts.translation: 她似乎很珍惜经历和回忆。你们之间有什么美好的回忆吗？仔细回想一下吧。

scripts.text: Hum... Hum... There's no such... Wait! Yes, I remember one!
scripts.translation: 嗯...好像没有...等等！我想起来了！

scripts.text: Do you remember how we walked around the Comodo beach together during the summer vacation? We picked up some pretty stones on the shore and in the cave.
scripts.translation: 你还记得暑假时我们一起在克魔岛海滩散步吗？我们在岸边和洞穴里捡了些漂亮的石头。

scripts.text: Our sister really liked...This clear stone containing some sea water and a piece of coral inside.
scripts.translation: 姐姐特别喜欢那块透明的石头...里面封着海水和一片珊瑚。

scripts.text: Yes, that's it! She lined up those stones near the window and enjoyed looking at them glittering in the sun.
scripts.translation: 对，就是它！她把那些石头摆在窗边，喜欢看它们在阳光下闪闪发亮。

scripts.text: Oh, I remember now. I remember seeing them glittering in her room.
scripts.translation: 哦，我想起来了。我记得那些石头在她房间里闪闪发光。

scripts.text: It is a pretty stone which can only be found in Comodo. It is called the Sea Stone because it looks as if there is the sea captured inside of it, with the sea water and corals.
scripts.translation: 那是只能在克魔岛找到的漂亮石头。里面仿佛封存着大海，有海水和珊瑚，因此被称作大海之石。

scripts.text: Some romantics call it, the gift from a mermaid.
scripts.translation: 有些浪漫的人把它称为美人鱼的礼物。

scripts.text: You may find them upon digging the ground on the Comodo beach once in a while. Our sister, Isaac and I used to dig them out whenever we are on summer vacation.
scripts.translation: 偶尔能在克魔岛海滩挖到。我们三个以前每逢暑假都会去挖。

scripts.text: I have heard that it is not found on the beach these days. Instead, you can get it by killing the ^0000cdMedusa inside the cave in the west of Comodo^000000.
scripts.translation: 听说现在海滩上已经找不到了。如今得去克魔岛西边的洞穴打倒米杜沙才能获得。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What? Did the Medusa take them all?
scripts.translation: 什么？米杜沙把它们全拿走了吗？

scripts.text: Who knows? It is supposed to be the gift from a mermaid. Some say, the Mermen have given them to the Medusa. Well, this also sounds like a fairytale.
scripts.translation: 谁知道呢？大海之石据说是美人鱼的礼物。也有人说是海人族送给米杜沙的...听起来像童话吧。

scripts.text: How do you know it so well?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道得这么清楚？

scripts.text: I have once tried to distribute them all over the continent. You used to be able to get them by just digging the ground. Tourists used to pick them up as souvenirs or gamblers used to use them as talismans for their prayers to the sea-god.
scripts.translation: 我以前想把它们推广到大陆各地。那时只要挖土就能找到。游客会捡来当纪念品，赌徒则把它当作向海神祈祷的护身符。

scripts.text: Since it became hard to get them, I have given up the plan. The game is not worth the candle, having to kill the Medusa on the way.
scripts.translation: 后来它们变得很难找，我就放弃了。为了挖石头还得一路打倒米杜沙，实在得不偿失。

scripts.text: I didn't know that. Anyway, I remember there was something else next to the stone.
scripts.translation: 我还真不知道。对了，我记得石头旁边还有别的东西。

scripts.text: There were some flowers, a bunch of them. What flower was that? I lasted so long that it never seemed to wither at all.
scripts.translation: 好像有一大束花。那是什么花来着？放了那么久，似乎一直都没有枯萎。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you have any idea what flower that would have been?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你知道那会是什么花吗？

scripts.text: If it didn't whither for so long, it could have been a Witherless Rose.
scripts.translation: 如果一直没有枯萎，可能是永恒玫瑰。

scripts.text: Is there such a thing? Why do you need a Witherless Rose when you can just buy another flower before the older one withers?
scripts.translation: 还有这种东西？旧花枯萎前再买一朵新的不就好了，为什么非要永恒玫瑰？

scripts.text: You want what you like to last long. If you replace it with another flower, it is not the same flower you liked anymore.
scripts.translation: 人总希望喜欢的东西能长久。换成另一朵花，就不是原来那朵了。

scripts.text: Hum... Well, I guess I can imagine myself being replaced with another person. I understand it now.
scripts.translation: 嗯...如果我被别人取代，应该也能理解这种感觉了。我明白了。

scripts.text: So, when are you going to get them for us?
scripts.translation: 那你打算什么时候去帮我们找？

scripts.text: You didn't think that we would go there to get them ourselves, did you?
scripts.translation: 你不会以为我们要亲自去找吧？

scripts.text: I am busy with my business, and Jurgen attracts too many people around him.
scripts.translation: 我忙着做生意，尤尔根身边又总围着一大群人。

scripts.text: We need someone else we can trust, who happens to be right in front of us.
scripts.translation: 我们正好需要一个值得信赖的人，而这样的人就在眼前。

scripts.text: I was worried about it as well. Please, dear adventurer, help us. The loving relationship among us depends on you.
scripts.translation: 我也正担心这件事呢。亲爱的冒险者，请帮帮我们。我们兄妹能不能和好就靠你了。

scripts.text: If you say so... How many of them do you need? Where can I get the Sea Stone?
scripts.translation: 既然你们这么说...需要多少？大海之石要去哪里找？

scripts.text: Hum... I guess we need ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000 and ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000 since we want to decorate the window with them.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我们想用它们装饰窗边，所以需要1朵永恒玫瑰和10块大海之石。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you came! Did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你来了！带了我们拜托的东西吗？拜托你说带了。

scripts.text: I wasn't able to bring them all.
Why? Did you forget what to bring by any chance? Let me tell you once more.
scripts.translation: 为什么？你是不是忘了要带什么？我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text: ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000. You can get them while hunting Medusa in Comodo. They are valuable because it is difficult to kill Medusa.
scripts.translation: 10块大海之石。去克魔岛打米杜沙时可以获得。米杜沙很难对付，所以这些石头很珍贵。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I know that's a lot of things to bring, but I believe we need them all to make our sister feel better.
scripts.translation: 我知道要带的东西不少，但我相信只有凑齐这些，才能让姐姐开心起来。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你带来我们拜托的东西了吗？拜托你说带来了。

scripts.text: Yes, please tell us that you did. We tried our best to balance out her anger. However, she's been giving the cold shoulder to us.
scripts.translation: 是啊，快说带来了吧。我们已经尽力想让姐姐消气，可她还是一直对我们爱理不理。

scripts.text: I brought them. You'd better not to press an angry person so impatiently like that, you know.
scripts.translation: 我带来了。对生气的人可别这么着急地催促，你们懂的。

scripts.text: Whoa, they are all here! You saved our lives. We should call our sister now. What if she is still mad at us...
scripts.translation: 哇，全都带来了！你真是救了我们一命。我们现在就叫姐姐过来。万一她还在生气怎么办...

scripts.text: Why do you keep calling me? Please leave me alone for that I am not mad at you any more.
scripts.translation: 你们为什么一直叫我？让我一个人静一静吧，我已经不生气了。

scripts.text: Sister, forgive us. Please stop being mad at us.
scripts.translation: 姐姐，请原谅我们。别再生我们的气了。

scripts.text: ...Do you know what you have done wrong?
scripts.translation: ...你们知道自己做错了什么吗？

scripts.text: I don't think I am to blame, but I am sorry that I have taken your stuff without telling you.
scripts.translation: 我觉得我不该受责备，不过没告诉你就拿走你的东西，确实是我不对。

scripts.text: Well, I am sorry about it all. I haven't been considerate of your feelings. However, it wouldn't have hurt you to open up to me a little, since we are family.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这一切都是我的错。我没有顾及你的感受。不过我们毕竟是一家人，你也可以稍微对我敞开心扉。

scripts.text: If we don't be honest to each other, we will just grow away. We will get our wires crossed again.
scripts.translation: 如果我们不坦诚相待，就会渐渐疏远，也会再次产生误会。

scripts.text: You are right. I have given it a thought as well. I think some part of it is my fault. I should have been honest with you, at least.
scripts.translation: 你说得对。我也想过了，觉得自己也有错。至少，我应该坦诚地告诉你们。

scripts.text: When we were young, we used to talk a lot, and have some good times. Look at these. We used to run around looking for things like these. Do you remember this stone? You liked to watch them glitter in the sun.
scripts.translation: 小时候我们常聊天，也有过很多快乐时光。看这些，我们以前总会到处找这样的石头。还记得这块吗？你喜欢看它们在阳光下闪闪发亮。

scripts.text: They are.. When did you get them...?
scripts.translation: 这些是...你什么时候找到的...？

scripts.text: The adventurer helped us. I guess those were the times when we were the closest to one another. Look at this.
scripts.translation: 多亏冒险者帮忙。我想那时我们最亲近了。看这个。这

scripts.text: This stone is so clear that you can see the seawater and coral reef inside right through it.
scripts.translation: 块石头很透明，能直接看到里面的海水和珊瑚。

scripts.text: I think people are just the same. We don't need to show everything, but we do need to show some to let others know how pretty we are inside.
scripts.translation: 我觉得人也一样。不必什么都展示出来，但总该让别人看到一些，知道我们的内心也很美好。

scripts.text: Yes, you are right. I think you have got the point. I'll try. I'll do it to avoid any more misunderstanding.
scripts.translation: 你说得对。我想我明白你的意思了。我会试着改变，避免再发生误会。

scripts.text: By the way, when did you learn to talk like that? I think I am finally able to talk with you guys now.
scripts.translation: 对了，你什么时候变得这么会说话了？我觉得现在终于能和你们好好聊聊了。

scripts.text: You mean, you haven't been able to talk with us?
scripts.translation: 你是说以前一直没法和我们好好说话吗？

scripts.text: Well, thanks to my effort, we brothers and sister have become close to one another again.
scripts.translation: 嗯，多亏我努力，我们兄妹又亲近起来了。亲爱的冒

scripts.text: Thank you for your work, dear adventurer. This is not much, but I hope you take it. Sorry about all the trouble you have been through for us.
scripts.translation: 险者，谢谢你帮忙。这点谢礼不算什么，希望你收下。让你为我们费心了，真抱歉。

scripts.text: Material reward has never seems to small before.
scripts.translation: 以前我从没觉得物质上的谢礼如此微

scripts.text: I guess what you have done for us is just that priceless.
scripts.translation: 不足道。你为我们做的一切实在无价。

scripts.text: I am sorry to cause such an embarrassing scene in front of you. If you have time, please come by again. We will make sure to receive you properly next time.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉让你看到这么尴尬的一幕。有空请再来，下次我们一定好好招待你。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I have learned new lessons and earned many things, thanks to you. If you need our help, we will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you luck!
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，多亏了你，我学到了很多，也收获良多。如果你需要我们帮忙，我们一定尽力。祝你好运！

scripts.text: Are you enjoying the banquet? Do you need any help by any chance?
scripts.translation: ，欢迎。宴会还愉快吗？需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text: No. I just wanted to talk to you for a second.
scripts.translation: 没什么，只是想和你聊几句

scripts.text: I wonder how your sister is doing these days as well.
scripts.translation: 。也想问问你妹妹最近怎么样。

scripts.text: Thanks to your help, we have never been better than this.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你的帮忙，我们兄妹的关系比以往都好

scripts.text: I've been talking to my sister much more, and..
I am sorry. I thought no one was here. I just wanted to clean the room, I am really sorry. I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我以为里面没人。我只是来打扫房间的，真的很抱歉。我晚点再来。

scripts.text: Not at all. Please come in. It is a nonsense that you cannot clean the room because of the people inside.
scripts.translation: 没关系，请进。不能因为有人在里面就不打扫房间。

scripts.text: Hello, long time no see. Sorry about the trouble you went through last time. Fortunately, the box thing has been resolved well.
scripts.translation: 你好，好久不见。上次让你费心了，抱歉。幸好盒子的事已经顺利解决了。

scripts.text: Is this the person from the last time? Whom you asked about the box...?
scripts.translation: 这就是上次那个人吗？就是你问过盒子事情的那位？

scripts.text: I am sorry about that. We were desperate and in a hurry. I apologize if you were upset by it.
scripts.translation: 那件事很抱歉。当时我们又急又慌。如果让你不高兴了，我向你道歉。

scripts.text: Thank you for telling me that. Since I am a maid, there are people who suspect me or treat me like a thief.
scripts.translation: 谢谢您告诉我这些。我只是个女仆，有些人会怀疑我，甚至把我当成小偷。

scripts.text: However, you seem different, dear prince. I am a little surprised. I thought people who belong to the high society didn't know how to apologize.
scripts.translation: 不过，王子殿下，您似乎不一样。我有些惊讶，一直以为上流社会的人都不会道歉。

scripts.text: Oh, it was very presumptuous of me.
I am supposed to clean the room when there is no one inside anyway. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation: 。反正房间里没人时我还得来打扫，请见谅。

scripts.text: You shouldn't have to... Well, she's gone...
Well, I think ^0000cdI have fallen in love^000000 .
I have never met anyone who looks directly into my eyes like that.
scripts.translation: 我从没遇过一个人，能那样直视我的眼睛。

scripts.text: I fell in love with her. I love her dignified and calm voice. Unaffected behaviors That tone of voice reflecting strong will...
scripts.translation: 我爱上她了。我喜欢她端庄沉静的声音、自然不做作的举止，还有那透着坚定意志的语气...

scripts.text: All the women I have seen so far are like flowers in the greenhouse. However, she resembles a wild flower in the field.
scripts.translation: 我见过的女人都像温室里的花，可她就像田野中的野花。

scripts.text: She is totally different from the ladies I have met before.
scripts.translation: 她和我以前认识的那些贵族小姐截然不同。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer! How can I tell someone I have fallen in love at first sight how I feel? Should I go take her hands and say I love her?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者！要怎么向一见钟情的人表达心意？我该不该牵起她的手，告诉她我爱她？

scripts.text: What? You don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation: 什么？你对这种事一窍不通？

scripts.text: She is my ^0000cdfirst love^000000. My life will never be the same since I have met her.
scripts.translation: 她是我的初恋。遇见她之后，我的人生就不一样了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hum... Try to remember what all the people outside the door have done to you.
scripts.translation: 嗯...想想门外那些人都对你做过什么。

scripts.text: Well... Nothing that I can recall... Hum... There have been some impressive people though. There was this person who penetrated defense and hid behind the curtain in my room...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我想不起来有什么特别的...不过有些人确实令人印象深刻。有人突破防守，躲到我房间的窗帘后面...

scripts.text: Hum... That's impressive. However, it is a crime. You should forget it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...真厉害。不过那是犯罪，还是忘了吧。

scripts.text: There was this person who sent me a life-size golden statue. I sent it back since I didn't need it and it didn't look as good as real me.
scripts.translation: 有人送过我一尊等身大的金像。我不需要，而且它看起来也不如真人帅，所以就退回去了。

scripts.text: How about sending her a gold statue looking exactly like me?
scripts.translation: 要不我送她一尊和我一模一样的金像？

scripts.text: She will be repelled if you try too hard like that from the very beginning. How about sending her a ^0000cdletter^000000 with a small gift?
scripts.translation: 一开始就这么卖力，会把她吓跑的。不如寄一封信，再附上一件小礼物？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It is a good idea! Please wait a moment!
Did you forget? If I take a step out of that door, I'll draw attention.
scripts.translation: 你忘了吗？我只要一走出那扇门，就会引起大家注意。

scripts.text: It would cause her trouble, wouldn't it. By the way, I didn't even get the chance to ask her what her name was.
scripts.translation: 那样反而会给她添麻烦。对了，我甚至还没来得及问她叫什么名字。

scripts.text: Please send this letter to her with this box containing jewelry.
scripts.translation: 请把这封信和装着珠宝的盒子一起送给她。

scripts.text: It will be difficult. I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 这有点困难，我还有别的事要做。

scripts.text: Sorry about the difficult request. I guess I should go there myself. You may be able to see the news that the heir of the Wigner family has been crushed to death by his followers on Daily Rune-Midgarts tomorrow morning.
scripts.translation: 抱歉拜托你这么难办的事。看来我只能亲自去了。明天早上，你或许会在《卢恩·米德加兹日报》上看到维格纳家族继承人被狂热粉丝压死的新闻。

scripts.text: Or, the poor maid could be hospitalized by tomorrow. Anyway, I understand.
scripts.translation: 或者那位可怜的女仆明天就得住院。总之，我理解。

scripts.text: OK. I should get going then.
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you. How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者！我一直在等你。事情怎么样了？她也说喜欢我了吗？

scripts.text: No, I haven't been able to meet her yet. Let me go see her again.
scripts.translation: 不，我还没能见到她。我再去找她看看。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者！我一直在等你。

scripts.text: How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation: 事情怎么样了？她也说喜欢我了吗？

scripts.text: No, actually... She ^0000cdturned it down^000000. She returned what you had sent her as well.
scripts.translation: 不，其实...她拒绝了，还把你送的东西退了回来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Why? Did she say that she didn't like my looks? Or wasn't what I had sent her enough for her?
scripts.translation: 为什么？她说不喜欢我的长相吗？还是我送的东西不够好？

scripts.text: No, not that... She has said she is currently not in the situation to go out with someone. She seems to have a reason.
scripts.translation: 不是那样...她说目前不适合和别人交往，似乎另有原因。

scripts.text: Does she already have a boyfriend? I am not surprised. She is so attractive after all. No wonder I have fallen for her.
scripts.translation: 她已经有男朋友了吗？我倒不意外，毕竟她那么迷人。难怪我会爱上她。

scripts.text: No, not that either... She just has said she is currently not in the situation to date someone.
scripts.translation: 也不是...她只是说目前不适合和别人约会。

scripts.text: Whoa... ^0000cdIt is my first time to want something so badly in this life^000000. Never did I know that it would be so difficult to get.
scripts.translation: 天哪...这是我这辈子第一次如此渴望得到某样东西，没想到实现起来这么难 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Is living such a difficult thing?
However, my father has told me that I should always try at least three times.
scripts.translation: 不过父亲告诉过我，无论什么事，至少要尝试三次。

scripts.text: First try to begin, second try to confirm and the third try to give up since it is not meant to be.
scripts.translation: 第一次是为了开始，第二次是为了确认，第三次则是为了放弃，因为那注定不属于自己。

scripts.text: So, dear adventurer. Please do this one more time for me.
scripts.translation: 所以，亲爱的冒险者，请再帮我一次。

scripts.text: Well, I think you should write the letter again...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我想你应该重新写一封信...

scripts.text: I need something special. Something pretty and shiny which reflects my feelings...
scripts.translation: 我需要特别的东西，一件漂亮又闪亮、能表达我心意的东西...

scripts.text: I want to send her ^0000cdthe heart that is as wide and beautiful as the sea^000000 and ^0000cdthe amaranthine heart for her^000000.
scripts.translation: 我想送她如大海般广阔美丽的心，以及永不凋零的爱意。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Should I go get them all myself as well?
scripts.translation: 难道还要我亲自去把它们都找来？

scripts.text: Please, dear adventurer, be the messenger of love for me. Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，请做我的爱情信使吧。替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text: If you say so, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 既然你这么说，那我就去吧。

scripts.text: Please send her my letter with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation: 请把这封信和15颗大海之石、1朵永恒玫瑰一起送给她。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: As I told you before, you can get the Sea Stone from killing Medusa.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前说的，大海之石可以通过击败米杜沙获得。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I will never forget this and make it up to you. We, Wigners, never forget any debt.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，我不会忘记这份恩情，一定会报答你。我们维格纳家族从不欠人情。

scripts.text: Not that I am doing it expecting something in return, but I will deliver them to her since you look so desperate.
scripts.translation: 我可不是为了回报才帮忙的，不过看你这么着急，我就替你送去吧。

scripts.text: Thank you! Oh, do you happen to get her name by any chance?
scripts.translation: 谢谢！对了，你知道她叫什么名字吗？

scripts.text: ^0000cdMary^000000. It is a common but pretty name. What is common means that it is well loved by many people. I'll get all my things embroidered with this name from now on.
scripts.translation: 玛丽。普通又好听的名字。所谓普通，就是很多人都喜欢。从今以后，我要把这个名字绣在所有东西上。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you may set off now. Please deliver my feelings to her safely.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你可以出发了。请把我的心意平安送到她那里。

scripts.text: Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation: 你把我的心意平安送给玛丽了吗？你回来得真快。

scripts.text: Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation: 你需要带15颗通过击败米杜沙获得的大海之石，以及1朵永恒玫瑰。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right? Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation: 玛丽收到这些普通的礼物，应该不会觉得不自在吧？请替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text: I couldn't stop thinking about her even while you were gone.
scripts.translation: 来了！你不在的时候，我满脑子都是她。

scripts.text: Even when I eat, drink a tea, look into the mirror and talking to other people! I though about her all day. It was painful but I was in a flutter.
scripts.translation: 无论是吃饭、喝茶、照镜子还是和别人说话，我整天都在想着她！虽然很煎熬，心里却又小鹿乱撞。

scripts.text: That's what falling in love is like.
Oh, then I must have been doing bad things to numerous people. There is nothing I can do for them.
scripts.translation: 哦，那我一定辜负过很多人的心意。我也没办法补偿她们了。

scripts.text: By the way, since your hands are empty, I guess she has accepted my heart at last!
scripts.translation: 对了，你两手空空地回来，看来她终于接受我的心意了！

scripts.text: Well, hum... She didn't react negatively, but you'd better be careful since you don't know each other yet.
scripts.translation: 嗯...她没有表现出反感，但你们还不熟，最好谨慎些。

scripts.text: Why don't you spare her some time?
She must have not accepted my heart completely then. I am all right though! She hasn't turned me down yet!
scripts.translation: 看来她还没有完全接受我的心意。不过没关系！至少她还没拒绝我！

scripts.text: I didn't know how painful it was to love someone. I did know how I would be fidgety about a word or gesture of her.
scripts.translation: 我以前不知道爱一个人会这么痛苦，也没想到自己会因为她的一句话、一个动作而坐立不安。

scripts.text: It is true. Winning someone's heart is the hardest thing.
scripts.translation: 确实如此。赢得一个人的心是最难的事。

scripts.text: I guess I should be nicer to the people who like me.
scripts.translation: 我想我应该对那些喜欢我的人好一点。

scripts.text: I don't think that is a good idea...
Dear adventurer, thank you again. Would you come by again tomorrow?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，再次谢谢你。明天还会再来吗？

scripts.text: It seems like a good sign. Paddle as the wave approaches. That's one of the many mottos of our family.
scripts.translation: 这似乎是个好兆头。趁浪头到来时划桨，这是我们家族格言之一。

scripts.text: I want to let her know of my blazing heart every day.
scripts.translation: 我想每天都让她知道我这颗炽热的心。

scripts.text: I have a feeling that everything will turn out great if you send it for me.
scripts.translation: 我觉得只要你替我送去，一切都会顺利的。

scripts.text: How about allowing her some time?
What if she forgets about me? Then, please send her my message once a day. You wouldn't say no, right?
scripts.translation: 万一她把我忘了怎么办？请每天替我给她捎个口信，好吗？你不会拒绝吧？

scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot. It is not much, but please accept this as my token of gratitude for the messenger of my love.
scripts.translation: 哦，差点忘了。礼物不算贵重，请收下这点谢意，感谢你做我的爱情信使。

scripts.text: Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation: 你把我的心意平安送给玛丽了吗？你这么快就回来了。

scripts.text: Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation: 你需要带15颗通过击败米杜沙获得的大海之石，以及1朵永恒玫瑰。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right?
scripts.translation: 玛丽收到这些普通的礼物，应该不会觉得不自在吧？

scripts.text: Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation: 请替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I'd like to call you who has delivered my message of love to her, the ^0000cdMessenger of Love^000000.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，我想称呼你这位替我传递爱意的人为爱情信使。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: On the day Mary accepts my feelings, I would like to give you a huge pure gold statue.
scripts.translation: 等玛丽接受我的心意时，我要送你一座巨大的纯金雕像。

scripts.text: You really don't have to do that.
However, this is the only thing I can offer you for now. Please visit our manor later. There are some real valuable things.
scripts.translation: 不过这就是我现在唯一能送你的东西。稍后请到我们庄园来，那里有真正珍贵的东西。

scripts.text: Then dear adventurer, I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 那么，亲爱的冒险者，明天再见。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, what brought you here around this time? May I help you?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，这个时间来有什么事吗？我能帮上忙吗？

scripts.text: Are you here to deliver my message of love to Mary?
scripts.translation: 你是来替我向玛丽传达爱意的吗？

scripts.text: Oh, well, it was you who had said that she would be repelled by my impatience.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，是你说我太着急会让她反感。

scripts.text: I am trying hard not to send her my love letter every minute and second. Please comeback when the time comes.
scripts.translation: 我正在努力克制自己，不每分每秒都给她写情书。等时机到了再来吧。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you came! It seems that something good may happen today.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你来了！看来今天会有好事发生。

scripts.text: Please deliver her the message of my love with deliver my message of love with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation: 请把我的爱意和15颗大海之石、1朵永恒玫瑰一起送给她。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you remember? You can get the Sea Stone by killing Medusa.
scripts.translation: 还记得吗？击败米杜沙就能得到大海之石。

scripts.text: Please send them to her and tell me how Mary is doing today. I am sad that she doesn't come here to clean the room anymore.
scripts.translation: 请把这些交给她，再告诉我玛丽今天过得怎么样。她不再来这里打扫房间，我有些失落。

scripts.text: I want to go see her myself. However, I guess she will feel uncomfortable.
scripts.translation: 我也想亲自去见她，可我想她会觉得不自在。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I am depending on you!
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，就拜托你了！

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, we are honored to have you with us. Have you met our father who is the head of the Wigner family?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，欢迎来到我们家。您见过维格纳家族的家主，也就是我的父亲了吗？

scripts.text: How about meeting Jurgen, the hair of the Wigner family who is participating in the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation: 要不要去见见正在参加皇家议会的维格纳家族继承人尤尔根？

scripts.text: Then, have a comfortable time in the Wigner family.
scripts.translation: 那么，请在维格纳家好好休息。

scripts.text: Sister, please calm down. Where did you put it? Are you sure you have left it here?
scripts.translation: 姐姐，先冷静一下。你把它放在哪里了？确定是放在这里吗？

scripts.text: Here, I have left it right here! After talking to the adventurer, I put it here and... It was gone... Where did it go?
scripts.translation: 我明明就放在这里！和冒险者谈完后，我就把它放在这儿了...怎么不见了...到底去哪儿了？

scripts.text: My jewelry box... Well, it is technically not a jewelry box since it doesn't hold any jewelry in it, but anyways, ^0000cda small box containing something very important is missing.^000000
scripts.translation: 我的首饰盒...虽说里面其实没装首饰，总之，一个装着重要东西的小盒子不见了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I took it out of my bag and out it here. Then it was gone. What should I do? I don't know what I should do without it... I cannot afford to let anyone see it...
scripts.translation: 我从包里拿出来放在这里，然后就不见了。我该怎么办？没有它我真不知道该怎么办...我不能让任何人看到里面的东西...

scripts.text: It could be the ^0000cdmaid^000000 who came here earlier to clean the room. She may have taken it.
scripts.translation: 会不会是刚才来打扫房间的女仆拿走了？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You haven't seen her taking it. You shouldn't doubt other people without proof.
scripts.translation: 你又没看到她拿走。没有证据就不该怀疑别人。

scripts.text: Not that I am suspicious of her, but it may help to ask her. If she saw it or when was the last time she saw it...
scripts.translation: 我不是怀疑她，不过问问她也许能有帮助。比如她有没有看到，或最后一次看到是什么时候...

scripts.text: Please don't. She would be upset if she feels that she is being suspected.
scripts.translation: 请别这么做。她会觉得我们在怀疑她，一定会很难过。

scripts.text: But you are being so nervous. Isn't it an important thing to you?
scripts.translation: 可你这么紧张，这东西对你很重要吧？

scripts.text: You really need to get it back, right?
scripts.translation: 你很想把它找回来，对吧？

scripts.text: I'll make sure to ask her about it as politely as possible. Please relax and wait here.
scripts.translation: 我会尽量礼貌地问她。请放松些，在这里等我。

scripts.text: I don't know if is the best idea. I don't want her to feel that we are suspecting her.
scripts.translation: 我不知道这是不是个好主意。我不想让她觉得我们怀疑她。

scripts.text: Just wait until the adventurer comes back. The adventurer is really experienced in this kind of stuff.
scripts.translation: 等冒险者回来吧。冒险者很有处理这类事情的经验。

scripts.text: Then, please help me, dear adventurer. I'll go search other pleases then.
scripts.translation: ..那就拜托你了，亲爱的冒险者。我去别的地方找找。

scripts.text: Please, help her. I have heard that ^0000cdthe maids are in the kitchen^000000.
scripts.translation: 请帮帮她。我听说女仆们都在厨房。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I should have taken better care of it...
Please make sure not to hurt other people's feelings.
scripts.translation: 请别伤害其他人的感情。

scripts.text: I would like to go find it myself, but I am not in the situation to do that...
scripts.translation: 我也想亲自去找，但现在不方便...

scripts.text: I don't even want to imagine anyone else sees it though...
scripts.translation: 我甚至不敢想象被别人看到里面的东西...

scripts.text: I would be embarrassed to death.
scripts.translation: 那会让我羞愧得无地自容。

scripts.text: Ah, it was you, dear adventurer. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation: ！啊，是你啊，亲爱的冒险者。抱歉。

scripts.text: Your feeling must have been hurt by your brothers.
scripts.translation: 你的兄弟们一定伤了你的心。

scripts.text: I am... I am just angry at myself.
Something like this never would have happened if was more careful...
scripts.translation: 如果我再小心一点，这种事根本不会发生.

scripts.text: Moreover, I shouldn't have said such things to my brothers either.
scripts.translation: ..而且我也不该对兄弟们说那样的话。

scripts.text: However, I couldn't take it anymore when I heard the rumors and Jurgen's attitude...
scripts.translation: 可是听到那些流言，再看到尤尔根的态度，我实在忍不下去了...

scripts.text: I thought I was used to those things... I guess I am not.
scripts.translation: 我以为自己早就习惯了...看来并没有。

scripts.text: I should have given it up by now...
Oh, I am sorry. I believe you haven't come here to listen to a story like this.
scripts.translation: ..啊，抱歉。我想你不是特地来听我说这些的。

scripts.text: I am sorry, but I want to be alone for now.
scripts.translation: 对不起，我现在只想一个人待着。拜

scripts.text: Thanks to you, we have become closer to one another now.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，我们现在亲近多了。我也能更

scripts.text: Now I can open up to my brothers more.
scripts.translation: 敞开心扉地和兄弟们交流了。

scripts.text: I have tried to hide my feelings and save my words. However, I have realized that It is not the best policy.
scripts.translation: 我一直压抑感受、尽量少说话，但我明白了这并不是最好的办法。从

scripts.text: From now own, I am going to tell them how I feel to avoid any misunderstanding.
scripts.translation: 今以后，我会告诉他们我的想法，避免再产生误会。

scripts.text: I believe I haven't met you before. Are you here to see my father?
scripts.translation: 我想我们之前没见过。您是来见我父亲的吗？

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you know the old saying that the emptier it is, the more you can fill it?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你听过“越空的容器，越能装下东西”这句老话吗

scripts.text: It is one of the many aphorisms passing down in our family.
scripts.translation: ？这是我们家族代代相传的格言之一。

scripts.text: Oh, welcome, dear adventurer, my brother is over there...
scripts.translation: 哦，欢迎，亲爱的冒险者。我哥哥在那边...

scripts.text: No. I am here to see you, Isaac.
scripts.translation: 不，我是来见你的，艾萨克。

scripts.text: Yes. How did you know it...?
Wolf is not here even after the time he has promised. He is the man of his word. Something must have happened to him.
scripts.translation: 狼已经过了约定时间还没来。他一向言而有信，一定是出了什么事。

scripts.text: I never expected you would come here instead though. So is he cancelling the appointment today then?
scripts.translation: 不过我没想到你会亲自来这里。他今天是取消约定了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, he is. And he asked me to get ^0000cda certain thing^000000 from you, Isaac.
scripts.translation: 是的，他取消了。他让我向你，艾萨克，取一样东西。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That thing...? Wolf must trust you, dear adventurer. Or it could be...
scripts.translation: 那样东西...？狼一定很信任你，亲爱的冒险者。或者，这是...？

scripts.text: Don't take it the wrong way. I am just be careful. In order to do what I do, I need to know who I can trust first.
scripts.translation: 别误会，我只是谨慎行事。要做我正在做的事，首先得知道谁值得信任。

scripts.text: You can bring it to Wolf. Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation: 你可以把东西交给狼。请小心保管。

scripts.text: May I ask you for one more thing? I have heard that there is ^0000cda strange rumor^000000 circulating in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 我还能再拜托你一件事吗？我听说普隆德拉正在流传奇怪的传闻。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It is supposed to be about ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000. Would you investigate about the rumor and let me know the truth?
scripts.translation: 据说和赫尔穆特·罗根堡有关。能调查一下传闻，告诉我真相吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Since I have a reputation to keep. I cannot afford to have a scandal. Please help me.
scripts.translation: 我得维护自己的名声，不能惹上丑闻。请帮帮我。

scripts.text: Have you deliver the thing to Wolf safely? You should be careful with it since it can be dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你把东西安全交给狼了吗？那东西可能很危险，要小心。

scripts.text: And, don't forget to ask about the rumor as well.
scripts.translation: 还有，别忘了打听那个传闻。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你回来了。东西安全交给他了吗？他对传闻怎么说？

scripts.text: Here is the document about that. Here... It was. Wait, I must have forget to bring it with me. I am sorry. I'll be back with it soon.
scripts.translation: 这是那件事的文件。在这里...咦？等等，我好像忘了带。抱歉，我马上回去拿。

scripts.text: Such things happen. Take your time. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 这种事难免会发生。慢慢来，我会等你的。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你回来了。东西安全交给他了吗？他对传闻怎么说？

scripts.text: Here is the ^0000cddocument^000000 about it. It is written by Wolf Roegenburg himself.
scripts.translation: 这是相关的文件，出自沃尔夫·罗根堡本人之手。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Let's see... Hum... So the new business will be delayed indefinitely. The direction of the business will be changed.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯...看来新业务要无限期推迟，经营方向也会改变。

scripts.text: I'll see you again after taking care of the matters. - W. R.
scripts.translation: 处理好事情后，我会再与你见面。——W. R.

scripts.text: It means that he would stop the deal about the war, right? The rumor must have been quite threatening.
scripts.translation: 这意味着他要取消有关战争的交易，对吧？那个传闻一定造成了很大影响。

scripts.text: I feel sorry. It would have been a great chance for me to impress my family.
scripts.translation: 真遗憾，本来是我向家族证明自己的好机会。

scripts.text: Well, I believe Wolf would find a better direction to the business. Please tell Wolf that I support his decision. And that I am excited about his new business.
scripts.translation: 不过，我相信狼会找到更好的经营方向。请告诉他，我支持他的决定，也期待他的新业务。

scripts.text: It was a great opportunity for me and Wolf.
scripts.translation: 这原本是我和狼的大好机会。

scripts.text: However, since my partner wants to quit, I shouldn't force him to carry on with it.
scripts.translation: 不过既然搭档想退出，我也不该强迫他继

scripts.text: I believe that Wolf must already have the plan about the next business item in his mind.
scripts.translation: 续。我相信狼已经在考虑下一项生意了。

scripts.text: That's why I accepted his suggestion to be partners in business.
scripts.translation: 所以我才接受了他的提议，和他合伙做生意。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, since you are here to the Wigner family, why don't you go meet some other members of the family?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，既然你来到维格纳家了，不妨去见见其他家人吧。

scripts.text: Like my parents, my brother who is the candidate to the throne or my sister who is the eldest child.
scripts.translation: 比如我的父母、作为王位候选人的哥哥，或身为长女的姐姐。

scripts.text: I believe that you would have more productive time with them.
scripts.translation: 我相信和他们相处会更有收获。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring what I had asked you?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你带来我拜托的东西了吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to go get them myself or ask other people to do it. But, I feel a little uncomfortable since it is a family matter.
scripts.translation: 我本想自己去拿，或让别人代劳，但这毕竟是家事，我有点不好意思。

scripts.text: I know how it is troubling you, but please help us. You have not forgotten what to bring, have you?
scripts.translation: 我知道这让你为难，但还是请帮帮我们。你还记得要带什么吗？

scripts.text: You need to bring ^0000cd10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation: 你需要带10块大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Our fate depends on you! We may be able to get along again or we may become distant.
scripts.translation: 我们的命运就交给你了！我们可能重归于好，也可能从此疏远。

scripts.text: Please bring them to us as soon as possible!
Thanks to you, my brother and sister have become close to each other again.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，哥哥和姐姐又亲近起来了。要是没有

scripts.text: What would they do without me?
Dear adventurer, I'll see you around then.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，那我们回头见。

scripts.text: Is it your first time to visit the Wigner family?
scripts.translation: 这是你第一次来维格纳家吗？那么，

scripts.text: Then, ^0000cdyou should meet our parents^000000 over there first.
scripts.translation: 000cd先去那边见见我们的父母吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I couldn't shake hands with Jurgen! Oh, it's too hot!
scripts.translation: 我没能和尤尔根握手！啊，好烫！

scripts.text: Oh, you shouldn't bring too much stuff in here.
scripts.translation: 哦，你不该带这么多东西进

scripts.text: As you see there are a lot of fragile things.
You need to leave some out. It would be a big problem if the bundle touches the dishes and breaks them.
scripts.translation: 有些东西得放在外面。要是包裹碰到餐具把它们打碎，就麻烦了。

scripts.text: I am cleaning the kitchen now, which is the hardest place to clean. It is really difficult to get rid of all the dirt in here.
scripts.translation: 我正在打扫厨房，这里是最难清理的地方。要清除所有污垢可不容易。

scripts.text: My arms are way too weak to handle it.
I happen to see someone with a strong set of arms... Those arms... What brought you here?
scripts.translation: 我刚好看到一位手臂很有力的人...那双手臂...你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Hello, I am the adventurer invited to the royal banquet. Are you the maid who have cleaned the Wigner residence this afternoon?
scripts.translation: 你好，我是受邀参加皇家宴会的冒险者。你是今天下午打扫维格纳宅邸的女仆吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am. What can I do for you?
Did you happen to see ^0000cda small box^000000 in the Wigner residence? It was supposed to be on the table next to the bed. The box belongs to Princess Katrin. Have you seen it?
scripts.translation: 你有没有在维格纳宅邸看到一个小盒子？它原本放在床边的桌上，是卡特琳公主的。你见过吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes, I have. It was the box which looked simple but classy. I held it up for a second to clean the table and put it down. I remember it.
scripts.translation: 见过。那是个看起来朴素却很有格调的盒子。我擦桌子时把它拿起来过一下，之后又放回去了。我记得。

scripts.text: Did you see it there when you leave the room? Wasn't there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation: 你离开房间时还看到它吗？当时房间里还有别人吗？

scripts.text: Wait a moment. I know where you are getting with this. We, maids, often get into a situation like this.
scripts.translation: 等一下，我知道你想问什么了。我们女仆经常遇到这种情况。

scripts.text: Isn't the box missing and are you ^0000cdsuspecting the maid who has cleaned the room^000000? Am I right?
scripts.translation: 盒子不见了，所以你怀疑打扫房间的女仆，对吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I am not suspecting you. I am just ^0000cdasking you about the situation^000000 to track the box.
scripts.translation: 我没有怀疑你，只是想了解一下当时的情况，好找到盒子。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: With an element of suspicion in your mind, right?
scripts.translation: 心里多少还是有点怀疑吧？

scripts.text: No, I am not suspecting you. Please don't get me wrong. I am just asking you when you have seen it and if there haven't been anyone else there.
scripts.translation: 没有，请别误会。我只是想问你什么时候看到它的，以及当时有没有其他人在。

scripts.text: Ha, you are not being honest with me. If I say that there was no one around, I would be suspected, right?
scripts.translation: 哈，你还是不肯坦白。如果我说当时没有别人，岂不是更让人怀疑？

scripts.text: I can tell you this one though. I didn't take it. If you ask me if there was anyone in the room, well...
scripts.translation: 不过有一点我可以告诉你：我没有拿。如果你问当时房里有没有人，那...

scripts.text: There was someone in the room, right?
Was there? This kitchen is too messy that I cannot think straight. ^0000cdI may be able to recall if it is cleaned up^000000.
scripts.translation: 有吗？厨房太乱了，我脑子都转不过来。把这里打扫干净后，我或许就能想起来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, the kitchen is messy and so are the thoughts inside my head. Oh, how dirty and messy!
scripts.translation: 厨房乱糟糟的，我脑子里也一团乱。真是又脏又乱！

scripts.text: May I help you clean up?
Oh, would you do that for me? I would be so grateful. Here is a ^0000cdPoring Scrub Sponge^000000, please scrub every inch of this place clean.
scripts.translation: 哦，你愿意帮我吗？那我太感激了。这是波利擦洗海绵，请把这里每个角落都擦干净。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Since it is a specially-maid Scrub Sponge, it serves multiple purposes. It coaches you on how to clean so make good use of it.
scripts.translation: 这是特制的擦洗海绵，用途很多。它还会教你怎么清洁，好好利用吧。

scripts.text: You may be surprised by it, but it is a safe Scrub Sponge which doesn't hurt others. Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 你可能会觉得奇怪，但这块擦洗海绵很安全，不会伤到人。别担

scripts.text: It is a Scrub Sponge developed by a legendary figure.
scripts.translation: 心。它是一位传奇人物发明的。

scripts.text: Oh, wait! You know, there is a certain protocol when it comes to cleaning. You first need to wipe off the mold on the wall. Then you have to clean up the grease. The last thing for you to do is cleaning the floor.
scripts.translation: 等等！打扫也有顺序。先擦掉墙上的霉菌，再清理油污，最后才打扫地板。

scripts.text: It doesn't seem so. The thoughts in my head haven't cleared up yet.
scripts.translation: 看起来还没有呢，我脑子里的思绪还没理清。

scripts.text: I think I would be able to recall when you come back after cleaning the kitchen with the Scrub Sponge I have given you.
scripts.translation: 等你用我给的擦洗海绵把厨房打扫干净再回来，我应该就能想起来了。

scripts.text: Wow... The kitchen has become so clean! You really need to clean the grease with a strong set of arms!
scripts.translation: 哇...厨房真干净！清理油污确实需要一双有力的手臂！

scripts.text: Argh... My arms... Was there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation: 啊...我的手臂...房间里当时还有别人吗？

scripts.text: You must know what kind of family that is. It is the wealthiest family in Rune-Midgarts. Despite being a temporary residence, the room was decorated with so much care.
scripts.translation: 你应该知道那是什么样的家族。他们是卢恩·米德加兹最富有的家族。虽说这里只是临时住所，房间还是布置得十分用心。

scripts.text: All the gorgeous pieces of furniture and carpets... I have never seen tiger skin as white and huge as that one in there.
scripts.translation: 华丽的家具和地毯...我从没见过那么大、那么白的虎皮。

scripts.text: Why are you talking about the furniture all of a sudden?
scripts.translation: 你怎么突然说起家具了？

scripts.text: Oh, my, how are you going to deal with the members of the royal families with such slow wit?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，你反应这么慢，怎么应付王室成员？想想看，我为什么要

scripts.text: Think. Why would I ^0000cdtalk about the furniture^000000 ?
...You ^0000cdcan ask the person who was delivering the furniture^000000 .
I cannot point it out, but I think I have given you enough clues.
scripts.translation: 我不能直接点破，不过线索已经给得够多了

scripts.text: By the way, is the box really missing in the first place?
scripts.translation: 。对了，那个盒子真的不见了吗？

scripts.text: It is not my opinion, but there are these words people say. You know, the rumors.
scripts.translation: 这不是我的看法，只是大家都这么说的...你知道，那些流

scripts.text: Since the prince of the Wigner family looks so handsome...
scripts.translation: 言。维格纳家的王子长得那么英俊...

scripts.text: He has been the center of the attention since he was young. People say that the lady is stressed about it and does things to draw attention.
scripts.translation: 他从小就是众人关注的焦点。大家都说，那位小姐因此压力很大，还会故意做些引人注目的事。

scripts.text: This could be one of her tricks, they say.
scripts.translation: 据说这可能也是她的把戏之一。

scripts.text: The words haven not been spread yet, but I am sure that everyone will be talking about it even before the teatime is over.
scripts.translation: 这些话现在还没传开，但我敢说茶会结束前，大家就会议论纷纷。

scripts.text: I don't think that is true. She is not that kind of person.
scripts.translation: 我不觉得这是真的。她不是那种人。

scripts.text: That's what people say. You don't have to reason with me. Anyways, I should get back to my cleaning duty. If you are not going to help me, please leave me alone now.
scripts.translation: 大家都是这么说的，你不用跟我讲道理。总之，我得回去打扫了。如果你不打算帮忙，就别打扰我。

scripts.text: Do you know where the man who have delivered the furniture is?
scripts.translation: 你知道送家具的人在哪里吗？

scripts.text: He must be somewhere in Prontera. Why don't you try visiting the area ^0000cdnear the district office^000000. Most stores are located there.
scripts.translation: 他应该在普隆德拉的某个地方。去区公所附近找找吧，那边店铺很多。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, you didn't hear it from me. Not that I said anything to you.
scripts.translation: 对了，刚才的话别说是我告诉你的。我可什么都没跟你说。

scripts.text: Of course. Thank you for your cooperation.
Dear adventurer, didn't you say that you were going to visit the delivery man?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你不是说要去找送货员吗？他应该在

scripts.text: He must be somewhere ^0000cdnear the district office^000000.
Since I need to clean up. please leave now.
scripts.translation: 我还得打扫，请你先离开。

scripts.text: You are getting in the way.
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
scripts.translation: 唉，我受够打扫了！家里要打扫的东西已经够多了，我不想在外面还做这

scripts.text: I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation: 些。我干脆辞职逃走算了。

scripts.text: Oh, why can't I get it off easily? I guess I won't be able to go home early.
scripts.translation: 唉，怎么这么难擦？看来今天没法早点回家了。我为什么

scripts.text: Hello. Do you have a moment?
Aren't you the adventurer who was at the Wigner residence?
scripts.translation: ..你就是在维格纳宅邸见过的那位冒险者吧？

scripts.text: Yes. And I have come here before, and I have helped you with cleaning.
scripts.translation: 是我。我之前还来帮你打扫过。你不记得

scripts.text: Oh, I am really sorry. ^0000cdI am not good at remembering faces.^000000
scripts.translation: 啊，实在抱歉。我不太擅长记人脸。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Jurgen of the Wigner family has asked me to give it to you.
scripts.translation: 维格纳家的尤尔根让我把这个交给你。

scripts.text: What is it? Why did he give it to me? Is it an invoice? Have I done anything wrong?
scripts.translation: 这是什么？他为什么给我这个？是账单吗？我做错什么了吗？

scripts.text: No, it is not. Please just read it first.
Hum... I have fallen in love with you at first sight.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我对你一见钟情。那个..

scripts.text: Well... Hum... Please accept my love for... Eh... Umm...
He has used some really direct languages here. How very Wigner of him for that he values efficiency... Hahaha...
scripts.translation: 他写得可真直接。真是维格纳家的作风，凡事都讲求效率...哈哈哈...

scripts.text: Hum... It is... It is... Well, is it what I think it is?
scripts.translation: 嗯...这...这是...我想的那种东西吗？

scripts.text: Yes, it is a love letter.
Phew... I am sorry, but you should take it back.
Well... I appreciate his feelings for me... I really do... But please just take it back.
