Squeeze the lemon and sprinkle the juice over the floor. Then sprinkle the powdery fine sand over it!
scripts.translation: 把柠檬挤汁，洒在地板上，再撒上细粉砂！这

scripts.text: This will whiten and polish the floor! Not to mention the fresh scent of lemon adding something extra!
scripts.translation: 样能让地板洁白光亮！柠檬的清香更是锦上添花！

scripts.text: Then you scrub briskly with me!
The method of scrubbing is as follows! It is not difficult if you follow me! Listen up!
scripts.translation: 速擦洗！方法是这样的！跟着做并不难，听好了！

scripts.text: Three times to the left! Once to the right! Once to the left again! Twice to the front!
scripts.translation: 向左三次！向右一次！再向左一次！向前两次！最

scripts.text: Then twice to the left to wrap up! Start now!
scripts.translation: 后再向左两次收尾！开始！

scripts.text: Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!
You have completed the cleaning mission beautifully!
scripts.translation: 亮！你完美地完成了清洁任务！

scripts.text: I believe that you can handle cleaning perfectly even without me!
scripts.translation: 我相信没有我，你也能把清洁工作做得很好

scripts.text: Old soldiers never die! They just fade away! So save the tears!
scripts.translation: ！老兵不死，只是渐渐凋零！所以别哭！

scripts.text: You may think of me whenever you see and clean the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles!
scripts.translation: 以后看到并清理地砖缝里的黑垢时，记得想起我！现在解

scripts.text: When did I teach you like that? Don't you dare say that you have learned it from me!
scripts.translation: 我什么时候教过你这种方法？别说是跟我学的！

scripts.text: Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
scripts.translation: 干净的地板让我想起那块外表强硬、内心柔软的擦洗

scripts.text: Let's go back to the maid and report that the cleaning is completed.
scripts.translation: 海绵。回去告诉女仆，清洁工作完成了。

scripts.text: The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
scripts.translation: 干净的地板让我想起那块外表强硬、内心柔软的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text: Oh, my arms, legs, back and my entire body hurts. Well, I am just glad that today's work is done. I can take some rest now. I should go have some hot soup. Is it supposed to be the meat soup for today?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我的胳膊、腿、背，全身都疼。不过今天的工作总算完成了，可以休息了。我得去喝碗热汤。今天应该是肉汤吧？

scripts.text: What is it? Is it about furniture delivery? I am off my duty today. Unless it is really urgent, would you please come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation: 什么事？是家具配送的事吗？我今天已经下班了。除非特别紧急，否则明天再来好吗？

scripts.text: I am exhausted from today's work. I almost cannot stand with my back straight now.
scripts.translation: 今天的工作把我累坏了，现在腰都快直不起来。

scripts.text: No, it is not about that. You are the one who has delivered the furniture to the Wigner family, right?
scripts.translation: 不是关于家具的。你就是把家具送到维格纳家的人，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I have... Is there any problem with the furniture? What should I do? I would never be able to afford the furniture!
scripts.translation: 是我送的...家具出问题了吗？我该怎么办？那些家具我可赔不起！

scripts.text: What if there is a dent? Should I call James to fix it? Damage? Wrong delivery? What should I do? What is it about?
scripts.translation: 如果家具磕坏了呢？要叫詹姆斯来修吗？要是损坏了或送错了怎么办？到底出什么事了？

scripts.text: No, nothing like that. Please relax.

What is it? Additional delivery? I really want to take some rest now... However, I guess I have no choice since it is the Wigners that I am dealing with. Oh, I really hate it... It is just too difficult to make ends meet.
scripts.translation: 什么事？还要追加送货吗？我现在真的想休息...不过既然是维格纳家的事，我也只能照办。唉，真烦...日子过得太难了。

scripts.text: No, I just have a question for you. Have you seen a small box on the table in the room?
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是想问你一件事。你在房间的桌上看到一个小盒子了吗？

scripts.text: What box? I was busy delivering the furniture... Wait, I remember it.
scripts.translation: 什么盒子？我当时忙着搬家具...等等，我想起来了。

scripts.text: You mean the ^0000cdsmall box^000000 on the table next to the bed, right? The locked box with no particular decoration.
scripts.translation: 你是说床边桌上的小盒子吧？那个没有装饰、上了锁的盒子。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes, I remember it. It was a simple box without any decoration, but it looked very classy.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我记得。那是个没有装饰的素净小盒子，却

scripts.text: The wood was of the finest quality and the locking device was exquisite. I could tell that it must have been made by a master artisan at a glance.
scripts.translation: 显得很典雅。木料上乘，锁具也很精巧。我一眼就看出那是名匠的作品。

scripts.text: Since I work with furniture, a piece like that really catches my eyes. It really was a work of art.
scripts.translation: 我毕竟是做家具这行的，那样的东西特别引人注目。真是件艺术品。

scripts.text: Was the box still there after you delivered the furniture?
scripts.translation: 你送完家具后，盒子还在吗？

scripts.text: Yes, it was. The box cannot move itself, can it?
scripts.translation: 还在啊。盒子总不会自己长腿跑掉吧？

scripts.text: Oh, wait? Are you telling me that it is missing? Are you implying that it has been carried out in my carriage?
scripts.translation: 等等，你是说盒子不见了？你怀疑它被装上我的马车带走了？

scripts.text: No. Please calm down. I am not suspecting you. I just want to listen to your story. I am just tracking the whereabouts of the box based on the words of the people who have seen the box.
scripts.translation: 不是。请冷静，我没有怀疑你。我只是想听听你的说法，根据见过盒子的人提供的线索追查它的去向。

scripts.text: If anything goes missing, it is always us, the ordinary people, who are suspected. Do you know that it is just a prejudice?
scripts.translation: 东西一丢，总是我们这些普通人先被怀疑。你知道这其实是种偏见吗？

scripts.text: The people who have less must be hungry for money. And they are unvirtuous...
scripts.translation: 好像穷人就一定贪财、品行不端似的...

scripts.text: It is just a misunderstanding. Trust me, I am not suspecting you.... You know, you look for any witnesses when a person goes missing.
scripts.translation: 这只是误会，相信我，我没有怀疑你...出了什么事，总得找目击者问问。

scripts.text: I don't want to hear it! Why are you scaring an innocent furniture delivery man for some missing box?
scripts.translation: 我不想听！一个盒子不见了，你干吗要吓唬无辜的送货员？

scripts.text: I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I am just asking everyone who has been in that room. I am not suspecting you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉让你不舒服了。我只是在询问进过房间的人，并没有怀疑你。

scripts.text: Heh, not that it makes me feel any better. I think I may be feeling even worse since I am hungry. Oh, my stomach is growling... I don't feel well...
scripts.translation: 哼，这话也没让我好受些。我现在饿得更难受了，肚子都在叫...我不舒服...

scripts.text: Do you need something to eat?
It doesn't change anything even if you say that...Well, I may be able to let it go if I have some Ox Head Slices... I cannot forget the taste from 10 years ago...
scripts.translation: 你这么说也没用...不过要是能吃到牛头肉片，我也许就不计较了。我忘不了十年前吃到的味道...

scripts.text: Would it make you feel better?
scripts.translation: 吃点东西会让你舒服些吗？

scripts.text: Well, not that it will... OK, good! I'll let it go for ^0000cd3 Ox Head Slices^000000! Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation: 嗯...也不一定...好吧！给我3份牛头肉片，事情就算了！这才公平。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Would it be enough? OK, please wait for me then.
scripts.translation: 这些够吗？好，那请等我一下。

scripts.text: You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset as I get parched with thirst.
scripts.translation: 你来了。再晚一点我可真要不高兴了，口都渴干了。

scripts.text: Did you forget? I said I would let it go with ^0000cd3 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation: 吗？我说过给我3份就不计较了。 ^0000cd{0}^000000

scripts.text: I wouldn't let it go without them! I won't! I'll tell people that there is an adventurer who frames an innocent person! He!
scripts.translation: 没有肉片我绝不算了！绝不！我要告诉大家，有个冒险者在诬陷无辜的人！哼！

scripts.text: You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset due to my raging stomach.
scripts.translation: 你来了。再晚一点我可真要不高兴了，肚子都饿得咕咕叫。

scripts.text: Well, it was very difficult to get them. Here you are.
scripts.translation: 弄到这些可不容易。给你。

scripts.text: Let's see! Oh, this is it! Have you had good wine with some Ox Head Slices? You will never get over this heavenly combination!
scripts.translation: 让我看看！哦，就是这个！你吃过牛头肉片配美酒吗？这绝妙的组合，吃过就忘不了！

scripts.text: This tastes the same as it did 10 years ago! Now I feel fully recovered from the fatigue! I don't feel tired any more! All the stress is gone!
scripts.translation: 味道和十年前一模一样！我现在彻底恢复精神了，一点也不累，压力也全消了！

scripts.text: Oh, it sure looks delicious. I should try some later. Anyways, do you know anything else about the box?
scripts.translation: 看起来真美味，我稍后也尝尝。对了，你还知道那个盒子的其他消息吗？

scripts.text: Are we still talking about it? Let's not talk about such thing while I am enjoying some wine and meat. My carriage is heavy when I get in, but it is as light as a feather when I get out.
scripts.translation: 还在说那个盒子啊？我正享受美酒佳肴，别提那些事。我的马车上车时很沉，下车时却轻得像羽毛。

scripts.text: If you feel suspicious, ask the Gate Guard. He inspected my carriage.
scripts.translation: 你要是怀疑，可以去问城门卫兵。他检查过我的马车。

scripts.text: Have you seen the princess of the family? You must have. Doesn't she appear suspicious to you? I can tell people's character by their faces. She seems to be hiding something. She may stab you in the back.
scripts.translation: 你见过那家的公主吗？肯定见过吧。你不觉得她很可疑吗？我看人很准，她似乎藏着什么秘密，说不定会在背后捅你一刀。

scripts.text: Isn't it called a prejudice to judge some based on the appearance?
scripts.translation: 仅凭外表判断别人，不也是一种偏见吗？

scripts.text: You are right. I feel sorry, However, there are people talking about it. There's no smoke without fire.
scripts.translation: 你说得对，我不该这么说。不过确实有人在议论她。俗话说，无风不起浪。不

scripts.text: No? Well. Perhaps, there could be smoke without fire.
scripts.translation: 是吗？嗯...也许有时无火也会有烟。

scripts.text: Katrin was not that kind of person as far as I observed.
scripts.translation: 据我所知，卡特琳不是那种人。

scripts.text: Well, if not, that's fine. Anyways, the box was there in its place when I left the room. You may go if you don't have any business left here.
scripts.translation: 那就好。总之我离开房间时，盒子还在原处。你没别的事就可以走了。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, why are you here again? Didn't you say you were heading back to the palace?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你怎么又回来了？你不是说要回宫里吗？

scripts.text: Do you have more things to as me? Or are you going to drink with me?
scripts.translation: 你还有什么事要问我？还是想留下来陪我喝一杯？

scripts.text: I should earn enough money to open a store of my own. The owner only lets me deliver the furniture and never teaches me how to make one.
scripts.translation: 我得攒够钱自己开家店。老板只让我送家具，从来不教我怎么制作家具。

scripts.text: All the cutting and delivery work will break my back.
scripts.translation: 又是切割又是搬运，简直要把我的腰累断了。唉

scripts.text: I finally have the strawberry cake no one has ever touched.
scripts.translation: 我终于拿到了没人碰过的草莓蛋糕。为

scripts.text: The things I have been through to keep the cake in the expedition camp... I am about to burst into tears... Aww...
scripts.translation: 了把它从远征营地保下来，我吃了不少苦...我都快哭出来了...呜呜...

scripts.text: Strawberry! Strawberry! This strawberry cake belongs to Ryosun! I won't give it to anyone.
scripts.translation: 草莓！草莓！这块草莓蛋糕是良孙的！谁也别想拿走。

scripts.text: Are you having a good time?
We have put a lot of efforts since it's a big event in the palace in a long while.
scripts.translation: 是宫里难得一见的大型活动，我们为此费了不少心思。希

scripts.text: It is always my pleasure to attend a banquet. Traveling and learning about different cultures are always interesting. It just makes it better to have good music and delicious food.
scripts.translation: 参加宴会总是我的荣幸。旅行和了解不同的文化总是很有趣。如果有美妙的音乐和美味的食物，那就更好了。

scripts.text: It is always tiring to attend a banquet. I am still tired from the trip, it is just too painful to mingle with people... Phew...
scripts.translation: 参加宴会总是很累的。我还在旅途的疲劳中，与人应酬实在太痛苦了...呼...

scripts.text: The Palace of Rune Midgarts is so big and glamourous. It somewhat feels exotic too. It's been a long way, but I am glad to be here.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的宫殿如此宏大华丽。它甚至带有一点异域风情。路途遥远，但我很高兴能来到这里。

scripts.text: Oh, aren't you the adventurer who has saved the world? Please visit Portmalaya someday. Everyone will welcome you there! Your story is known even to a far away place from here!
scripts.translation: 哦，您不就是那位拯救了世界的冒险者吗？请有一天来波塔马拉亚。那里的人都会欢迎您！您的故事甚至传到了离这里很远的地方！

scripts.text: The music played by the music makes me so emotional. It is worthwhile to come here for this music alone.
scripts.translation: 乐手演奏的音乐让我如此感动。光是为了这音乐，来这里就值得了。

scripts.text: Wait, I have been looking at the flowers here. Are they blinking? How wonderful!
scripts.translation: 等等，我一直在看这里的花。它们在眨眼吗？太美妙了！

scripts.text: I visited the Palace of Rune Midgarts long time ago. It has changed a lot ever since. It has become much more glamourous and magnificent that I really enjoy being guided around this place.
scripts.translation: 我很久以前就参观过伦米德加特的宫殿。自那以后它变化很大，变得更加华丽宏伟，我很享受在这里被引导参观。

scripts.text: There are a long of people here. I almost feel dizzy. However, still, I like the lively atmosphere.
scripts.translation: 这里人真多。我几乎要头晕了。不过，我依然喜欢这种热闹的氛围。

scripts.text: I have come to Prontera to attend the banquet from Amatsu. It sure feels totally different from Amatsu. Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 我从天津町来普隆德拉参加宴会。感觉和天津町完全不同呢。哈哈。

scripts.text: All the nobility who are in charge of the market in Rune Midgarts are here. We, the Cat Hand Services, shouldn't miss this chance.
scripts.translation: 负责伦米德加特市场的所有贵族都在这里。我们“猫爪服务”可不能错过这个机会。

scripts.text: I'll score contracts as tall as my height.
scripts.translation: 我要签下和我身高一样高的一摞契约。

scripts.text: I am an old fan of Orint of the band.
scripts.translation: 我是乐队成员奥林的资深粉丝

scripts.text: I have spent a lot of money and time not to miss any of his performance.
scripts.translation: 。我花了很多钱和时间，只为不错过他的任何一场演出。

scripts.text: It was very difficult to get my hands on the invitation to this banquet.
scripts.translation: 拿到这次宴会的邀请函非常困难。它太专

scripts.text: It was so exclusive that I almost joined the expedition!
scripts.translation: 属了，我差点就加入远征队了！

scripts.text: The twin sisters of the band are of completely different characters. However, they are good at imitate each other.
scripts.translation: 乐队里的双胞胎姐妹个性截然不同，却很擅长模仿彼此。她们

scripts.text: When they pretend to be one person, they really looks like Doppelgangers.
scripts.translation: 假扮成同一个人时，简直就像分身一样。

scripts.text: You have been invited to the banquet as well.
scripts.translation: 你也受邀参加宴会了。嗯，

scripts.text: Well, no wonder... If you think about it.
I am glad to see you here. Life must be treating you well!
scripts.translation: 很高兴在这里见到你。生活一定对你很好吧！

scripts.text: Come to think of it, Kid is here too.
He met the people from the guild and went to see them...
scripts.translation: 他遇到了公会的人，就过去找他们了...

scripts.text: Hum... Then he was taken by a strange guy among the bunch to the dining hall.
scripts.translation: 嗯...然后他被那群人中的一个奇怪的家伙带到了餐厅。你可

scripts.text: It is a banquet in a long time. We may as well enjoy it.
scripts.translation: 这是很久以来的一场宴会。我们不妨好好享受一下。

scripts.text: Well, this is how the aristocrats spend their time!
scripts.translation: 原来贵族们是这样打发时间的！哈

scripts.text: Haha, let's see which lady is wearing the most beautiful dress.
scripts.translation: 哈，让我们看看哪位女士穿着最漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text: ...Oh... You have visited us to change your class, I remember.
scripts.translation: ...哦...我记得你来过我们这里转

scripts.text: We have recommended you as a representative of the guild.
scripts.translation: 职。我们推荐你作为公会的代表。

scripts.text: I am glad to see you all grown up.
Never forget the weight of the blood to be covered on your hands at all times.
scripts.translation: 了。永远不要忘记你手上沾染的血的重量。

scripts.text: You must have been invited to the banquet.
scripts.translation: 你一定是受邀参加宴会的。我们

scripts.text: It is rare to see the palace open to public like this. Enjoy as much as you can.
scripts.translation: 像这样向公众开放宫殿的机会很少见。请尽情尽兴吧。

scripts.text: ...I don't like a crowded place like this, but I cannot help it when I am on a mission.
scripts.translation: ...我不喜欢这种拥挤的地方，但执行任务时身不由己。

scripts.text: Well, I guess you are supposed to be here.
Oh, is it the first time since our last encounter for your class change?
scripts.translation: 哦，这是自上次为你办理转职以来我们第一次见

scripts.text: Thanks to your contribution, the position of the guild has been strengthened.
scripts.translation: 面吧？多亏了你的贡献，公会的地位更加稳固了。

scripts.text: I guess you will be the hero of the palace.
scripts.translation: 我想你将成为宫殿里的英雄。很高

scripts.text: I am glad to see you well.
Hum... Did we meet at Criatura?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我们是在克里阿图拉见过的吗？

scripts.text: I have dealt with too many people...
scripts.translation: 我接触的人太多了...你的

scripts.text: The drowsy music, the whispering people and the chamberlains carrying the refreshments. I think I am nobly born to see it.
scripts.translation: 。慵懒的音乐，低语的人群，还有端着点心的侍从长。我觉得自己生来就是为了欣赏这一切的。

scripts.text: I know this banquet is held for someone else. However, it still is a great opportunity for me to meet someone I can spend my life with.
scripts.translation: 我知道这场宴会是为别人举办的。不过，这对我来说也是一个寻找能共度一生之人的绝佳机会。

scripts.text: Everyone else seems to love the banquet, but I don't. I am forced by my parents to come here. I really want to go home and take a rest now.
scripts.translation: 其他人都似乎很享受宴会，但我并不喜欢。我是被父母逼着来的。我现在真的很想回家休息。

scripts.text: I'd like to invite them to the royal villa for my party.
scripts.translation: 我想邀请他们去皇家别墅参加我的派对。

scripts.text: Dwit! Look at the nobility over there. Aren't they beautiful?
scripts.translation: 德威特！看那边的贵族们。他们是不是很迷人？

scripts.text: Hum, yes they are. I think you would fit in there perfectly though.
scripts.translation: 嗯，确实如此。不过我觉得你在那里会非常合拍。

scripts.text: One day, I'll play the guitar next to you dancing and singing in a blue dress.
scripts.translation: 总有一天，我会弹着吉他，看着你穿着蓝色裙子跳舞唱歌。

scripts.text: Haha, that woman in the blue dress, it could be me!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，那个穿蓝裙子的女人，说不定就是我！

scripts.text: You are mistaken if you think I cannot distinguish you twin sisters, Occi. I can tell your differences from the steps you take and the sound of your breath.
scripts.translation: 奥奇，如果你以为我分不清你们这对双胞胎姐妹，那可就错了。我能从步态和呼吸声分辨出你们。

scripts.text: When I first met Orint, I thought he was stoic and unconcerned. However, he turned out to be a man of extraordinary concentration and possessiveness.
scripts.translation: 我第一次见到奥林特时，以为他沉默寡言、什么都不在乎。后来才发现，他专注得惊人，而且占有欲很强。

scripts.text: He always tries to be the best. That's why he can play the tune like that.
scripts.translation: 他总是力求做到最好。这就是为什么他能演奏出那样的旋律。

scripts.text: However, he doesn't know when to concentrate. His behavior is often misread.
scripts.translation: 然而，他不知道何时该专注。他的行为常常被误解。

scripts.text: Anyways, we are invited to an honorable place like this thanks to Orint.
scripts.translation: 总之，多亏了奥林特，我们才能受邀来到这样尊贵的

scripts.text: If you want to hear any song, ask him to play it for you.

scripts.text: They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
scripts.translation: 她们在那豪华的地方看起来很兴奋...

scripts.text: ...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...
scripts.translation: ...待在一个不属于自己的地方真让人难受...

scripts.text: You are a visitor to the Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation: 你是普隆德拉宫殿的访客。

scripts.text: You may move to the northern corridor from here.
scripts.translation: 从这里可以前往北侧走廊。

scripts.text: There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.
scripts.translation: 北侧走廊中央有通往瓦尔基里领域的入口。

scripts.text: The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
scripts.translation: 左边的门通往皇家别墅。那里

scripts.text: There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.
scripts.translation: 设有海涅、内里乌斯和瓦尔特家族的住所，以及一间贵宾室。

scripts.text: You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.
scripts.translation: 从这里沿右侧走廊走到中央，会看到一扇大门，从那里就能进入宴会厅。

scripts.text: We have ^4d4dffNoblesse^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation: 000装备。我会根据您的职业引导您兑换。

scripts.text: You can exchange the Honor Marks given by the noble people of Rune-Midgarts as the token of trust with some valuable items of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 您可以用卢恩·米德加兹贵族赠送的荣誉勋章，兑换普隆德拉的珍贵物品。

scripts.text: Would you view the item description?
The ^3131FF{0}s^000000 you can exchange with the Honor Marks are as follows.
scripts.translation: 以下是可以用荣誉勋章兑换的。 ^3131FF{0}^000000

scripts.text: It can be exchanged for ^FF0000{0} Honor Marks^000000.
You don't have enough Honor Marks.
It is the symbol of honor in Prontera. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation: 这是普隆德拉荣誉的象征。请妥善保管。

scripts.text: Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
scripts.translation: 你就是大家都在谈论、受邀参加宴会的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation: 你有<荣誉勋章>吗？能给我一些吗？

scripts.text: Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
scripts.translation: 就算我一辈子在这里拼命工作，也总是活在阴影里。

scripts.text: If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.
scripts.translation: 我常对阿纳尔说，男人就该有远大的梦想，可他实在太死板了。

scripts.text: I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.
scripts.translation: 我不梦想一夜暴富，但既然我是个男人，我就想要一些荣誉。

scripts.text: The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?
scripts.translation: 贵族们绝不会让我处理什么大机会。不过，你可能已经获得了一些<荣誉勋章>，对吧？

scripts.text: If you give me ^FF0000 30 <Honor Marks>^000000, I'll give you something really useful.
scripts.translation: 给我30枚<荣誉勋章>，我就给你一件很实用的东西。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.
scripts.translation: 对我们这种人来说，<荣誉勋章>就是快速晋升的阶梯。

scripts.text: What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.
scripts.translation: 我手里有一个包裹好的盒子，那是阿纳尔拥有的物品之一。

scripts.text: It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.
scripts.translation: 这是专门制作给贵族的正品。不过我不知道里面是什么，就看你的运气了。

scripts.text: After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
scripts.translation: 等我收集齐荣誉勋章，就在海边建座城堡，和那个固执的阿纳尔一起度过余生。那个笨蛋

scripts.text: That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.
scripts.translation: 阿纳尔，要不是有我，他就会在宫里一直兑换东西，直到老死。

scripts.text: I have told you I need 30 of them.
Thank you. This is the thing I have promised.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你。这就是我答应给你的东西。

scripts.text: This must be Prontera in the past?
scripts.translation: 这里一定是过去的普隆德

scripts.text: I guess we have picked the right time to be here-
scripts.translation: 拉吧？看来我们来对了时间——
哇，别小看我。我可是宫廷

scripts.text: I have also learned a lot of things at the Cat Paw Services!
scripts.translation: 我也从猫爪服务学到了不少！

scripts.text: I believe that I have the most thorough knowledge when it comes to the crack of dimension!
scripts.translation: 说到次元裂缝，我的知识可是最全面的！

scripts.text: As long as it is from a place on the crack of dimension,
scripts.translation: 只要知道次元裂缝中的位置，回

scripts.text: It is a piece of care to go back!
Since we don't belong to this time, it is much easier to get out than to enter.
scripts.translation: 既然我们不属于这个时代，离开这里比进来容易得多。

scripts.text: So, what are you going to do?
Let's go back to our time.
Do you remember the gate we got out?
It is supposed to be connected to the inside of the palace.
scripts.translation: 那扇门吗？它应该通向宫殿内部。

scripts.text: However, we arrived here. I guess the spaces are twisted a little so that they are connected.
scripts.translation: 可我们却来到了这里。我想是空间稍微扭曲，让两处连接在了一起。

scripts.text: I have already experimented this. If you enter the entrance to the palace,
scripts.translation: 我已经验证过了。只要进入宫殿入口，就会来

scripts.text: It is connected to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 which we have just been to.
scripts.translation: 到我们刚才去过的王室往事。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation: 哇，现在要整理一下思路吗？

scripts.text: ^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
scripts.translation: 意识之室里原本放着的东西一定是 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
scripts.translation: ...这肯定和现在袭击普隆德拉的不死族大军有关。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation: 一定是被他们带走了，没错吧？ ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: Or, can we take it with us?
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
scripts.translation: 上级应该会命令我们这么做。

scripts.text: Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation: 无论如何都要想办法成功。

scripts.text: Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
scripts.translation: 也许这只是我的猜测。意

scripts.text: Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
scripts.translation: 识之室里的东西被拿走了，对吧？可

scripts.text: However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation: 王室成员似乎一直在照常举行仪式，对此毫不知情。

scripts.text: They must have done something or it must have returned...
scripts.translation: 他们一定做了什么，或者那东西已经回来了...

scripts.text: This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation: 这或许符合条件，能让我们看到王室往事中被封印的部分... ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说那些知晓真相的人？

scripts.text: Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
scripts.translation: 没错。如果这就是解开封印的关键，

scripts.text: We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation: 那我们就带回了一条重要情报。

scripts.text: We didn't protect or take the thing...
scripts.translation: 我们既没能保护那东西，也没把它带

scripts.text: But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation: 走...但现在我们知道了真相，这或许能解开文件的封印...

scripts.text: As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
scripts.translation: 随着王室秘密揭开，缺失的线索也会补齐。哈哈

scripts.text: Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，而你就是这一切的中心，我亲爱的！

scripts.text: We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation: 从今以后我们不是天天见面吗？

scripts.text: Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation: 暂时完成这里的任务了！

scripts.text: Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation: 待在不属于我们时代的地方太久，可没什么好处。

scripts.text: Forget everything and let's get out-
Hey, you need to be cured first.
Argh... Those undead bastards... I'll kill them all...
scripts.translation: 可恶...那些不死族混蛋...我要杀光它们...

scripts.text: My colleague who had been laughing with me just... Aww...
scripts.translation: 刚才还和我有说有笑的同伴...唉...

scripts.text: Please. Don't get yourself killed by the enemy.
What was it that had dropped from the sky? How could it bring the undead to the capital?
scripts.translation: 刚才从天上掉下来的是什么？它怎么会把不死族带到首都来？

scripts.text: I'll... I'll make sure to defend this place.
The endless battle against the enemies...
scripts.translation: 和敌人的战斗永无止境...

scripts.text: An eccentric scientist, Doyeon, went out there with soldiers, and there has been no message from them. I am getting worried.
scripts.translation: 古怪的科学家道渊带着士兵出去了，之后就没消息了。我很担心。

scripts.text: Scientist Doyeon... Would she be OK? How can she go out there to study in a situation like this?
scripts.translation: 科学家道渊...她没事吧？这种时候怎么还跑出去做研究？

scripts.text: The troops of immortality... They are really strong. Please be careful.
scripts.translation: 不死族大军...他们真的很强。小心点。

scripts.text: We will defend the palace of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 我们要守住普隆德拉王宫。

scripts.text: My family live in Prontera. I wonder if they have fled safely.
scripts.translation: 我的家人住在普隆德拉。不知道他们有没有安全撤离。

scripts.text: Thank god... The undead are not coming this way much. What a relief.
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地...不死族没怎么往这边来。真是松了口气。

scripts.text: My friend has followed Scientist Doyeon. I am worried. I have heard that she really is an oddball.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友跟着科学家道渊出去了。我很担心，听说她是个怪人。

scripts.text: Hahaha, I was supposed to have a romantic dinner with my girlfriend, damn it!
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈，我本来要和女朋友共进浪漫晚餐的，该死！

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Are you an adventurer? I am sorry, but I am in the middle of something. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation: 你是冒险者吗？抱歉，我现在忙着处理事情，请先别打扰我。

scripts.text: I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation: 谨代表普隆德拉卫队向您致谢。

scripts.text: We will make sure to end the battle with the undead as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 我们会尽快结束与不死族的战斗。

scripts.text: I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation: 我听派往村公所附近的士兵说，您帮助了村民。

scripts.text: He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation: 他是个在村里待了一阵子的年轻人，看起来工作很勤勉...

scripts.text: However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation: 不过，经营普隆德拉冶炼厂的夸德罗先生似乎在混乱中丢失了一份重要文件。

scripts.text: He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation: 他负责管理卫兵使用的武器。我担心这会影响他的工作。

scripts.text: Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation: 哦！总之，感谢您帮助了村民们。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text: I heard from the soldiers dispatched to the Knights' building that you saved Lowen.
scripts.translation: 我听派往骑士团的士兵说，您救了洛温。

scripts.text: Lowen is a spirited girl who claims that she likes the Crusaders to the Royal Lord Knights.
scripts.translation: 洛温是个活泼的女孩，她说自己从十字军时代起就喜欢骑士团的骑士。

scripts.text: Rosa who is the younger sister to the girl is also popular among our soldiers.
scripts.translation: 她的妹妹罗莎在我们士兵中也很受欢迎。

scripts.text: I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation: 谨代表普隆德拉卫兵向您致谢。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text: I heard from the soldier dispatched to the village office that a soldier on his vacation has been fled here.
scripts.translation: 我听派往村公所的士兵说，一名休假的士兵逃到了这里。

scripts.text: I guess there has been a soldier on vacation during such a difficult time. I had been ignorant of it before I got the report.
scripts.translation: 这么艰难的时候竟然有士兵在休假。我直到收到报告才知道这件事。

scripts.text: I am faced with my inadequacies as the one in charge of the security of the capital.
scripts.translation: 身为负责首都治安的人，我深感自己失职。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text: I heard from the soldier in the cathedral that you saved the couple, Eryus and Ellie.
scripts.translation: 我听大教堂的士兵说，您救了埃里乌斯和艾莉这对夫妻。

scripts.text: I think I have heard of their names. I have heard that they irritate the minds of lonely soldiers with their endless public display of affection.
scripts.translation: 我好像听过他们的名字。听说他们总是旁若无人地秀恩爱，让那些孤单的士兵很是心烦。

scripts.text: Everyone in Prontera must know about it. Anyways, thank you for doing this for the Guards.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉的人肯定都知道这件事。总之，感谢您为卫兵们做了这件事。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text: I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation: 我会在地图上标出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地点。

scripts.text: Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation: 如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text: Don't stand there in the middle of our line! Watch out!
scripts.translation: 别站在我们队伍中间！小心点！

scripts.text: If you are hurt step back to get yourself cured. If you are recovered, get back in the line.
scripts.translation: 受伤了就退后接受治疗，恢复后再回到队伍中。

scripts.text: Huh? I haven't seen you before. You seem like a civilian. Why are you coming from there?
scripts.translation: 咦？我没见过你。你看起来像是平民。你为什么会从那里过来？

scripts.text: What? Have the undead entered the palace already?
scripts.translation: 什么？不死族已经攻入宫殿了吗？

scripts.text: No... I don't think so... I am just...
So you are supposed to be an adventurer invited to the banquet, right?
scripts.translation: 所以你是受邀参加宴会的冒险者，对吗？

scripts.text: Has there been a banquet in the palace lately? I don't remember.
scripts.translation: 最近宫殿里有宴会吗？我不记得了。

scripts.text: Well... Since we are busy dealing with
the undead invading the village, as long as the palace is safe from the undead, I won't make a big deal out of it.
scripts.translation: 对入侵村庄的不死族。只要宫殿没有受到威胁，我就不追究了。

scripts.text: I won't stop you from moving around the town. I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation: 我不会阻止你在城里走动。我会在地图上标出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地点。

scripts.text: Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation: 如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Whoa... You are not an undead, aren't you?
Do you know how scare I have been? This place was packed with the undead, and I heard screams from everywhere.
scripts.translation: 你知道我有多害怕吗？这里挤满了不死族，到处都能听见尖叫声。

scripts.text: Thank god... The shelter is supposed to be near the village office over there. Why don't we continue this conversation there?
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地...避难所应该就在那边的村公所附近。我们去那里继续聊吧？

scripts.text: Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Huh...? What a nerve! That guy... Save a stranger from the sea, and heùéll ask for more...
scripts.translation: 哼...真敢开口！那家伙...从海里救了个陌生人，还想得寸进尺...

scripts.text: Oh! I wasn't going to eavesdrop. Please don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation: 哦！我并没有在偷听。请别误会。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. I believe that uniform is worn by the Guards of Geffen.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，那身制服应该是吉芬卫兵穿的。

scripts.text: Who is that soldier? He seems to enter the shelter so smoothly in a situation like this. He confuses me.
scripts.translation: 那个士兵是谁？在这种局势下，他进入避难所的样子如此从容，让我感到困惑。

scripts.text: This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Whoa... I am saved. How fortunate. I guess I am a lucky man.
scripts.translation: 哇...我获救了。真幸运。看来我是个幸运的人。

scripts.text: Wait? Where did it go? I think I lost the Tool Bag while I was running.
scripts.translation: 等等？它去哪了？我想我逃跑的时候把工具包弄丢了。

scripts.text: I can guess where it has been dropped...
scripts.translation: 我可以猜到它掉落在哪里了...

scripts.text: You must be pretty tough to roam the village in a situation like this. Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation: 这种时候还能在村里四处走动，你一定很有本事。帮我个忙吧。

scripts.text: Do you know where the Prontera Smelter is?
scripts.translation: 你知道普隆德拉冶炼厂在哪儿吗？

scripts.text: It is quite a famous store in Prontera. Someday, I will...
scripts.translation: 那是普隆德拉一家很有名的店。总有一天，我也要...

scripts.text: Oh! Never mind. I am counting on you.
Whoa... I thought I have lost it. You really found it!
scripts.translation: 哇...我还以为弄丢了。你真的找到了！

scripts.text: This is awesome. Thank you so much. You must be busy, right? I have to go take care of something now...
scripts.translation: 太棒了，真是谢谢你。你肯定很忙吧？我得去处理点事了...

scripts.text: Oh! I know you are strong enough, but please be careful.
scripts.translation: 哦！我知道你很强，但请务必小心。

scripts.text: Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: In front of the Prontera Smelter
There a bag which would be full if you put some items.
scripts.translation: 里有个袋子，里面似乎装满了东西。

scripts.text: This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text: Oh! Dear {0}... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation: 哦，亲爱的{0}……那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text: Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a {0}.
scripts.translation: 请把它交给我，让我安抚同事的亡魂吧。虽然紧急情况期间服务暂停了，但我可以帮你骑乘{0}。

scripts.text: You need to learn how to ride a {0} first.
scripts.translation: 您需要先学会如何骑乘{0}。

scripts.text: You need to let go of the bridle to ride a {0}.
scripts.translation: 你得先松开缰绳，才能骑乘{0}。

scripts.text: Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。如果你找到其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text: This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text: Oh, dear Mechanic! That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation: 哦，亲爱的机匠！那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text: Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you borrow a Cart or ride a Magical Gear.
scripts.translation: 请把它交给我，让我安抚同事的亡魂吧。虽然紧急情况期间服务暂停了，但我可以帮你租用手推车或骑乘魔导装甲。

scripts.text: You are already using a Cart.
scripts.translation: 您已经在骑乘手推车了。

scripts.text: Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text: You cannot ride another magical gear since you are already riding one.
scripts.translation: 您已经在骑乘魔导装甲了，无法再骑乘另一辆。

scripts.text: Go get a license to ride a magical gear first.
scripts.translation: 请先去办理骑乘魔导装甲的许可证。

scripts.text: Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: I was running to the church with my sister, Rosa... And I lost her... Awww...
scripts.translation: 我正和姐姐罗莎跑去教堂...结果把她弄丢了...呜呜...

scripts.text: Rosa should have held on to my hand tightly. How clumsy of her to be lost!
scripts.translation: 罗莎本该紧紧牵着我的手才对。她怎么这么不小心，竟然走丢了！

scripts.text: Would you take me to the cathedral?
We promised to meet at the cathedral when we are lost. I believe she would be there in the church.
scripts.translation: 我们约好走散时在大教堂碰面。我想她应该会在那里。

scripts.text: Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 咦？你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Please take care of Lowen. She is like a mascot to us in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 请照顾好洛温。她对我们普隆德拉来说就像吉祥物一样。

scripts.text: Ellie is really fragile. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation: 艾莉真的很虚弱。希望她没事。

scripts.text: Oh, my... Ellie is in a critical condition. I hope a priest comes out to help her if there is one in there.
scripts.translation: 哎呀...艾莉的情况很危急。希望里面有牧师能出来救她。

scripts.text: Thank you for your effort. We will devote our lives to protect the cathedral from the undead coming this way.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的帮助。我们会誓死守住大教堂，不让不死族闯进来。

scripts.text: This the cathedral which is the first shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里是普隆德拉的第一个避难所——大教堂。

scripts.text: That belt... It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead. Would you mind giving it to me?
scripts.translation: 那条腰带...看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。你愿意把它交给我吗？

scripts.text: I know it is an emergency, but I'd like to comfort the soul of my colleague.
scripts.translation: 我知道现在情况紧急，但我想让同事的亡魂安息。

scripts.text: Oh, I see. Please bring them to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。改变主意的话，请把腰带带来。

scripts.text: Oh, where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation: 哦，你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text: Thank you. I guess the dead may rest in peace now. This is the only thing that I can offer you... However...
scripts.translation: 谢谢。我想逝者现在可以安息了。这是我唯一能给你的谢礼...不过...

scripts.text: If you find more articles left by the soldiers, would you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation: 如果你找到其他阵亡士兵留下的遗物，也请带给我好吗？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -
哦！亲爱的圣殿十字军！那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text: That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation: 字军！那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text: Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me call Pecopeco for you.
scripts.translation: 请把它交给我，让我安抚同事的亡魂吧。虽然紧急情况期间服务暂停了，但我可以为你叫来大嘴鸟。
亲爱的圣殿十字军，哦！你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text: Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation: ，哦！你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text: Oh... I guess you should learn how to ride a Pecopeco first.
scripts.translation: 哦...我想你得先学会骑大嘴鸟。

scripts.text: You are already using the Pecopeco.
You need to let go of the bridle to ride it.
scripts.translation: 你得先松开缰绳才能骑乘。

scripts.text: Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的遗物，请带给我。

scripts.text: Oh, I am an uncle now...
If you are here to borrow a PecoPeco, I have to say I am sorry.
scripts.translation: 如果您是想借大嘴鸟，我很抱歉，恐怕不行。

scripts.text: Due to the emergency situation, all troops of Prontera are deployed to protect the residents of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 由于情况紧急，普隆德拉所有部队都已出动保护居民。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Oh, Uncle Peco, did you see my sister here?
scripts.translation: 哦，大嘴鸟叔叔，你看到我姐姐了吗？

scripts.text: You mean Rosa? Do you mean Rosa? I haven't seen Rosa here. Wasn't she coming with you?
scripts.translation: 你是说萝莎？你是说萝莎吗？我没在这里见到萝莎。她不是和你一起来的吗？

scripts.text: Aww... Rosa, where are you now?
scripts.translation: 唉...萝莎，你现在在哪里呢？

scripts.text: She could have gone to the Knights' building. Weren't you sisters supposed to go to the shelter there?
scripts.translation: 她可能去了骑士团大楼。你们姐妹不是该去那里的避难所吗？

scripts.text: Eh? It must have not been the cathedral then... Huh? What should I do?
scripts.translation: 咦？所以不是大教堂...啊？我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, if you are not in a hurry, would you help Lowen flee to the Knights' building?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，如果你不赶时间，能帮洛温逃到骑士团大楼吗？

scripts.text: Lowen's sister is a careful girl, unlike Lowen. She must have fled to the Knights' building.
scripts.translation: 洛温的姐姐很细心，不像洛温那么冒失。她一定逃去骑士团大楼了。

scripts.text: Since I am here already, let me keep helping her.
scripts.translation: 既然我已经在这里了，就继续帮帮她吧

scripts.text: Thank you. Please take care of her.
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 咦？你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: This the knight's building which is the second shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里是骑士团大楼，也是普隆德拉的第二个避难所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Are you the one who has helped Sister Erinin? What a relief that we have someone like you?
scripts.translation: 你就是帮助艾琳修女的人吗？有你这样的人帮忙，真是太好了！

scripts.text: With the honor of the knight, I'll protect the villagers inside.
scripts.translation: 我以骑士的荣誉起誓，会保护里面的村民。

scripts.text: Are you here to hire a mercenary?
I am sorry, but all mercenaries dispatched in this area have been hired by the palace.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，这个区域的所有佣兵都已被宫殿征召。

scripts.text: Lowen, where did you go this time?
scripts.translation: 洛温，你这次又跑到哪里去了？
嘿嘿... 谢谢你，亲爱的冒险者。

scripts.text: Oh! Dear adventurer, thank you. She is so handful, you know.
scripts.translation: 哦！亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你。她可真让人操心，你知道的。

scripts.text: She is so delicate, but she is reckless. I am worried about her.
scripts.translation: 她很娇弱，却又鲁莽行事，我真担心她。

scripts.text: Well, we shall go hide in there so that the knights here don't need to worry about us anymore.
scripts.translation: 好了，我们进去躲起来吧，这样这里的骑士们就不用再为我们担心了。

scripts.text: Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 咦？你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Argh! The undead! Bring it on!
Hey, what would be the use of telling them to bring it on when you are hiding in there...
scripts.translation: 自己都躲在里面了，还喊他们来有什么用...

scripts.text: You adventurer don't understand it. I am pushed to this corner after a long battle against the undead.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你不懂。我和不死族激战许久，才被逼到这个角落。

scripts.text: You must be quite courageous for walking around the town in a situation like this.
scripts.translation: 这种时候还敢在镇上走动，你一定很勇敢。

scripts.text: You must be as brave as I am... The hero who has subjugated the Kobolds in Geffen...
scripts.translation: 你一定和我一样勇敢...是那个在吉芬击退刺锤犬妖的英雄...

scripts.text: Just in time. I was getting exhausted by the attacks of the undead.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，来得正好。不死族的攻击快把我累垮了。

scripts.text: I am on the way to go hide in the shelter nearby. Would you come with me?
scripts.translation: 我正准备去附近的避难所躲一躲。你愿意和我一起去吗？

scripts.text: Good. Since I am tired from the previous battle, please escort me to the Knight's building.
scripts.translation: 很好。我刚经历一场战斗，已经累了，请护送我去骑士团大楼。

scripts.text: Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Thank god, you heard my voice.
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地，你听见我的声音了。

scripts.text: I was going to help the knights defending the knight's building since I heard that many residents had been fled there. However, there seem to be enough troops here.
scripts.translation: 我听说很多居民逃到了骑士团大楼，本想去帮忙守卫的骑士。不过看来那里人手充足。

scripts.text: If I show my face, it may just disturb their concentration. I'd rather go without seeing them.
scripts.translation: 如果我露面，可能会分散他们的注意力。我还是不去打扰他们了。

scripts.text: I shall go join the defense on another place. I guess I can join the troops at the village office down there.
scripts.translation: 我得去别处帮忙防守。我想可以去下面的村公所加入那里的部队。

scripts.text: Since I want to save my energy for the battle, please escort me to the village office.
scripts.translation: 我想留些体力应付战斗，请护送我去村公所。

scripts.text: Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: There are not many people guarding this place.
I should go help them now.
It is such a secluded place, and there are 3 soldiers here.
scripts.translation: 这里这么偏僻，居然还有3名士兵。

scripts.text: Oh, I wasn't going to tell you this story, because I didn't want to boast...
scripts.translation: 哦，我本来不想说这件事的，因为我不想炫耀...

scripts.text: Millions of Kobolds have invaded Geffen before.
scripts.translation: 以前曾有数百万犬妖入侵吉芬。

scripts.text: The endless march of the Kobolds...
scripts.translation: 犬妖大军源源不断地行进...

scripts.text: Huh... Thinking about it makes me sweat...
scripts.translation: 唉...一想到这事，我就冒冷汗...

scripts.text: Well,, from my experience, a place like this is the toughest to guard when the enemies march in out of blue.
scripts.translation: 嗯，根据我的经验，敌人突然来袭时，这样的地方最难防守。

scripts.text: It is a secret that it is the greatest timing for the rise of a hero.
scripts.translation: 这是个秘密，此刻正是英雄崛起的最佳时机。

scripts.text: I'll take a rest inside, and come out to save these people when this place is in danger. You shall go save another place.
scripts.translation: 我会在里面休息；这里有危险时，再出来救人。你去救其他地方的人吧。

scripts.text: Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Oh, Odin... Thank you! Dear adventurer, please find my wife.
scripts.translation: 丁啊...谢谢你！亲爱的冒险者，请帮我找找妻子。

scripts.text: It happened in the evening, at dusk.
With a roaring sound, we heard that something dropped near the old swordsmen's guild.
scripts.translation: 轰鸣后，我们听说老剑士公会附近有什么东西坠落了。

scripts.text: Many residents gathered around the area to find out what had caused such a commotion.
scripts.translation: 许多居民聚集在那片区域，想弄清楚是什么引起了这么大的骚动。

scripts.text: I went down there with my wife Ellie.
scripts.translation: 我和妻子艾莉也去了那里。

scripts.text: When the people gathered, and night fell, the undead which had been buried under the ground of Prontera started waking up.
scripts.translation: 人群聚集、夜幕降临时，埋在普隆德拉地下的不死族开始苏醒。

scripts.text: People freaked. While running around, I lost hold of my wife's hand.
scripts.translation: 人们惊慌失措，四散奔逃时，我松开了妻子的手。

scripts.text: Oh, Ellie... My wife is a very fragile woman. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation: 艾莉...我的妻子很虚弱，希望她平安无事。

scripts.text: Let me go find her. You should go hide in the cathedral. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation: 我去找她。你先去大教堂避难，我带你过去。

scripts.text: Awww... Please help me. Please find my wife.
scripts.translation: 呜呜...求求你帮帮我，找到我的妻子。

scripts.text: Awww... I need to find my wife... And I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 呜呜...我得找到妻子...而且我不应该被看见。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Awww... Please help me. Please find my wife... I am really worried about her.
scripts.translation: 呜呜...求求你帮帮我，找到我的妻子...我真的很担心她。

scripts.text: Wait in the cathedral. I'll look for your wife. Where did you lose her?
scripts.translation: 你先在大教堂等着。我去找你妻子。你们在哪里走散的？

scripts.text: Aww... I must have forgotten to tell you.
I lost hold of her hand near the Prontera employment agency.
scripts.translation: 我在普隆德拉就业介绍所附近和她走散了。

scripts.text: I am not sure if she is still there...
scripts.translation: 我不确定她是不是还在那里...

scripts.text: Aww... Please help me, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation: 哎呀...亲爱的冒险者，请帮帮我。

scripts.text: I lost hold of her hand near the Prontera employment agency.
scripts.translation: 我在普隆德拉的就业机构附近松开了她的手。

scripts.text: Aww... Please help me, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation: 哎呀...请帮帮我，亲爱的冒险者。
哦！谢天谢地！亲爱的冒险者...

scripts.text: Ellie, what is going on? Are you ill again? Where is your medicine?
scripts.translation: 艾莉，怎么了？你又生病了吗？你的药在哪里？

scripts.text: Cough... Cough... I must have dropped it while running...
scripts.translation: 咳...咳...我跑动的时候可能把它弄掉了...

scripts.text: Where did you drop the medicine?
Cough... Cough... I don't know. Cough, it could be there... Cough... Cough...
scripts.translation: 咳...咳...我不知道。咳，可能在那边...咳...咳...

scripts.text: Where you were before? Wait a moment. Let me go get it for you.
scripts.translation: 你刚才待的地方吗？等一下，我去帮你拿。

scripts.text: It is dangerous out there. I'll go. You should stay here and take care of your wife.
scripts.translation: 外面很危险，我去吧。你留下来照顾妻子。

scripts.text: Would you do that for us? Please. We are running out of time. Ellie. hold on...
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮我们吗？拜托了，我们没多少时间了。艾莉，坚持住...

scripts.text: Please. We are running out of time.
scripts.translation: 拜托了，我们没多少时间了。

scripts.text: The priest of the cathedral is taking care of my wife in there.
scripts.translation: 了。大教堂的牧师正在里面照顾我妻子。

scripts.text: Thank you for helping us. I guess I shall bring the medicine to her as fast as possible.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮了我们。我得尽快把药送给她。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. God bless your journey...
scripts.translation: 太感谢你了。愿奥丁保佑你的旅途...

scripts.text: Awww... I need to find my wife... And I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation: 呜呜...我得找到妻子...而且我不应该被看见。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: I have been asked by your husband.
scripts.translation: 我是受你丈夫之托来的。

scripts.text: Oh... He is such a kind person... He must have been in danger as well, but he still cares about me...
scripts.translation: 哦...他真是个好人...他自己肯定也身处险境，却还惦记着我...

scripts.text: This place is dangerous. Let's move.
scripts.translation: 这里很危险，我们快走吧。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you see me? This is not good.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你看得见我吗？这可不妙。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -
哦！谢天谢地！亲爱的冒险者...

scripts.text: Ellie, what is going on? Are you ill again? Where is your medicine?
scripts.translation: 艾莉，怎么了？你又生病了吗？你的药在哪里？

scripts.text: Cough... Cough... I must have dropped it while running...
scripts.translation: 咳...咳...我跑动的时候可能把它弄掉了...

scripts.text: Where did you drop the medicine?
Cough... Cough... I don't know. Cough, it could be there... Cough... Cough...
scripts.translation: 咳...咳...我不知道。咳，可能在那边...咳...咳...

scripts.text: Where you were before? Wait a moment. Let me go get it for you.
scripts.translation: 你刚才待的地方吗？等一下，我去帮你拿。

scripts.text: It is dangerous out there. I'll go. You should stay here and take care of your wife.
scripts.translation: 外面很危险，我去吧。你留下来照顾妻子。

scripts.text: Would you do that for us? Please. We are running out of time. Ellie. hold on...
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮我们吗？拜托了，我们没多少时间了。艾莉，坚持住...

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you see me? This is not good.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，你看得见我吗？这可不妙。

scripts.text: It seems to be the bundle of medicine dropped by Ellie while running.
scripts.translation: 看来这是艾莉逃跑时掉落的药包。

scripts.text: You picked up the bundle of medicine. Bring it to Ellie in pain.
scripts.translation: 你捡起了药包。把它带给痛苦中的艾莉吧。
