scripts.translation: [卢恩·米德加兹王国首都：普隆德拉]

scripts.text: There is Izlude in the south east, Payon in the south, Geffen in the west and Al De Baran in the north.
scripts.translation: 东南方是依斯鲁得岛，南方是斐扬，西方是吉芬，北方是艾尔帕兰。

scripts.text: Proceed after resetting the quest. Select the quest to start.
scripts.translation: 重置任务后继续。请选择要开始的任务。

scripts.text: Would you move to this starting point?
Would you move to this starting point?
Would you move to this starting point?
Would you move to this starting point?
All quests related with the underground dungeon will be reset.
scripts.translation: 所有地下城相关任务都将重置。

scripts.text: There are too many kinds of items in possession. Reduce the type of the items and try again.
scripts.translation: 持有的物品种类过多。请减少物品种类后再试。

scripts.text: It seems difficult to proceed any further since the items in your possession are too heavy. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 背包里的物品太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text: What is it? Did Dylan send you here? If you are going to deal with me, don't waste any more time. There are a lot of people watching us.
scripts.translation: 什么事？是迪伦派你来的？要对付我就别浪费时间。很多人都在看着我们。

scripts.text: Isn't Dylan making some strange powder whenever he breaks a thing?
scripts.translation: 迪伦每次弄坏东西时，都会弄出某种奇怪的粉末，不是吗？

scripts.text: It is ^0000ffRune Magic Powder^000000 which the magicians use for their experiments. I don't think Dylan knows this.
scripts.translation: 那是卢恩魔法粉末，魔法师用来做实验的材料。我想迪伦并不知道这点。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: I'll ^0000ffexchange 30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box^000000. How do you like that? It is such a sweet deal, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 我用30个卢恩魔法粉末换1个神秘蓝箱。怎么样？这笔交易很划算吧？ ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: 30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box. I remind you.
scripts.translation: 我再说一遍：30个卢恩魔法粉末换1个神秘蓝箱。

scripts.text: Good, it is a great deal.
There are too many kinds of items in possession. Reduce the type of the items and try again.
scripts.translation: 持有的物品种类过多。请减少物品种类后再试。

scripts.text: It seems difficult to proceed any further since the items in your possession are too heavy. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 背包里的物品太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text: Are you a customer? I am not going to get more customers today because I am tired.
scripts.translation: 你是来买东西的？我累了，今天不想再招待客人。

scripts.text: Are you running a business in the prison?
Although I may look like this now, I used to be called the man with the hand of minus out there. It is quite dangerous stuff. You'd better stay away.
scripts.translation: 我现在虽然落魄，以前在外头可是有“负之手”的称号。这行当危险得很，你最好离远点。

scripts.text: ^0000ffUnlike his words, he really seems eager to give an explanation.^000000
scripts.translation: 他嘴上这么说，似乎却很想解释一番。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: I don't want to waste time here.
scripts.translation: 我不想在这里浪费时间

scripts.text: What kind of business you are running here.
Honor Mark, which is issued by the kingdom and not to be traded between individuals. I receive it and enhance people's equipment.
scripts.translation: 王国颁发的荣誉徽章不能由个人交易。我收下徽章，帮人强化装备。

scripts.text: As you can tell, it is against the law. That's why I used to only work for through personal contacts. However, one guy whose equipment was broken while resetting the enhancement informed on me.
scripts.translation: 你也看出来了，这是违法的。所以我以前只通过私人关系接活。不过有个家伙重置强化时弄坏了装备，转头就把我告发了。

scripts.text: I don't need to hear of some personal impression by you. Although I am caught, I am roaming the prison freely thanks to the warder over there.
scripts.translation: 我不需要听你的个人评价。虽然我被抓了，但多亏那边的看守，我才能在监狱里自由走动。

scripts.text: Of course, I cannot get out to avoid causing the real problem. That's why I stay in the prison like this. Are you interested in the deal?
scripts.translation: 当然，为了避免惹出更大的麻烦，我不能出去，所以才一直待在监狱里。你对这笔交易有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: The kingdom has poor public security.
What a nerd. I told you to back off if you didn't want to get involved.
scripts.translation: 真是个书呆子。我说过，不想惹上麻烦就离我远点。

scripts.text: You are a great fellow to deal with. I want to save enough money to bail myself out. Any customers are welcome here.
scripts.translation: 你挺好打交道的。我想攒够钱把自己保释出去。这里欢迎所有顾客。

scripts.text: I enhance the three items, Flattery Robe, Invective Robe and Prontera Badge for Honor Mark.
scripts.translation: 我用荣誉徽章强化三件装备：恭维法袍、辱骂法袍和普隆德拉徽章。

scripts.text: I guess I don't need to explain about it anymore. Just bring the equipment you want to enhance to me.
scripts.translation: 不用我多解释了。把想强化的装备拿给我就行。

scripts.text: Are you here to deal with me? Tell me what you need now.
scripts.translation: 你是来跟我做交易的吗？说说你要办什么。

scripts.text: Listen carefully. I won't say twice.
I'll enhance one of the Flattery Robe or Invective Robe slot for 20 Honor Marks. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset. Do you follow me so far?
scripts.translation: 强化恭维法袍或辱骂法袍的一个槽位需要20枚荣誉徽章，最多可强化两个槽位。重置需要10枚荣誉徽章。听明白了吗？

scripts.text: Next, for the Prontera Badge. I'll take 5 Honor Marks to enhance 1 slot. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset.
scripts.translation: 接下来是普隆德拉徽章。强化一个槽位需要5枚荣誉徽章，最多可强化两个槽位。重置需要10枚荣誉徽章。

scripts.text: I don't perform the reset anytime. I'll do it when the 2 slots are enhanced for that you cannot enhance the item anymore. And... Then...
scripts.translation: 我不会随时提供重置服务。只有两个槽位都强化完、无法继续强化时，我才会帮你重置。还有...

scripts.text: Oh, there is one problem though. There is a change that the badge can be destroyed while resetting it. The chance is about 20%. Since it is such a tiny thing, there is some side effect of removing the enhancement.
scripts.translation: 不过有件事要提醒你：重置徽章时有约20%的几率会损坏。毕竟是小物件，移除强化时可能会有些副作用。

scripts.text: I hope the deal goes well, buddy.
You need 20 Honor Marks for each slot of Flattery Robe or Invective Robe. Do you want to enhance it?
scripts.translation: 强化恭维法袍或辱骂法袍的一个槽位需要20枚荣誉徽章。要强化吗？

scripts.text: You need 5 Honor Marks to enhance one slot of the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body. Would you enhance it?
scripts.translation: 强化你左侧装备栏中佩戴的普隆德拉徽章的一个槽位，需要5枚荣誉徽章。要强化吗？

scripts.text: You need 10 Honor Marks to reset Invective Robe or Flattery Robe. The equipment won't be destroyed. The bound cards and the refinement level would remain the same as well.
scripts.translation: 重置辱骂法袍或恭维法袍需要10枚荣誉徽章。装备不会损坏，卡片和精炼等级也会保留。

scripts.text: You need 10 Honor Marks to reset the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body.
scripts.translation: 重置你左侧装备栏中佩戴的普隆德拉徽章需要10枚荣誉徽章。

scripts.text: As I told you, it is difficult to reset the badge, ^ff0000The chance of success is 80%.^000000 If it fails, everything will be gone. Would you reset it?
scripts.translation: 正如我所说，重置徽章有风险，成功率为80%。失败的话，一切都会消失。要重置吗？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I am busy so please don't waste my time by talking to me for no reason.
scripts.translation: 我很忙，没事就别来浪费我的时间。

scripts.text: Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the equipment.
scripts.translation: 别闹了。想强化就穿着装备来找我。

scripts.text: It cannot be enhanced anymore. Do you have anything else to enhance?
scripts.translation: 它已经无法继续强化了。还有别的东西要强化吗？

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计。没有荣誉徽章就别想跟我交易。

scripts.text: Oh, I have forgotten to mention it. I only enhance the item equipped in the left slot. Enhance it while equipping it in the left slot.
scripts.translation: 哦，我忘了说。我只强化装备在左侧槽位的物品。记得把它装备在左侧槽位再来。

scripts.text: Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the Prontera Badge.
scripts.translation: 别闹了。想强化就装备着普隆德拉徽章来找我。

scripts.text: It cannot be enhanced anymore. Do you have anything else to enhance?
scripts.translation: 它已经无法继续强化了。还有别的东西要强化吗？

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计。没有荣誉徽章就别想跟我交易。

scripts.text: Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the equipment.
scripts.translation: 别闹了。想强化就穿着装备来找我。

scripts.text: Oh, this item is not enhanced completely. I cannot reset it yet.
scripts.translation: 哦，这件装备还没强化满，现在不能重置。

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计。没有荣誉徽章就别想跟我交易。

scripts.text: Oh, I have forgotten to mention it. I only enhance the item equipped in the left slot. Enhance it while equipping it in the left slot.
scripts.translation: 哦，我忘了说。我只强化装备在左侧槽位的物品。记得把它装备在左侧槽位再来。

scripts.text: Oh, this item is not enhanced completely. I cannot reset it yet.
scripts.translation: 哦，这件装备还没强化满，现在不能重置。

scripts.text: Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the Prontera Badge.
scripts.translation: 别闹了。想强化就装备着普隆德拉徽章来找我。

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计。没有荣誉徽章就别想跟我交易。

scripts.text: Hum, it has been processed well. Check out the item.
scripts.translation: 嗯，处理好了。看看装备吧。

scripts.text: I guess you are out of luck. The equipment is broken. Tut tut.
scripts.translation: 看来你运气不好，装备坏掉了。啧啧。

scripts.text: Hum, it has been processed well. Check out the item.
scripts.translation: 嗯，处理好了。看看装备吧。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Unauthorized access to this area is restricted. Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation: 险者。未经许可不得进入此区域。感谢配合。

scripts.text: I am sorry to say this but unauthorized access to the area you see in the front is restricted. Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，前方区域禁止未经授权者进入。给您带来不便，敬请谅解。

scripts.text: Come to think of it...Not everyone is allowed to enter this place. Whoa!
scripts.translation: 仔细想想...并不是谁都能进这里。哇！

scripts.text: I heard the adventurer who made the significant contribution to defeating Devil King Morocc has been invited to the royal banquet.
scripts.translation: 我听说，那位为击败魔王梦罗克立下大功的冒险者，受邀参加了王室宴会。
既然您在这里...您一定就是...！

scripts.text: I heard so much about you. I'm a huge fan!
scripts.translation: 说过很多关于您的事，我是您的忠实粉丝！

scripts.text: Holy moly! I felt so bad having to guard here in the night of the banquet and I never expected to see you here, Adventurer. Amazing!
scripts.translation: 天哪！宴会之夜还要在这里站岗，我本来很郁闷，没想到竟然能见到您，冒险者！太棒了！

scripts.text: I am Ellond Lawrence from the Royal Crusaders. I have so much respect for you.
scripts.translation: 我是皇家十字军的艾隆德·劳伦斯。我非常敬仰您。

scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot! Can I get your autograph?
scripts.translation: 哦，我差点忘了！能给我签个名吗？

scripts.text: Thank you so much! Now I have something to brag about to my fellows. What an honor to my family.
scripts.translation: 太感谢了！这下我可以向同伴们炫耀了。真是我们家族的荣幸。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that, but I understand you have reasons.
scripts.translation: 听到您拒绝，我很遗憾，不过我理解您有自己的理由。

scripts.text: Some discussed the idea during the meeting to ask the famous adventurer to handle the problem at the restricted area. No approval was given to it, but I'll see what I can do with my authority.
scripts.translation: 会议上有人提议请那位著名冒险者处理限制区域的问题。提议虽未获批准，我还是会用自己的权限想想办法。
限制区域出了什么问题？

scripts.text: Oh, I knew this would pique your interest, Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 哦，我就知道这会引起您的兴趣，冒险者。

scripts.text: No one will question your reputation and abilities. So I would love to cut to the chase and spill the beans, but...
scripts.translation: 没人会质疑您的名声和本领。我本想开门见山，把详情告诉您，但是...

scripts.text: I think I'll have to take a deep breath and drink a cup of water to calm myself down before I do.
scripts.translation: 我得先深呼吸、喝口水，冷静一下再说。

scripts.text: Now that my thirst has been quenched, let me tell you the story.
scripts.translation: 现在我不渴了，让我告诉您事情的经过。

scripts.text: This problem has long been a pain in the neck.
scripts.translation: 这个问题一直让人头疼。

scripts.text: There was zero monster in the beginning for sure, but, out of the total blue, they started to appear in the underground dungeons.
scripts.translation: 起初那里确实没有魔物，但不知为何，它们突然开始出现在地下迷宫里。

scripts.text: It doesn't mean we're goofing off around here!
scripts.translation: 这可不代表我们在这里偷懒！

scripts.text: We crusaders are doing our best to eliminate the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as we can.
scripts.translation: 我们十字军正尽全力清除地下迷宫里的魔物。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, the numbers kept growing to a degree that we can't handle them all by ourselves.
scripts.translation: 可惜魔物越来越多，单靠我们已经应付不过来了。

scripts.text: I hate to admit, but we haven't even identified where these monsters come from.
scripts.translation: 我很不想承认，但我们甚至还没查明这些魔物的来源。

scripts.text: In the underground dungeon, they are...No. I don't think I should say it right here. You'll see once you get inside.
scripts.translation: 地下迷宫里的那些东西...不，还是别在这里说了。您进去就知道了。

scripts.text: So, what can I do for you?
Oh, I'm sorry. I think I have said too much.
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉。我好像说得太多了。

scripts.text: There is no need to submit any investigation report. We've got ours, too.
scripts.translation: 不需要提交调查报告，我们也有自己的调查结果。

scripts.text: What I would like to ask you to do for us is to mop out the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as you can.
scripts.translation: 我想请您尽可能清除地下迷宫里的魔物。

scripts.text: While you're at it, I would much appreciate it if you can let me in on what goes on inside the underground dungeon.
scripts.translation: 另外，如果您能告诉我地下迷宫里发生了什么，我会非常感激。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector A.
Whoa, what did you just say? You've been to Sector A?
scripts.translation: 哇，您刚才说什么？您去过A区？

scripts.text: I haven't met that bloke in that sector yet, but one of my fellows appointed to that area did say he can be pretty ferocious.
scripts.translation: 我还没见过那一区的人，不过派驻那里的同伴说，他相当凶猛。

scripts.text: Anyway, it is a relief to hear he hasn't caused any trouble there.
scripts.translation: 总之，听说他在那里没惹出麻烦，我就放心了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector B.
~Laughs~ He had been my junior to me.
He can be pretty annoying, I know. He would ask to make a lifelike doll, and even try to hit on his female fellows.
scripts.translation: 我知道他挺烦人的。他会要求做逼真的玩偶，甚至还会搭讪女同事。

scripts.text: So if he hasn't changed much, that means he's not going to make a problem. I'm relieved to hear that.
scripts.translation: 如果他没什么变化，应该不会惹麻烦。听你这么说我就放心了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector C.
~Laughs~ Have you been to Sector C, eh?
Oh, my days! Did he really say you'll be rewarded for those chores? What an improvement!
scripts.translation: 天哪！他真说做那些杂务会给你奖励吗？真是长进了！

scripts.text: It's not uncommon for the Crusaders to lose something they are not supposed to...
scripts.translation: 十字军丢了不该丢的东西，这种事并不少见...

scripts.text: I can see they have improved for some reason. They probably like you a lot.
scripts.translation: 看来他们不知为何有所改进，大概是很喜欢您吧。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector D.

scripts.translation: ~倒吸一口气~ D...区...D区...？！~咽口水~

scripts.text: Don't ever let his looks deceive you! He can be the most dangerous one in the prison.
scripts.translation: 千万别被他的外表骗了！他可能是监狱里最危险的人。

scripts.text: If he doesn't try to do anything to you, it must be the best that could ever happen.
scripts.translation: 只要他没对你动手，那就算最好的情况了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector E.
I know a few things about the Sector E, actually.
Unlike what he looks like, he has such a delicate and warm heart. Still, he can certainly go berserk if things go haywire.
scripts.translation: 别看他外表那样，其实他心思细腻、心地温暖。不过事情失控时，他确实会陷入狂暴。

scripts.text: Just make sure he doesn't see red. Otherwise, you're going to do fine, I guess.
scripts.translation: 只要别惹他发火就行。我想你应该能应付。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector F.
Sector F, eh? ~Laughs~ The real troublemaker is locked in there.
scripts.translation: F区啊？~笑~ 真正的麻烦人物就关在那里。

scripts.text: He would not even lift a finger, bossing everyone around. He thinks the world revolves around him.
scripts.translation: 他懒得动一根手指，只会指使别人，以为全世界都围着他转。

scripts.text: He can be a complainer but he's harmless. I think you'll be fine with him.
scripts.translation: 他虽然爱抱怨，但没什么危险。我想你能应付他。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector G.
Oh, Sector G you say? Hmm, that zone must be...
scripts.translation: 哦，G区啊？嗯，那个区域应该是...

scripts.text: That prisoner is often called as the sleeping beauty in the prison. I remember he's been sleeping for quite a while.
scripts.translation: 那个囚犯常被称为监狱里的睡美人。我记得他已经睡了很久。

scripts.text: I don't have much to say about him because all I saw about him was sleeping. Well, I think you can make good friends with him.
scripts.translation: 我对他没什么好说的，毕竟我只见过他睡觉。嗯，你们应该能成为朋友。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector H.
Ah, Sector H! ~Bursts into laughter~ Is he still a whiner?
scripts.translation: 啊，H区！~大笑~ 他还是那么爱抱怨吗？

scripts.text: I was responsible for him when I first came here and his requests were endless!
scripts.translation: 我刚来这里时负责照看他，他的要求没完没了！

scripts.text: In case you forgot, you took a full tour around the underground dungeon.
scripts.translation: 提醒您一下，您已经完整逛过地下迷宫了。

scripts.text: Phenomenal! You are indeed worthy to be invited to the royal banquet on behalf of other numerous adventurers.
scripts.translation: 太了不起了！您确实有资格代表众多冒险者参加王室宴会。

scripts.text: One more thing. I reported what I requested to you to the superiors.
scripts.translation: 还有，我已经把委托您的事情报告给上级了。

scripts.text: They provided the special reward money for your credibility.
scripts.translation: 上级特意拨了奖励金，以表彰您的贡献。

scripts.text: Now that you received the special reward money, please keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 既然您收到了特别奖励金，请继续努力。

scripts.text: I appreciate what you do for us, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，感谢您为我们所做的一切。

scripts.text: I must say it's quite rare to see such a diligent adventurer like you.
scripts.translation: 像您这样勤勉的冒险者可不多见。

scripts.text: Are you ready to enter the underground dungeon? Do you have anything you'd like to ask?
scripts.translation: 您准备好进入地下迷宫了吗？有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text: I think I saw a bunch like them...
scripts.translation: 我好像见过一群类似的...

scripts.text: Is there something you'd like to know about the underground dungeon?
scripts.translation: 有什么想了解地下迷宫的吗？

scripts.text: Nothing particular. What you can imagine about the dungeon of the kingdom is all there is.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的。王国的地下迷宫大致就是您想象中的那样。

scripts.text: I was told it was made to lock up the menaces to peace and safety of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 听说这里是为了关押威胁卢恩·米德加兹王国和平与安全的危险分子而建的。
基本上设施很坚固，不过...

scripts.text: The facility there is very old so it must need some mending works here and there.
scripts.translation: 那里的设施很老旧，到处都需要修缮。

scripts.text: But, as you can see, we can't even find the time to fix anything.
scripts.translation: 可是您也看到了，我们连抽空修东西都做不到。

scripts.text: The situation here is getting worse, so please take good care of yourself so that you won't get hurt in the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 这里的情况越来越糟，请多保重，别在迷宫里受伤。

scripts.text: What you saw in the dungeon are monsters, for sure. What else could they be?
scripts.translation: 您在迷宫里看到的肯定是魔物。还能是什么？

scripts.text: This facility is so old and there is no document written about it. We just pass down what people say about it.
scripts.translation: 这里的设施太老旧，没有留下任何文献。我们只能听人们口耳相传。

scripts.text: What's certain is that they were the culprit of the chaos created in Rune-Midgarts in the past.
scripts.translation: 可以确定的是，它们过去曾在卢恩·米德加兹制造混乱。

scripts.text: Anyway, there is no document left about them ? for what they were charged or sentences confirmed against them.
scripts.translation: 总之，没有留下关于它们的文书，不论是罪名还是判决都无从查证。

scripts.text: Although there is a document saying that some crusader lost the document containing the charge and the sentence made...
scripts.translation: 不过有份记录提到，一名十字军弄丢了记载指控和判决的文件...

scripts.text: Well, I guess those in the underground dungeon don't seem to care too much about him, so it'd be alright.
scripts.translation: 嗯，地下迷宫里的那些家伙似乎不太在意他，应该没事。

scripts.text: Some of them must still be inside the prison even when they've done the time.
scripts.translation: 有些人刑期已满，却可能仍被关在监狱里。

scripts.text: Oh, I heard about that story, too.
The Crusaders are consisting of various bunches so some of them are adventurers like yourself.
scripts.translation: 十字军里什么人都有，其中也有像您这样的冒险者。

scripts.text: A friend of mine said he saw the monsters from the underground dungeon are going about the world outside of it.
scripts.translation: 有个朋友说，他看见地下迷宫的魔物跑到外面的世界去了。

scripts.text: The Crusaders say he is bluffing a lot probably because he was an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 十字军们说他在吹牛，大概因为他以前是个冒险者吧。

scripts.text: No offense, adventurer. This is not about you. He's just full of baloney...
scripts.translation: 冒险者，别介意，我不是说您。他只是在胡说八道...

scripts.text: I guarantee you that the monsters in the outer world and those in the dungeon must be different beings from each other.
scripts.translation: 我敢保证，外界的魔物和迷宫里的绝不是同一种生物。

scripts.text: They must be remotely related or something.
scripts.translation: 它们之间大概有些遥远的关联。

scripts.text: I am sorry, but unauthorized access to this place is restricted.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，未经许可不得进入此地。

scripts.text: Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.
scripts.translation: 给您带来不便，敬请谅解。感谢配合。

scripts.text: You are out from the Past Memories of the Royal Family?
scripts.translation: 您是从王室回忆中出来的吗？既

scripts.text: Since you know the way here, you must have got the permission to move.
scripts.translation: 然知道来这里的路，想必已经获准通行了。

scripts.text: If you move straight up the stairs, you'll find the Crusader's Office.
scripts.translation: 沿着楼梯直走，就能找到十字军办公室。之

scripts.text: You must to where to go after that, right?
scripts.translation: 后该往哪走，您应该知道吧？

scripts.text: To the Past Memories of the Royal Family
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Who is it? Who's calling me?
The prisoner is howling. Is something happening?
scripts.translation: 囚犯正在嚎叫。发生什么事了？

scripts.text: You must be adventurer, are you? Hmm...You seem like a beginner. I don't see much charm in you.
scripts.translation: 你是冒险者吧？嗯...看起来像个新手，没什么魅力。

scripts.text: Pleasure. It's been a while I saw a human around here.
scripts.translation: 幸会。我已经很久没见到人类了。

scripts.text: You don't seem like that crusader who put me in here. From what I see, I guess you're an adventurer...Is that so?
scripts.translation: 你看起来不像是把我关进来的十字军。依我看，你应该是冒险者...是吧？

scripts.text: It's been a while I saw an adventurer. What brought you here?
scripts.translation: 好久没见到冒险者了。你怎么会来这里？

scripts.text: - I explained why I came here. -
scripts.translation: - 我解释了来这里的原因。 -

scripts.text: I thought the Crusaders released them all, no? I must've thought wrong, then.
scripts.translation: 我还以为十字军把他们全放出来了，看来是我想错了。

scripts.text: I just thought the Crusaders released them to disrupt the prisoners' peaceful break.
scripts.translation: 我还以为十字军把他们放出来，故意扰乱囚犯们的清静。

scripts.text: Anyway, I am sorry that I can't be of any help to you.
scripts.translation: 总之，很抱歉我帮不上忙。

scripts.text: Human adventurer, I couldn't be of help, but do you mind if I ask you to do me a favor?
scripts.translation: 人类冒险者，虽然我帮不上你的忙，但能请你帮我一件事吗？

scripts.text: Let's hear what it is, shall we?
Thank you. I was once a seaman, voyaging around the sea.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。我曾经是个水手，四处航海。

scripts.text: I met a whole lot of fellow seamen as much as I had been on a voyage. Pleasing fellow, bluffing fellow, chicken-hearted fellow...
scripts.translation: 航海时我遇到过许多水手同伴，有人讨喜，有人爱吹牛，也有人胆小如鼠...

scripts.text: - The prisoner seems reminiscent of his past, pounding his left chest with his fist. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯似乎陷入回忆，用拳头捶着自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text: Yes, I've had a lot of fellow seamen from all walks of life. But we had to part with each other after we got here...
scripts.translation: 是啊，我有过许多来自各行各业的水手同伴。可到了这里之后，我们不得不分开...

scripts.text: I've been here for as long as I can remember but that sound...It's pretty recent around here.
scripts.translation: 我在这里待了很久，但那个声音...最近才开始出现。

scripts.text: It's indistinct but...I can hear the sound from the very far into the darkness, calling me...
scripts.translation: 声音很模糊...我能听见黑暗深处传来呼唤...

scripts.text: Can you find an old fellow of mine who must be locked somewhere in the prison for me?
scripts.translation: 你能帮我找找被关在监狱某处的老伙计吗？

scripts.text: Thank you. I hope it is the cry from that fellow.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。我希望那是老伙计的呼唤。

scripts.text: Please. I hope it's one of my fellow men. You have no idea how long it's been.
scripts.translation: 拜托了，希望那是我的同伴。我等这一天等了很久。

scripts.text: You came, at last! So what was that sound? Did you meet my man?
scripts.translation: 你终于来了！那个声音是怎么回事？你见到我的老伙计了吗？

scripts.text: - I explained what happened to his fellow. -
scripts.translation: - 我向他说明了同伴的遭遇。 -

scripts.text: So what I heard from darkness was indeed the voice from my fellow man. I hoped he'd be alright.
scripts.translation: 原来黑暗中传来的确实是同伴的声音。我还盼着他平安无事。

scripts.text: So he is no longer alive...I know it's been quite a while since that happened, but it's still a shame.
scripts.translation: 原来他已经不在人世了...虽然那是很久以前的事，还是让人惋惜。

scripts.text: Thank you so much for finding that out for me. I'm much obliged.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢你替我查明此事。我感激不尽。

scripts.text: By the way, I haven't even asked your name. What is your name?
scripts.translation: 对了，我还没问过你的名字。你叫什么？

scripts.text: - The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯握紧拳头，捶了捶自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text: I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.
scripts.translation: 我会把你的名字刻在这里。希望你能继续替我向同伴传话。

scripts.text: Can you locate an old fellow of mine, again, and deliver his story to me?
scripts.translation: 。你能再帮我找找老伙计，把他的故事带给我吗？

scripts.text: I've got my hands full today.
Is that so? That's a shame. Be sure to come back again if you have the time...
scripts.translation: 是吗？真遗憾。有空记得再来...

scripts.text: I sure am counting on you.
I can't wait to hear it.
I owe you big time. You have no idea.
scripts.translation: 我欠你一份大人情，你可不知道。

scripts.text: - The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯握紧拳头，捶了捶自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text: I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.
scripts.translation: 我会把你的名字刻在这里。希望你能继续替我向同伴传话。

scripts.text: Now that the fellow has become freer from death, I wonder what he's up to. I wonder what kind of memory he would write in his next letter.
scripts.translation: 那位老伙计已经逃过一劫，不知他现在怎么样。不知道他下一封信会写下怎样的回忆。

scripts.text: The prisoner started singing as if he was reminiscing about something.
scripts.translation: 囚犯像是回忆起什么，开始哼唱。

scripts.text: Is it already that time to hear the news from the old fellow of mine?
scripts.translation: 是不是又到了听老伙计消息的时候？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. As soon as I showed an interest, it was gone nowhere.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影漂浮在暗处。我刚表现出兴趣，它就消失了。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape starts to sway when it saw me. Did it mean it's delighted to see me?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影看见我后摇晃起来。它是在高兴吗？

scripts.text: The Dark Shape handed you the letter and was gone.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影把信交给你后消失了。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape seems to be in a good mood, humming along.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影心情不错，正哼着歌。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. What should I do about it?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影漂浮在暗处。我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Ask if he's the fellow of 243AD265.
You have no idea what it's talking about, but get the impression, from its response to what you say, that it must be the one of the Prisoner 243AD265's fellows.
scripts.translation: 你完全听不懂它在说什么，但从它的反应看来，它应该是囚犯243AD265的同伴。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape handed you the letter and left. Did it mean to ask you to deliver it?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影把信交给你后离开了。它是想让你替它送信吗？

scripts.text: You are becoming increasingly agitated as you can't communicate with it effectively. So you decided to leave.
scripts.translation: 你无法和它顺利沟通，越来越焦躁，于是决定离开。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape must've noticed it. It's gone nowhere, too.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影似乎察觉到了什么，也消失了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner here is sitting with the extremely bored look. If you talk to him at this point, you may have to sit down to hang out with him.
scripts.translation: 囚犯坐在这里，无聊得东张西望。现在和他说话，恐怕得坐下来陪他打发时间。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm bored as you must've imagined, but I can't hang out with you. Why? You don't have the eyes that I want.
scripts.translation: 正如你想的，我很无聊，但没法陪你消遣。为什么？因为你没有我想要的眼睛。

scripts.text: Hey! Yes, you outside of the steel bars. You have such pretty eyes. My cup of tea.
scripts.translation: 嘿，铁栏杆外的你！你的眼睛真漂亮，正合我意。

scripts.text: Please be nice and give me either of your eyes. I'll cherish them.
scripts.translation: 乖一点，把一只眼睛给我吧。我会好好珍惜的。

scripts.text: Am I? Because those eyes look so gorgeous.
scripts.translation: 是吗？你的眼睛实在太漂亮了

scripts.text: Even if you give me one of those, you still have one left. How hard can it be?
scripts.translation: 。就算给我一只，你不是还剩一只吗？这有什么难的？

scripts.text: Well, if you say so, can you just find the time to talk with me, then?
scripts.translation: 好吧，既然你这么说，那就抽空来陪我聊聊天吧？

scripts.text: You're pretty straightforward. If you say so...
scripts.translation: 你倒挺直率。既然你这么说...

scripts.text: Alright, then! What should we talk about first?
How about this? Do you know what charge people put against me? It's the marriage scam!
scripts.translation: 这样吧，你知道我被控什么罪吗？婚姻诈骗！

scripts.text: Marriage scam? Ridiculous! Do I look like someone who would dupe anyone into marrying me?
scripts.translation: 婚姻诈骗？荒唐！我看起来像会骗别人跟我结婚的人吗？

scripts.text: Pretty eyes don't do any good, I guess! You should open your mind to match those pretty little eyes!
scripts.translation: 看来漂亮眼睛也没用！你该敞开心扉，别辜负这双漂亮眼睛！

scripts.text: I was merely attracted to the woman with pretty eyes. It was pure love. People don't get me.
scripts.translation: 我只是被那个有双漂亮眼睛的女人吸引了，那是纯粹的爱情。大家都不理解我。

scripts.text: Oh, I remember. Yes, there is a bunch who's walking around the underground dungeon as freely as they desire.
scripts.translation: 哦，我想起来了。有一群家伙在地下迷宫里想去哪就去哪。

scripts.text: I thought that was weird and recently found the cheeky ones with the bat wings when they're not even bats.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这很奇怪。最近还看到一些长着蝙蝠翅膀的家伙，可它们明明不是蝙蝠。

scripts.text: They were cheeky indeed, but I thought they have pretty blue eyes.
scripts.translation: 它们确实很无礼，不过我觉得它们有漂亮的蓝眼睛。

scripts.text: So I told them I would gracefully let them pass with their wings and, in return, they should give me that blue gems.
scripts.translation: 所以我说可以放它们带着翅膀通过，但要拿那些蓝色宝石来交换。

scripts.text: But they might listen to you because you have pretty eyes.
scripts.translation: 不过你有一双漂亮眼睛，也许它们会听你的。

scripts.text: Can you just go ask them to give their pretty gems? I'm not allowed to leave here.
scripts.translation: 你能去问问它们要那些漂亮宝石吗？我不能离开这里。

scripts.text: If they wouldn't listen, why don't you just take them? How about 20? I'm giving you the special grant.
scripts.translation: 它们不肯听的话，直接拿来不就行了？给我20个吧，我特别批准了。

scripts.text: It started off with a little chat, but ended up as a request. Haha!
scripts.translation: 本来只是随便聊聊，结果变成了提要求。哈哈！

scripts.text: I believe someone with pretty eyes like you should forgive me. So...
scripts.translation: 我相信你这么漂亮的人一定会原谅我的。所以...

scripts.text: Go and get those pretty gems from the cheeky bunch with the bat wings.
scripts.translation: 去把那群长着蝙蝠翅膀的无礼家伙的漂亮宝石拿来。

scripts.text: You should get me at least 20, alright?
No way! What I saw were blue eyes but these are red! That's odd!
scripts.translation: 不可能！我看到的明明是蓝眼睛，这些却是红色的！真奇怪！

scripts.text: I'll have to take a close look. Will you hand them to me?
scripts.translation: 我得仔细看看。把它们交给我吧？

scripts.text: Now that I have a job to do for today and you've done a good job. Maybe I should give you a present.
scripts.translation: 今天总算有事可做了，而且你也干得不错。也许我该送你份礼物。

scripts.text: Humans who had been here before gave me this. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.
scripts.translation: 以前来过这里的人类送我的。我不喜欢这种设计，就送给你吧。

scripts.text: This time, again, I took a close look at it.
scripts.translation: 这次我又仔细检查了一遍。

scripts.text: But I couldn't find what turned the blue eyes into the red ones.
scripts.translation: 可我没找到蓝眼睛变红的原因。

scripts.text: So I'm asking you ? will you take the blue gems from them again?
scripts.translation: 我再问你一次，你愿意再去拿那些蓝色宝石吗？

scripts.text: I thought you'd be different. So disappointing.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你会不一样。真让人失望。

scripts.text: You should get me at least 20, alright?
Oh~~ I wish I would get the pretty blue eyes this time~~
scripts.translation: 哦~~希望这次拿到的是漂亮的蓝眼睛~~

scripts.text: Oh, you indeed brought them! I'll take a close look. Let me.
scripts.translation: 哦，你真的带来了！让我仔细看看。

scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot. This is the thing I talked to you the last time. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.
scripts.translation: 哦，我差点忘了。这就是上次提到的东西。我不喜欢这种设计，送给你吧。

scripts.text: He's really taking the time looking closely at the red eyes you brought.
scripts.translation: 他正仔细端详你带来的红色眼睛。

scripts.text: He must not be responding to whatever you say to him now.
scripts.translation: 他现在似乎听不见你说话。

scripts.text: Oh, I have nothing else to do. I'm so bored. I should do something.
scripts.translation: 哦，我没事可做，无聊死了。得找点事干。

scripts.text: Oh! Human with pretty eyes! You've come at the right time.
scripts.translation: 哦，眼睛漂亮的人类！你来得正好。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner here is gazing around the corners like a hunting lion. You want to get away before you get caught.
scripts.translation: 这里的囚犯像猎食的狮子一样四处张望。你想趁被他发现前溜走。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to say this but I have to work now. Let me play with you later.
scripts.translation: ！抱歉，我现在得工作，待会儿再陪你玩。

scripts.text: How did you get in here? You've got some skills!
scripts.translation: 你怎么进来的？有两下子嘛！

scripts.text: Let me give you a compliment stamp. Here it is!
Hehe- I think it's all good since I don't have to see the menacing ones. Right?
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿——不用看那些吓人的家伙，我觉得一切都挺好。对吧？

scripts.text: What I learned is that the humans would do anything for a reward. Am I right or what?
scripts.translation: 我发现人类为了奖励什么都肯做。对不对？

scripts.text: Let me give you quite a good one. Just follow one of my 'orders.'
scripts.translation: 我给你个不错的奖励。只要听从我的一个“命令”就行。

scripts.text: You're such a good human. See? You'll know what I mean if you have eyes.
scripts.translation: 错！你真是个好人类。明白了吗？有眼睛的话就该懂我的意思。

scripts.text: This underground dungeon used to be clean and neat. Once the humans came along a while ago, it got dirty probably because they haven't done the proper cleaning.
scripts.translation: 这个地下迷宫以前干净整洁。人类来了之后，大概没好好打扫，才变得脏兮兮的。

scripts.text: Watch this, human. Trust my detective instinct. Do you see them wandering around here?
scripts.translation: 看好了，人类。相信我的侦探直觉。你看到它们在这里游荡了吗？

scripts.text: I have no idea how they got in, but I'm absolutely sure they're the cause of dirtiness in the prison.
scripts.translation: 我不知道它们怎么进来的，但我敢肯定，是它们把监狱弄脏了。

scripts.text: Do you want me to attack them?
What are you talking about, human? They're nice. I didn't know you'd be this violent. I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation: 你在说什么，人类？它们很可爱。没想到你这么暴力，真让我失望。

scripts.text: Stop harassing the innocent kids. Just go around the prison and clean up the mess.
scripts.translation: 别欺负无辜的小家伙。去监狱周围把垃圾清理干净。

scripts.text: Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.
scripts.translation: 人类！别偷懒，把这里那里都擦干净。好好做。

scripts.text: You've done your cleaning? Yay! Here's your compliment stamp!
scripts.translation: 打扫完了？太好了！这是给你的表扬章！

scripts.text: Now that the prison becomes clean, you must be feeling good, too, aren't you, human? We should do the cleaning more often.
scripts.translation: 监狱变干净了，你心情也好多了吧，人类？我们该常打扫才对。

scripts.text: Oh, right! I told you I'd give you a reward, didn't I?
scripts.translation: 对了！我说过会给你奖励，对吧？

scripts.text: This is what the human who worked here before gave me. You've been such a sport so let me give you this.
scripts.translation: 这是以前在这里工作的人类送我的。你表现不错，就给你吧。

scripts.text: If you come back again tomorrow and give me a hand, there will be more of this. Come back often!
scripts.translation: 明天再来帮我，还能拿到更多。记得常来！

scripts.text: Now that the prison has gotten messy as I intended. So it's finally the time for cleaning.
scripts.translation: 监狱现在变得够乱了，终于该打扫了。

scripts.text: Cleaning will make the day rewarding!
scripts.translation: 打扫干净，这一天才算有收获！

scripts.text: No way! I will never do it. Over my dead body.
Oh, you...! I knew you'd be better but I didn't know you were this lazy. Big letdown!
scripts.translation: 哦，你...！我以为你会好些，没想到这么懒。太让我失望了！

scripts.text: Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.
scripts.translation: 人类！别偷懒，把这里那里都擦干净。好好做。

scripts.text: What a good human! You've earned another compliment stamp! Here it is!
scripts.translation: 真是个好人类！你又得到一枚表扬章了！来！

scripts.text: Now that you finished cleaning for today, let me give you this. Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 今天的清扫结束了，给你这个。明天再来！

scripts.text: You don't seem to know the fun of messing things up. Messing is as fun as cleaning!
scripts.translation: 你似乎不懂捣乱的乐趣。把东西弄乱和打扫一样有趣！

scripts.text: That's about enough now. You can do the rest tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 差不多了，剩下的明天再做。

scripts.text: You've come at the right time. The prison has gotten properly messy, so it's time for cleaning.
scripts.translation: 你来得正好。监狱已经够乱了，该打扫了。

scripts.text: Some stuff left around the floor are lumped together.
scripts.translation: 地上的一些杂物堆在了一起。

scripts.text: You're sad but there still are much to clean. Go find something to clean up.
scripts.translation: 虽然你有些沮丧，但还有很多要打扫。去找些东西清理吧。

scripts.text: You finished cleaning. Report the result.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: What is it, human? Anything you want to say to me?
scripts.translation: 人类，怎么了？有什么话要对我说？

scripts.text: What are you talking about? I don't have time for this. Beat it.
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？我没空听这些。滚开。

scripts.text: What?! Do you have anything to say to me? Spit it out, then!
I was ridiculed for no reason and it really feels bad.
scripts.translation: 我无缘无故被嘲笑，心里很不好受。

scripts.text: What?! Do you have a problem with me? Be gone now.
~Giggles~ I suddenly feel better now. Alright, what the heck. I'll send you to the sector you want for 1 Jellopy.
scripts.translation: ~咯咯笑~ 我突然心情好多了。好吧，随便你去哪，给我1个杰勒比结晶，我就送你过去。

scripts.text: What? You don't even have Jellopy with you? How useless are you?
scripts.translation: 什么？你连杰勒比结晶都没带？真没用。

scripts.text: What? Sector D is right here! Well, I've got my Jellopy so I don't care. Let me send you there.
scripts.translation: 什么？D区就在这里！反正我有杰勒比结晶，不在乎。送你过去吧。

scripts.text: Thank you for Jellopy! {0} it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的杰勒比结晶！{0}个就够了。走吧！

scripts.text: Just leave me alone! Go away!
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner is breathing calmly so he must be sleeping.
scripts.translation: 囚犯呼吸平稳，看来睡着了。
~嗅~ 这个气味...没错...是人类...

scripts.text: ~Giggles~ It's been such a while since any human came along in this dark underground. Get over here, human. It's been a while so I will show mercy and let you live.
scripts.translation: ~咯咯笑~ 这片黑暗的地下已经很久没人来了。过来吧，人类。看在好久没人来的份上，我大发慈悲饶你一命。

scripts.text: ~Evil laughter~ You've got the courage, human!
scripts.translation: ~邪恶的笑声~ 你胆子不小啊，人类

scripts.text: I can't wait to let the dumb humans taste of my fist of terror!
scripts.translation: ！我等不及要让愚蠢的人类尝尝我恐惧之拳的滋味！

scripts.text: Now I can't let myself out of this dark and damp place because of the chicken-hearted human. Once I get out of here, I will never forgive the humans.
scripts.translation: 因为那个胆小鬼，我才被困在这阴暗潮湿的地方。等我出去，绝不会放过人类。

scripts.text: Well...there is particularly no need to...
Talking back to me? How dare you! But I like your audacity, too. You can be my underling, then.
scripts.translation: 声~敢顶嘴？胆子不小！不过我也喜欢你的胆量。那你就做我的手下吧。

scripts.text: By the way, didn't you just cringe?
scripts.translation: 你刚才不是缩起来了吗？

scripts.text: Wa-hahaha! I think I've got myself a cocky underling.
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈！看来我有了个狂妄的手下

scripts.text: Remember. A dark and humid place like this one is a match for a doppelganger who is blatantly wicked and doesn't even have its own face.
scripts.translation: 。记住，像这里这样阴暗潮湿的地方，正适合我这种面目狰狞、邪恶透顶的分身。

scripts.text: Let me give a chance to this amusing underling to prove your sense of loyalty. I'll have to brighten up this place first.
scripts.translation: 笑声~我给你这个有趣的手下一个证明忠诚的机会。首先得把这里弄亮。

scripts.text: Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. This place is too dark. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.
scripts.translation: 手下，去拿监狱里最亮的火把。这里太黑了，我要把它变得像我的故乡一样明亮。

scripts.text: Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.
scripts.translation: 手下，去拿监狱里最亮的火把。我要把这里弄得像我的故乡一样明亮。

scripts.text: What a loyal subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.
scripts.translation: 笑声~真是忠心的部下！多亏你，我至少能过上一段明亮的日子。

scripts.text: I mean, I am not your under...
scripts.translation: 我是说，我不是你的手下...

scripts.text: I would like to give you a reward, but I'm afraid I don't have much. I would've given you a world of treasures if it were my golden days.
scripts.translation: 我想给你奖励，可惜没什么好东西。要是在我的全盛时期，肯定会送你一大堆宝物。

scripts.text: Underling, this is a shame, but I'll give you something I took from the human who would come in here.
scripts.translation: 手下，真可惜，我只能把以前从进来的那些人类身上抢来的东西给你。

scripts.text: I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.
scripts.translation: 等我重回世界之巅那天，一定给你更多奖励。

scripts.text: It's time to demonstrate your sense of loyalty. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison.
scripts.translation: 该证明你的忠诚了。去拿监狱里最亮的火把。

scripts.text: Is there anything you should do now? I'm perplexed to hear it but I will do my best to understand you.
scripts.translation: 现在还有什么事吗？虽然不太明白，我会尽量理解。不

scripts.text: Still, don't make me wait too long.
~Laughter~ Go! Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison.
scripts.translation: ~笑~ 去吧！把监狱里最亮的火把拿来。

scripts.text: Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison, again.
scripts.translation: 再去把监狱里最亮的火把拿来。

scripts.text: What an exemplary subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.
scripts.translation: 真是模范部下！多亏你的帮忙，我至少能过上一段明亮的日子。

scripts.text: Keep this in mind. I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.
scripts.translation: 记住，等我重回世界之巅那天，一定给你更多奖励。

scripts.text: Things haven't changed much but it still feels good to see this place has gotten brighter.
scripts.translation: 虽然没什么变化，但这里亮起来了，感觉真不错。

scripts.text: Just so you know, the torchlight you brought is waning. It's time to show me your sense of worth to me again.
scripts.translation: 提醒你一下，你带来的火把快熄灭了。该再向我证明你的价值了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: This is a large torch burning quite brightly.
scripts.translation: 这是一支燃烧得很亮的大火把。

scripts.text: You carefully collected the light and obtained the bright light.
scripts.translation: 你小心地收集了火光，获得了明亮的光芒。

scripts.text: You carefully collected the light but it scattered.
scripts.translation: 你小心地收集火光，但火光散开了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Hey, are you that new servant?
The prisoner inside seems to be looking for a servant. I think he saw me but I'll just have to act like I didn't hear him.
scripts.translation: 里面的囚犯似乎在找仆人。我觉得他看见我了，但还是装作没听见吧。

scripts.text: Tsk, tsk. Even a servant is supposed to know manners.
scripts.translation: 啧啧，连仆人也该懂点礼貌。

scripts.text: Are you that new servant? I guess the prisoner keeper has sent another human servant, then.
scripts.translation: 你是新来的仆人吗？看来狱卒又派了一个人类仆人来。

scripts.text: I didn't like the human servant last time. He was too weak. I don't know about you.
scripts.translation: 我不喜欢上一个人类仆人，他太弱了。不知道你怎么样。

scripts.text: I'm worried but there is nothing else I can do.
scripts.translation: 我很担心，可也别无他法。

scripts.text: Human servant. What is your name? What should I call you?
scripts.translation: 人类仆人，你叫什么？我该怎么称呼你？

scripts.text: {0} What a weird and difficult name to pronounce! I wanted to call you by your name, but, I don't think I can.
scripts.translation: {0}，真是个奇怪又难念的名字！我本想叫你的名字，可看来做不到。

scripts.text: Oh, right, you're Noyel! I like the sound of the name. Your name is Noyel from now on.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，你是诺耶尔！我喜欢这个名字。从现在起就叫你诺耶尔。

scripts.text: Noyel, I have a question! Are the other human prisoners living in this dire environment?
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，我有个问题！其他人类囚犯也生活在这种恶劣环境里吗？

scripts.text: I know I'm a prisoner here, but I don't understand why they have to lock me in this place that is so dirty and humid.
scripts.translation: 我知道自己是囚犯，但不明白为什么要把我关在这么脏又潮湿的地方。

scripts.text: Noyel, go ahead and bring that prisoner keeper. I have a bone to pick with him.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，去把狱卒叫来。我有账要跟他算。

scripts.text: I don't think that's going to happen.
I didn't know a servant has no right to meet with the prisoner keepers. My apology.
scripts.translation: 我不知道仆人不能见狱卒。抱歉。

scripts.text: But I can't go there myself. That means it's impossible to meet him then. We should come up with an alternative.
scripts.translation: 可我自己也去不了那里，看来是见不到他了。我们得想个别的办法。

scripts.text: Now I remember. The servant who used to serve me gave me that. I'm not sure it's still here.
scripts.translation: 我想起来了。以前服侍我的仆人给过我那个东西，不知道现在还在不在。

scripts.text: For what I remember, it was something that you humans use. It is called a dehumidifier removing humidity around you. Do you know what that is?
scripts.translation: 我记得那是你们人类用的东西，叫除湿机，可以除去周围的湿气。你知道是什么吗？

scripts.text: Maybe I should use it because I don't have any other option. Bring me about 20 of them.
scripts.translation: 也许我该用它，反正也别无选择。给我拿20个来。

scripts.text: Still no dehumidifiers for me, Noyel? I don't need many. 20 dehumidifiers will do.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，除湿机还没拿来吗？不用很多，20个就够了。

scripts.text: I start to feel the damp and soggy place is getting freshened up, Noyel.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，这潮湿阴冷的地方好像清爽多了。

scripts.text: Good job. Go have a rest until I call you back up.
scripts.translation: 干得好。去休息吧，等我叫你再过来。

scripts.text: It's nothing. I don't need it so you take and use it.
scripts.translation: 没什么，我用不着了，你拿去用吧。

scripts.text: Noyel, the humidifier you brought for me doesn't seem to work. Will you bring another new one?
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，你带来的除湿机好像坏了。能再拿一个新的吗？

scripts.text: Ah...I've got other business to go about now.
scripts.translation: 啊...我现在还有别的事要忙

scripts.text: Noyel! Where do you think you're going? Noel.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔！你要去哪儿？诺耶尔！

scripts.text: Thank you, Noyel. I will wait for you to bring me 20 dehumidifiers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你，诺耶尔。我等你带20个除湿机来。

scripts.text: Noyel, when can I get those 20 dehumidifiers? The air feels so soggy and it's starting to feel unpleasant.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，什么时候才能拿到那20个除湿机？空气太潮湿，真让人难受。

scripts.text: You're late, Noyel. Did you have a hard time getting the dehumidifier?
scripts.translation: 你来晚了，诺耶尔。找除湿机很费劲吗？

scripts.text: I was actually starting to feel displeased by the dampening air.
scripts.translation: 潮湿的空气已经让我很不舒服了。

scripts.text: You did a good job getting the humidifier, Noyel.
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，除湿机找到了，干得好。

scripts.text: Noyel, the air I breathe couldn't be more fresh now!
scripts.translation: 诺耶尔，我现在呼吸的空气真是清新极了！

scripts.text: Even the prisoners deserve the pleasant environment to live. Keep that in mind, Noyel. Just in case.
scripts.translation: 即使是囚犯，也值得拥有舒适的生活环境。诺耶尔，记住这一点。

scripts.text: The dehumidifier you brought doesn't seem to function well. It's time to replace it with a new one.
scripts.translation: ，诺耶尔。你带来的除湿机似乎不太管用，该换新的了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner here is smiling out of his pain. I don't think he's in normal condition. Should I pass him?
scripts.translation: 这里的囚犯痛苦地笑着，状态似乎不太正常。要绕开他吗？

scripts.text: ~Giggles~ How long have I waited for a guest?
scripts.translation: ~咯咯笑~ 我等客人等了多久？

scripts.text: Even if your fear of me binds me here in the land of darkness, you can never bind my will. Mark my word.
scripts.translation: 就算你因恐惧把我困在这片黑暗之地，也休想束缚我的意志。记住我的话。

scripts.text: Ever since the cowards stopped coming to this land of darkness, I took my last sleep out of boredom.
scripts.translation: 自从那些胆小鬼不再踏入这片黑暗之地，我就无聊得睡了过去。

scripts.text: That was my mistake. Darkness inside of me became greater during my sleep and the followers awaken by darkness changed a lot of things in this land.
scripts.translation: 那是我的失误。沉睡时，我体内的黑暗愈发强大，被黑暗唤醒的信徒也改变了这片土地的许多事。

scripts.text: I hate to admit this but darkness is stomping around. I need something to bring it under control.
scripts.translation: 声~我不愿承认，但黑暗正在肆虐。我需要什么东西来压制它。

scripts.text: It doesn't happen every day for a lard to ask you to do something. ~Grunts~ Bring me...some flowers...
scripts.translation: 类...让老子开口求你可不常见。~呻吟~ 给我带些...花来...

scripts.text: Flowers representing the world are what not only soothes down darkness but also brings the peace of mind.
scripts.translation: 象征世界的花不仅能平息黑暗，也能让人心安。

scripts.text: ~Grunts~ It must be effective in calming down the growing darkness.
scripts.translation: ~呻吟~ 它应该能安抚不断增强的黑暗。

scripts.text: Hurry. ~Grunts~ Darkness inside of me is trying to stomp around. If you don't want to see the world brought to ashes by this darkness, bring me...flowers...Now.
scripts.translation: 快。~呻吟~ 我体内的黑暗正要肆虐。如果你不想看世界被黑暗化为灰烬，就带花来...现在。

scripts.text: ~Grunts~ I'll wait here for you. Any flowers would do. Bring me flowers.
scripts.translation: ~呻吟~ 我会在这里等你。什么花都行，带些来。

scripts.text: ~Evil laughter~ Human! You saved the world against darkness. Be glad!
scripts.translation: 邪恶的笑声~ 人类！你拯救了世界，使它免于黑暗。高兴吧！

scripts.text: I can feel darkness inside is getting under control.
scripts.translation: 我感觉体内的黑暗正在受到控制。

scripts.text: ~Grunts~ How pathetic I have become, getting help from a human...
scripts.translation: ~呻吟~ 我竟然要一个人类帮忙，真是狼狈...

scripts.text: You don't need to thank me. But, why the flowers?
scripts.translation: 不用谢我。不过，为什么是花？

scripts.text: Wait. Maybe it's alright after all since you're my savior.
scripts.translation: 等等。你毕竟救了我，也许告诉你也无妨。

scripts.text: Alright, whatever. I'll let you in on it just this once.
scripts.translation: 好吧，算了。这次就破例告诉你。

scripts.text: It was around the time when I was holding sway in the world. I was conquering one of the human towns with my followers.
scripts.translation: 那是我称霸世界的时候。我正带着信徒征服一个人类城镇。

scripts.text: I met a girl in that village who was different from other humans.
scripts.translation: 我在那个村子里遇到一个与众不同的女孩。

scripts.text: Humans who got scared silly were busy running away from me and my followers but that girl was different. She reached out to me.
scripts.translation: 其他人类吓得魂飞魄散，忙着逃离我和信徒，只有那个女孩不一样。她向我伸出了手。

scripts.text: You, human! Don't people often say you can be a wet blanket?
scripts.translation: 人类！你不知道大家常说你是个扫兴鬼吗？

scripts.text: It's true that you've been of help so let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.
scripts.translation: 你确实帮了我，就把信徒留下的东西给你一件吧。

scripts.text: ~Grunts~ If you don't want to see my darkness drags down the whole world to ashes, you'd better come often and bring me flowers.
scripts.translation: ~呻吟~ 不想看我的黑暗把世界拖入毁灭，就常来给我带花。

scripts.text: Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!
Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!
scripts.translation: 得控制住黑暗。快把花给我...啊！

scripts.text: Please get me one flower to calm down darkness, human...
scripts.translation: 人类...给我一朵花，让黑暗平息下来...

scripts.text: I'll hang in there. Just don't be too late...
Oh, no. It's getting out of my hand. Before this darkness goes berserk, bring me...flowers...~Grunts~
scripts.translation: 不...快控制不住了。黑暗狂暴起来之前，给我带花来...~呻吟~
花...？~呻吟~ 黑暗应该稳定下来了...

scripts.text: - The flower you just gave has withered. -
scripts.translation: - 你刚才给的花已经枯萎了。 -

scripts.text: This flower isn't enough to calm down darkness. Bring in more...!
scripts.translation: 这朵花不足以平息黑暗。再多带些来...！

scripts.text: ...It's working. Thank you, human. You've been a lot of help, too, this time.
scripts.translation: ...有用。谢谢你，人类。这次你也帮了大忙。

scripts.text: Let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.
scripts.translation: 我把信徒留下的东西给你一件吧。

scripts.text: I'll contact you again when the darkness inside of me starts to stomp around.
scripts.translation: 等我体内的黑暗再次躁动时，会再找你。

scripts.text: ~Grunts~ Pray, human. Pray if you don't want my darkness flail around. You don't want to see the end of the world.
scripts.translation: ~呻吟~ 祈祷吧，人类。若不想我的黑暗肆虐，就祈祷吧。你不会想看到世界末日的。

scripts.text: Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!
Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!
scripts.translation: 得控制住黑暗。快把花给我...啊！

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: I wonder the prisoner here may think this prison as some kind of a hotel. He's looking for a manager. I'll just let this one pass.
scripts.translation: 我看这囚犯把监狱当成旅馆了，居然在找经理。我还是别理他吧。

scripts.text: I would like to talk to the manager, not some normal clerk!
scripts.translation: 我要找经理，不是普通职员！

scripts.text: You look like a manager to me. I have to tell you, the service here is downright poor. Don't you agree, manager? Huh?!
scripts.translation: 你看起来像经理。我得说，这里的服务糟透了。你说是不是，经理？嗯？！

scripts.text: You've come at a good time, I guess. I haven't had the time to take care of my horn and it's still hanging in there.
scripts.translation: 你来得正好。我一直没空打理我的角，角都快撑不住了。

scripts.text: My horn used to be praised by the horned bunch and...I hate to even imagine what they would say to me if they get to see this ugly horn now.
scripts.translation: 我的角以前很受那些有角的家伙称赞...真不敢想它们现在看到我这丑角会怎么说。

scripts.text: Before my horn gets really damaged, I need to get it taken care of. But I don't see proper materials around here.
scripts.translation: 我的角彻底损坏前，得好好打理一番。但附近没有合适的材料。

scripts.text: Hey, manager. I think you're in luck. I think I've found something just right.
scripts.translation: 嘿，经理。看来你运气不错，我找到合适的东西了。

scripts.text: I see Taffy, the inferior species, walking around. I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper to trim down this thingies at the end of my horn.
scripts.translation: 我看到塔菲这种低等生物在四处走动。它们的皮应该能代替砂纸，磨掉我角尖上的小突起。

scripts.text: Look at this. This protruded area at the end of my horn. If it gets trimmed down, I would definitely get a peace of mind.
scripts.translation: 看这里，这是我角尖突出来的部分。磨掉之后，我就能安心了。

scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to skin that Taffy and bring me 20!
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？我叫你剥下塔菲的皮，给我带20张来！

scripts.text: What are you doing? Still haven't left?
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？还没出发吗？

scripts.text: You see Taffy walking around there? I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper. Bring 20 of them.
scripts.translation: 看到那边的塔菲了吗？它们的皮应该能代替砂纸。给我带20张来。

scripts.text: What in the world are they taking so long? They're slow with poor service...I know my manners as knight so I can't just pick a fight. Alright. Just take this tip.
scripts.translation: 他们怎么这么慢？服务真差...我身为骑士得讲礼貌，总不能动手。算了，这点小费给你。

scripts.text: ~Sighs~ Given the condition of my horn, I don't think a couple of these won't do any good at all.
scripts.translation: ~叹气~ 我的角都这样了，几张砂纸恐怕根本不够用。

scripts.text: You've come at the right time, manager.
I was putting on a cool pair of shoes but something happened and I broke my toenails.
scripts.translation: 我刚穿上一双帅气的鞋，却出了点意外，把脚趾甲弄断了。

scripts.text: That thing you brought me last time was pretty good. I'm impressed by your skinning ability. How about changing your job to skin master?
scripts.translation: 你上次带来的东西不错，我很佩服你的剥皮本领。要不要转行当剥皮专家？

scripts.text: In that spirit, why don't you bring me those 20 Sandpapers again?
scripts.translation: 既然这样，再给我带20张砂纸吧？

scripts.text: I knew it. Talk about poor service!
I can't wait to see what you'll bring this time.
scripts.translation: 我等不及想看看你这次会带什么来。

scripts.text: Rudolph the hero of reindeers said time is gold. I think it applies to humans, too.
scripts.translation: 驯鹿英雄鲁道夫说过“时间就是金钱”。我觉得这话对人类也适用。

scripts.text: You can't turn back time once it passes. Hurry up. You have no time to lose.
scripts.translation: 时间一去不返。快点，别浪费时间。

scripts.text: This time, the service is acceptable.
scripts.translation: 这次的服务还算过得去。

scripts.text: Here's your tip for your satisfactory work. Come back again.
scripts.translation: 这点小费是给你辛苦工作的。下次再来。

scripts.text: Oh, this alternative is better than I thought.
scripts.translation: 哦，这种替代品比我想的还好。

scripts.text: You've come at the right time, manager.
All quests related with the underground dungeon will be reset.
scripts.translation: 所有地下城相关任务都将重置。

scripts.text: Choose the quest to customize the setting.
scripts.translation: 请选择要自定义设置的任务。
